d: v  取消， 废除； 删去， 删除； 抵消 to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen

es.e: Our flight was cancelled.
es.c: 我们的航班取消了。

es.e: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
es.c: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

es.e: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
es.c: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

d: v  向后倚靠， 斜倚 to lie or lean back in a relaxed way

es.e: She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue.
es.c: 她开始斜靠在一个躺椅上。

d: adj 爆炸的，爆发的；使人冲动的 able or likely to explode；n  炸药 a substance that can cause an explosion

es.e: Because the gas is highly explosive, it needs to be kept in high-pressure containers.
es.c: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，因此需要保存在高压容器内。

es.e: A small explosive device (= bomb ) was set off outside the UN headquarters today.
es.c: 今天有一枚小型炸弹在联合国总部外爆炸。

d: v  准备， 预备 to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future

es.e: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
es.c: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

d: v  加入十字军， 投身正义运动 to take part in a crusade；n 十字军；斗争，运动 a determined attempt to change something because you think you are morally right
vt  取代， 代替 to take the place of a person or thing so that they are no longer used, no longer in a position of power etc

es.e: Barker was soon supplanted as party leader.
es.c: 巴克在党内的领导地位很快就被人取代了。

d: n  外科医师 a doctor who does operations in a hospital

es.e: ...a heart surgeon.
es.c: …一位心脏外科医生。

d: adj  突然的， 意外的； 唐突的， 鲁莽的 sudden and unexpected

es.e: an abrupt change of plan
es.c: 计划的突然改变

d: vt  使泄气， 使灰心； 阻止， 劝阻 to make someone less confident or less willing to do something

es.e: You should not let one failure discourage you.
es.c: 你不该失败一次就灰心丧气。

d: v  事先影响某人； 易受感染

es.e: They take pains to hire people whose personalities predispose them to serve customers well.
es.c: 他们煞费苦心雇用那些具备把顾客服务好的个性的人。

d: adj  自发的， 自然产生的； 自然的， 无雕饰的 something that is spontaneous has not been planned or organized, but happens by itself, or because you suddenly feel you want to do it

es.e: The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer.
es.c: 人群自发地欢呼起来。

es.e: My spontaneous reaction was to run away.
es.c: 我的本能反应就是逃跑。

d: n  对流； 传送 the movement in a gas or liquid caused by warm gas or liquid rising, and cold gas or liquid sinking

es.e: ...clouds which lift warm, moist air by convection high into the atmosphere.
es.c: ...云层通过对流把温暖湿润的空气送到高的大气层中。

d: vt 使失事；破坏 to completely spoil something so that it cannot continue in a successful way；n  沉船； 失事 a ship that has sunk

es.e: Injury threatened to wreck his sporting career.
es.c: 伤病可能会毁了他的运动生涯。

es.e: It was drink that wrecked their marriage.
es.c: 是酒毁了他们的婚姻。

d: adj  闪光的；n 瞬间，一眨眼 very quickly

es.e: On a clear night, I could see stars twinkling in the sky.
es.c: 在晴朗的夜晚，我可以看见星星在天空闪烁。

es.e: Miss heart only stars know, heart desire only you know, when you see the stars twinkling in the sky, is my best wishes to you.
es.c: 思念的心只有星星知道，心中的愿望只有你知道，当你看见星星闪烁的夜空，就是我的祝福在向你致意。

d: adj  忧郁的， 令人沮丧的； 昏暗的， 阴暗的， 阴沉的 making you feel that things will not improve

es.e: The report paints a gloomy picture of the economy.
es.c: 这篇报告描绘了一幅惨淡的经济现状。

d: v&n  指责， 斥责， 批评 criticism, blame, or disapproval

es.e: ‘You don’t need me,’ she said quietly, without reproach.
es.c: “你不需要我。”她语气平静，没有丝毫责备。

d: n  关税， 进口税； 海关 Customs is the official organization responsible for collecting taxes on goods coming into a country and preventing illegal goods from being brought in

es.e: What right does Customs have to search my car?
es.c: 海关有什么权力搜查我的车？

d: n 授权，批准；许可证；委任状，执行令 a legal document that is signed by a judge, allowing the police to take a particular action；vt  保证， 担保； 使正当 to promise that something is true

es.e: The company issued warrants for 300,000 shares.
es.c: 那家公司发放了30万股的认股权证。

d: n  缘故， 理由； 好处

es.e: He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health.
es.c: 他为了健康而迁居海滨。

d: vt  隐蔽； 隐瞒； 覆盖 to hide something carefully

es.e: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
es.c: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

es.e: The path was concealed by long grass.
es.c: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

es.e: a concealed weapon
es.c: 藏匿的武器

d: adj 固体的；实心的；结实的，稳固的；可靠的；连续的 hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas；n  固体 a firm object or substance that has a fixed shape, not a gas or liquid

es.e: The lake was frozen solid .
es.c: 湖水冻得结结实实。

es.e: It was good to be back on solid ground again.
es.c: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

es.e: Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
es.c: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

d: adj  叙述性的；n 叙述；记叙体，叙述技巧 a description of events in a story, especially in a novel

es.e: The novel contains more narrative than dialogue.
es.c: 这部小说里的叙述比对话多。

es.e: If this story must be written, we must have the courage to eliminate all adjectives that tend to excite wonder: they would achieve the opposite effect, of impoverishing the narrative.
es.c: 如果必须要写这篇故事，我们必须要有勇气剔除易于激发我们想入非非的所有形容词：这些词会使叙述贫瘠无力，起到相反的效果。

d: vi  同时发生； 一致， 相符； 重合 to happen at the same time as something else, especially by chance

es.e: When our vacations coincided, we often holidayed together.
es.c: 我们的假期要是凑巧赶在一起，我们常常会一同去度假。

d: adj  圆形的， 环形的； 循环的； 绕行的 shaped like a circle

es.e: a circular table
es.c: 圆桌

d: vt 刮擦，划；抓，搔 to rub your skin with your nails because it feels uncomfortable；n  划痕； 挠痒 a small cut on someone’s skin

es.e: John yawned and scratched his leg.
es.c: 约翰打了个呵欠，挠了挠腿。

es.e: Try not to scratch.
es.c: 尽量别挠。

d: vt  需要； 要求， 命令 to need something

es.e: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
es.c: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

es.e: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
es.c: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

es.e: Most house plants require regular watering.
es.c: 大多数室内盆栽植物需要定期浇水。

d: adj 合作的，协作的；配合的 willing to cooperate；n  合作企业 a business or organization owned equally by all the people working there

es.e: He was doing his best to be cooperative.
es.c: 他在尽全力配合。

es.e: a cooperative witness
es.c: 肯配合的目击者

d: n  柳， 柳树； 柳木制品 a type of tree that has long thin branches and grows near water, or the wood from this tree
adj  肉体的， 身体的； 物质的； 实体的 relating to the body, rather than to the mind, feelings, or spirit

es.e: corporeal desires
es.c: 肉欲

d: adj  急躁的， 易怒的； 易受刺激的； 过敏的 getting annoyed quickly or easily

es.e: Jo was tired, irritable, and depressed.
es.c: 乔疲惫暴躁，而且情绪低落。

d: v 增至三倍 to increase by three times as much, or to make something do this；adj  三部分的； 三方的； 三倍的 having three parts or involving three groups, people, events etc

es.e: The company has tripled in size .
es.c: 这家公司的规模已扩大了两倍。

es.e: We expect to triple our profits next year.
es.c: 我们期望明年利润增加两倍。

d: n 脾气，性情 a tendency to become angry suddenly or easily；vt  缓和， 调节 to make something less severe or extreme

es.e: That temper of hers will get her into trouble one of these days.
es.c: 她那种脾气早晚会让她惹麻烦的。

es.e: According to Nathan, Robin has quite a temper .
es.c: 据内森讲，罗宾脾气很大。

es.e: Theo needs to learn to control his temper .
es.c: 西奥应该学会控制他的脾气。

d: adj  清楚的； 易读的 written or printed clearly enough for you to read

es.e: Her handwriting was so tiny it was barely legible.
es.c: 她的字写得这么小，简直都看不清楚。

d: v 发痒；使高兴，逗乐 if something touching your body tickles you, it makes you want to rub your body because it is slightly uncomfortable；n  痒 a feeling in your throat that makes you want to cough

es.e: Mommy, this blanket tickles.
es.c: 妈妈，这毛毯扎人。

es.e: Mazie’s fur collar was tickling her neck.
es.c: 马齐耶的毛领子扎得她脖子痒痒的。

d: adj  心脏的； 心脏病的 relating to the heart

es.e: cardiac surgery
es.c: 心脏手术

d: adj  易接近的； 可得到的； 可进入的 a place, building, or object that is accessible is easy to reach or get into

es.e: The island is only accessible by boat.
es.c: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

es.e: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.
es.c: 有座教堂离我家很近。

d: n  年龄歧视 unfair treatment of people because they are old

es.e: The problem of ageism in the workplace often goes unrecognized.
es.c: 工作场所的年龄歧视问题常被忽视。

es.e: The International Day of Older Persons is our chance to take a stand against the destructive problem of ageism.
es.c: 国际老年人日是我们采取立场，反对年龄歧视这一具有破坏性问题的机会。

d: n  悬崖， 峭壁 a large area of rock or a mountain with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river

es.e: The car rolled over the edge of a cliff.
es.c: 汽车翻下了悬崖边。

d: v 滚动，转动；卷，绕；摇摆，摇晃 if something rolls, especially something round, or if you roll it, it moves along a surface by turning over and over；n  卷； 卷形物； 名单， 花名册 a piece of paper, camera film, money etc that has been rolled into

es.e: His sleeves were rolled above his elbows.
es.c: 他的袖子卷到了胳膊肘的上面。

d: adj 值得注意的，明显的；显著的；著名的；重要的 important, interesting, excellent, or unusual enough to be noticed or mentioned；n  名人， 要人

es.e: Every country in the world signed the treaty, with one notable exception - the United States.
es.c: 全世界每个国家都签署了那份条约，只有一个国家反其道而行之，就是美国。

d: v  承认； 让步； 允许 to admit that something is true or correct, although you wish it were not true

es.e: ‘That’s the only possible solution.’ ‘Yes, I suppose so,’ Charles conceded.
es.c: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

d: adj  空前的， 无比的 bigger, better, or worse than anything else

es.e: an achievement unparalleled in sporting history
es.c: 体育史上空前的成就

d: v  蒸发； 消失， 不复存在 if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas

es.e: Most of the water had evaporated.
es.c: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

es.e: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
es.c: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

d: n  亮度， 发光度； 光明 The luminosity of a star or sun is how bright it is

es.e: For a few years its luminosity flared up to about 10,000 times the present-day luminosity of the Sun.
es.c: 有几年它的亮度一度达到了现在的太阳亮度的一万倍左右。

d: n 授权，委任；委员会；佣金，回扣 a group of people who have been given the official job of finding out about something or controlling something；vt  委托， 授权 to formally ask someone to write an official report, produce a work of art for y

es.e: The Government set up a commission to investigate allegations of police violence.
es.c: 政府成立了一个委员会调查对警察施暴行为的指控。

d: n  政策， 方针； 原则； 保险单 a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization

es.e: an insurance policy
es.c: 保险单

d: v  重新开始， 继续 to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted

es.e: She hopes to resume work after the baby is born.
es.c: 她想生完孩子后继续工作。

es.e: The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops.
es.c: 叛乱分子继续与政府军发生冲突。

d: adj  挑衅的， 煽动性的； 惹人讨厌的； 挑逗的 provocative behaviour, remarks etc are intended to make people angry or upset, or to cause a lot of discussion

es.e: a provocative act by a terrorist group
es.c: 恐怖团体的挑衅行为

es.e: She was accused of being deliberately provocative .
es.c: 她被指责故意挑衅。

d: v  作讲话； 写姓名地址 if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are sending it to；n 地址；讲话 the details of the place where someone lives or works, which you use to send them le

es.e: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
es.c: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

d: vi 盘旋；盘旋上升；急剧增长 to move in a continuous curve that gets nearer to or further from its central point as it goes round；adj 螺旋形的 Spiral is also an adjective；n  螺旋形； 螺旋式的上升 a line in the form of a curve that winds around a c

es.e: Crime has spiraled out of control .
es.c: 犯罪活动激增，已经失控。

es.e: ...a spiral staircase.
es.c: …一段旋梯。

d: adj  艺术的； 富有艺术性的， 精美的； 有艺术天赋的 relating to art or culture

es.e: artistic work
es.c: 艺术作品

es.e: Opinion about the artistic merit of his paintings has been mixed.
es.c: 对于他的绘画作品的艺术价值，人们褒贬不一。

d: vi 漫游；漫谈，闲聊 to go on a walk in the countryside for pleasure；n  漫步 a walk in the countryside for pleasure

es.e: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
es.c: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

d: n  职业； 使命感； 圣召 a strong belief that you have been chosen by God to be a priest or a nun

es.e: It could well be that he has a real vocation.
es.c: 他很可能有种真正的使命感。

d: v  停住， 停下 to stop moving；n 停止，阻止；暂停 a stop or pause

es.e: The parade halted by a busy corner.
es.c: 游行队伍在一个热闹的拐角处停下了。

d: v 投，掷，抛；丢，扔；使陷入，使处于；使困惑，使吃惊 to make an object such as a ball move quickly through the air by pushing your hand forward quickly and letting the object go；n  投， 掷， 抛； 投掷的距离 an action in which someone throws something

es.e: The bus stopped suddenly and we were all thrown forwards.
es.c: 公共汽车猛地停住，我们都往前栽。

d: n  日落， 傍晚 the time of day when the sun disappears and night begins

es.e: a glorious sunset
es.c: 壮丽的日落景象

d: n  身材， 身高； 地位， 声望， 名望 the degree to which someone is admired or regarded as important

es.e: He grew in stature (= became more admired or popular ) during the campaign.
es.c: 在这场宣传活动中，他的声望提高了。

d: adj  顽强的， 坚持不懈的； 顽固的， 固执的 dogged behaviour shows that you are very determined to continue doing something

es.e: a dogged determination to succeed
es.c: 不屈不挠的成功决心

d: n  血浆； 等离子体 the yellowish liquid part of blood that contains the blood cells

es.e: Now there are no gaps, so this is the state of matter, and this was the state of a plasma.
es.c: 现在没有任何间隙，这样这是物质的状态，而以前是一个等离子体状态。

es.e: Scientists think this plasma represents the state of the whole universe justmoments after it was born in the Big Bang, when the universe was extremely hotand dense.
es.c: 科学家认为这种等离子体代表整个宇宙在它出生的大爆炸之后瞬间的状态，那时的宇宙是非常炎热和致密的。

es.e: It receives only in lymph, it gives the emotion through the blood and the right current, what you call, through the nerve system, and it changes to be the same plasma the skin of the man or your nail.
es.c: 它只会在淋巴中接收，而通过血液和合适的电流来给予情感，也就是通过你们所说的神经系统，然后它就变成与你的皮肤或者指甲相同的等离子体。

d: adj  过高的， 不合理的 an exorbitant price, amount of money etc is much higher than it should be

es.e: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
es.c: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

d: n  外科手术； 外科学； 手术室， 诊疗室 medical treatment in which a surgeon cuts open your body to repair or remove something inside

es.e: Dr. Hanson is in surgery.
es.c: 汉森医生在手术室。

d: adj  暴力的； 感情强烈的， 激情的； 强烈的， 激烈的 involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

es.e: the increase in violent crime
es.c: 暴力犯罪的增多

es.e: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
es.c: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

es.e: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
es.c: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

d: adj  难达到的， 不可及的； 不能得到的 difficult or impossible to reach

es.e: In winter, the villages are inaccessible by road.
es.c: 冬天时，进入这些村子的路很难走。

d: v 解决；决定，决心；分解；显现 to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem or difficulty；n  决心， 决议 strong determination to succeed in doing something

es.e: Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems.
es.c: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

d: v  设计舞蹈动作， 编舞 to arrange how dancers should move during a performance

es.e: The show is very cleverly choreographed.
es.c: 这个节目的舞蹈动作设计得非常好。

d: vt  使面临， 使遭遇； 对抗 if a problem, difficulty etc confronts you, it appears and needs to be dealt with

es.e: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
es.c: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

d: adj  非语言的 not using words

es.e: nonverbal forms of communication
es.c: 非语言交际形式

d: vt  部署， 调度； 利用 to organize or move soldiers, military equipment etc so that they are in the right place and ready to be used

es.e: a job in which a variety of professional skills will be deployed
es.c: 要用到多项专业技术的工作

d: v  繁殖， 生育； 复制； 再现 if an animal or plant reproduces, or reproduces itself, it produces young plants or animals

es.e: The turtles return to the coast to reproduce.
es.c: 海龟回到岸上繁殖。

d: n  梗概， 提纲； 骨架， 骨骼； 框架 the most important parts of something, to which more detail can be added later

es.e: We agreed on a skeleton outline of the proposal.
es.c: 我们给提案商定了一个基本框架。

d: vi  聚集在一起， 挤作一团； 蜷缩， 缩成一团， 蜷缩 if a group of people huddle together, they stay very close to each other, especially because they are cold or frightened；n 挤在一起的人 a group of people or things that are close together, but not

es.e: We lay huddled together for warmth.
es.c: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

d: adj  句法的； 按照句法的 relating to syntax

es.e: syntactic structure
es.c: 句法结构

d: n  表演， 演唱； 提供， 给予； 翻译 someone’s performance of a play, piece of music etc

es.e: He gave a moving rendition of Lennon’s ‘Imagine’.
es.c: 他深情地演唱了列侬的《想象》。

d: n  交点； 十字路口， 道路交叉口 a place where roads, lines etc cross each other, especially where two roads meet

es.e: We crossed at a busy intersection.
es.c: 我们穿过了一个繁忙的道路交叉口。

d: n  奖学金； 学问， 学识 an amount of money that is given to someone by an educational organization to help pay for their education

es.e: Her latest publication is a fine piece of scholarship.
es.c: 她最新出版的作品是一部优秀的学术著作。

d: adj  无数的； 大量的 very many；n 无数；大量 a very large number of things

es.e: the myriad causes of homelessness
es.c: 导致人们无家可归的种种原因

d: adv  而且， 还有 used when adding another reason；prep 除…之外

es.c: 在救援任务中充当先锋的部队

d: n&v  改革， 改造， 革新； 改正， 改过自新 to improve a system, law, organization etc by making a lot of changes to it, so that it operates in a fairer or more effective way

es.c: 彻底改革税收制度的计划

d: adj  有角的， 尖角的； 消瘦的， 瘦骨嶙峋的 thin and not having much flesh on your bones

es.c: 又高又瘦的年轻男子

d: n  日光； 白昼 the light produced by the sun during the day

es.e: The park is open to the public during daylight hours .
es.c: 公园白天对公众开放。

es.e: If possible, it’s better to work in natural daylight.
es.c: 如果条件允许的话，最好在自然日光下工作。

d: n  讲坛， 讲台； 指挥台 a small raised area for a performer, speaker, or musical  conductor  to stand on

es.e: Unsteadily he mounted the podium, adjusted the microphone, coughed, and went completely blank.
es.c: 他摇摇晃晃地走上讲台，调好麦克风，咳嗽了几声，接着脑子就一片空白。

d: adj  二进制的； 二元的； 由两部分组成的 a system of counting, used in computers, in which only the numbers 0 and 1 are used

es.e: a binary star system
es.c: 双星系

d: vi  继而发生， 接着发生 to happen after or as a result of something

es.e: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
es.c: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

d: adj  疯狂的， 不理智的； 狂热的， 热衷的； 精神失常的 very strange or not sensible

es.e: The neighbours must think we’re crazy.
es.c: 邻居一定会认为我们疯了。

es.c: 那绝对是个荒唐的想法。

es.e: I know this idea sounds crazy , but it may be worth a try.
es.c: 我知道这个主意听起来很荒唐，但也许值得一试。

d: adj  用显微镜可见的； 极小的 extremely small and therefore very difficult to see

es.e: a microscopic speck of dust
es.c: 微小的尘粒

es.e: Inspectors discovered microscopic cracks in the hull of the submarine.
es.c: 检测人员发现潜艇的船身有细微的裂缝。

d: n  尊敬， 敬意 something you do to show respect for someone or something you think is important

es.e: The film pays homage to Martin Scorsese’s ‘Mean Streets’.
es.c: 该影片向马丁·斯科塞斯的《穷街陋巷》致敬。

d: n  青霉素， 盘尼西林 a type of medicine that is used to treat infections caused by  bacteria
vi  憔悴； 难过， 悲伤 to become sad and not continue your life as normal because someone has died or gone away；n 松树 a tall tree with long hard sharp leaves that do not fall off in winter

es.e: Six months after he left, she was still pining.
es.c: 他离开六个月了，她还是很悲伤。

d: n  启发， 教化， 启迪； [the E-]启蒙运动 Enlightenment means the act of enlightening or the state of being enlightened

es.e: Stella had a moment of enlightenment.
es.c: 斯特拉恍然大悟。

d: n  反话， 讽刺， 嘲弄； 具有讽刺意味的事 a situation that is unusual or amusing because something strange happens, or the opposite of what is expected happens or is true

es.e: Life is full of little ironies.
es.c: 生活中充满了小小的讽刺。

d: n 强制的，法定的，义务的； 受托人； 代理人
n  毛毛虫 a small creature like a  worm  with many legs that eats leaves and that develops into a  butterfly  or other flying insect

es.e: I saw a caterpillar on the leaf.
es.c: 我看见一条毛毛虫在叶子上。

es.e: The caterpillar might well give you nightmares though!
es.c: 但是，它的毛虫却可能引起你噩梦！

es.e: The caterpillars grow. This caterpillar is big and fat.
es.c: 这毛虫渐渐成长。这个毛虫是大的和肥的。

d: n  超文本 a way of writing computer documents that makes it possible to move from one document to another by  clicking  on words or pictures, especially on the Internet

es.e: ...information embroidered with colourful graphics and tied together by hypertext links.
es.c: …饰以彩色图表并用超文本链接组合在一起的信息。

d: n  基础， 根基； 基岩 the basic ideas, features, or facts on which something is based

es.e: Marriage and children are the bedrock of family life.
es.c: 婚姻和子女是家庭生活的基础。

d: n  综合征； 典型表现 an illness which consists of a set of physical or mental problems – often used in the name of illnesses

es.e: people who suffer from irritable bowel syndrome
es.c: 患有肠道过敏综合征的人

d: n  新闻纸 cheap paper used mostly for printing newspapers on

es.e: ...a newsprint warehouse.
es.c: …一个新闻纸货仓。

es.c: 那艘轮船不得不被拖进港口。

d: n 泛音；

es.e: And the researchers say our brains might like these chords because their frequencies resemble those of a single harmonic note.
es.c: 研究人员表示，我们的大脑喜欢这些和弦，可能是因为这些频率与一个单谐波音符类似。

d: v 拖，拖运 to pull something heavy with a continuous steady movement；n  拖， 拉， 拖运； 一次获得的数量； 旅行的距离 the amount of fish caught when fishing with a net

es.e: the steam locomotive which hauled the train
es.c: 拖动火车的蒸汽机车

es.e: I hauled the door shut behind me.
es.c: 我用力拽上了门。

d: adj  精力充沛的， 积极的 having or needing a lot of energy or determination

es.e: an energetic man
es.c: 精力旺盛的男子

es.e: an energetic drive to get more customers
es.c: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

d: v 缝被；缝制 If you quilt, or if you quilt a piece of fabric, you make a quilt；n  被褥 a warm thick cover for a bed, made by sewing two layers of cloth together, with feathers or a thick material in between them

es.e: Maggie knows how to quilt.
es.c: 玛吉知道怎样缝被子。

es.e: Quilting a bed cover can be laborious.
es.c: 缝制一个床罩会很费力的。

d: adj  第一的， 首要的； 最著名的 best or most important；n 首相，总理 a  prime minister  – used in news reports

es.e: one of Dublin’s premier hotels
es.c: 都柏林最好的酒店之一

d: adj  过敏的， 变态反应的； 对…讨厌的 having an allergy

es.e: an allergic reaction to nuts
es.c: 对坚果的过敏性反应

d: n  海洋学者

es.e: In 1904 Johannes Schmidt, a young Danish oceanographer and biologist, got a job aboard the Thor, a Danish research vessel, studying the breeding habits of food fishes such as cod and herring.
es.c: 年轻的丹麦海洋学家兼生物学家乔纳斯·施密特在丹麦研究船“托尔”号上找到一份工作，研究食用鱼（如鳕鱼和鲱鱼）的繁殖习性。

d: n  秘闻； 轶事， 趣闻 a short story based on your personal experience

es.e: The book is full of amusing anecdotes about his life in Japan.
es.c: 这本书里全是他在日本生活的趣闻轶事。

d: adj  爱发号施令的， 爱指手画脚的 too eager to tell people what to do – used to show disapproval

es.e: an officious traffic warden
es.c: 一名爱发号施令的交通督导员

d: v  渗入， 渗透； 悄悄进入， 潜入 to secretly join an organization or enter a place in order to find out information about it or harm it

es.e: Police attempts to infiltrate neo-Nazi groups were largely unsuccessful.
es.c: 警方想打入新纳粹团体的行动基本上不成功。

d: vi  辅修；adj 较小的；次要的 small and not very important or serious, especially when compared with other things；n 未成年人；辅修科目 someone who is below the age at which they become legally responsible for their actions

es.e: What are your major subject and minor subject?
es.c: 你的主修科目和辅修科目是什么?。

d: adj  不友好的， 敌意的； 敌方的 angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them

es.e: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
es.c: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

es.e: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
es.c: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

es.e: his hostile attitude
es.c: 他敌对的态度

d: n  植物群 all the plants that grow in a particular place or country

es.e: Tourism is damaging the flora and fauna (= plants and animals ) of the island.
es.c: 旅游业正在破坏该岛的动植物资源。

d: adj  天空的， 天上的 relating to the sky or heaven

es.e: ...the clusters of celestial bodies in the ever-expanding universe.
es.c: …不断扩展的宇宙中的这些天体群。

d: vt  译， 解， 破译 to discover the meaning of a message written in a  code (= a set of secret signs or letters )

es.e: The software decodes the information embedded in the satellite broadcasts.
es.c: 这种软件能够解读衞星广播中的信息。

es.e: She fell off her bike and bruised her knee.
es.c: 她从自行车上摔下来，擦伤了膝盖。

d: v 缓慢行进；爬行 to move along on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground；n  缓慢的速度 Crawl is also a noun

es.e: The floor was crawling with ants.
es.c: 地板上爬满了蚂蚁。

es.e: The traffic on the off-ramp slowed to a crawl.
es.c: 驶出匝道的交通慢得在爬进。

d: adj  相同的； 同一的 exactly the same, or very similar

es.e: four identical houses
es.c: 四幢一模一样的房子

d: adj  未受协助的， 独立的 without help

es.e: She can no longer walk unaided.
es.c: 她再也不能独力行走了。

d: adj  有雄心的， 有野心的 determined to be successful, rich, powerful etc

es.c: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

es.c: 他没有学历。

es.c: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

es.c: 你的嘴唇就像是波斯王国的弯弓，那是一张涂上朱砂的弯弓，那是一张头上镶嵌珊瑚的弯弓。

es.e: I believe they are doing a good job with that. How about the coral? Is it really as beautiful as they say?
es.c: 我相信他们是在做好事。对了，珊瑚怎么样？它们真的就像人们说的那么漂亮吗？

es.c: 她的双腿现在已经丧失正常功能了。

es.e: You know I can’t function (= cannot perform normal activities ) without a coffee in the morning.
es.c: 你知道的，我早上不喝杯咖啡就无法工作。

es.c: 你能把灯举高点好让我看清吗？

es.e: William raised his hat and smiled at her.
es.c: 威廉抬一抬帽子，朝她笑了笑。

es.e: Raise your hand if you know the right answer.
es.c: 知道正确答案的话，请举手。

d: n  行为不良； 过失， 失职 illegal or immoral behaviour or actions, especially by young people

es.e: the ever-rising statistics of delinquency and crime
es.c: 青少年违法犯罪不断增加的统计数字

es.e: villages with no piped water
es.c: 没有管道供水的乡村

es.c: 伊莎贝尔温顺地依偎在他怀中。

es.e: her pliant lips
es.c: 她温软的嘴唇

d: vt  尊敬， 敬畏 to respect and admire someone or something very much

es.e: The Chinese revered corn as a gift from heaven.
es.c: 中国人将谷物奉为天赐礼物。

es.c: 民意调查员向一些有代表性的纽约居民征询了意见。

es.c: 鬼鬼祟祟的小把戏

es.c: 这个镇位于东经12度。

es.c: 一只蓝色的鸽子蹲坐在一堵墙上。

es.c: 顾名思义，鸽子式是一个很棘手的姿势，它对于我来说是最有挑战性的。

es.c: 最重要的是，如果眼见事故就要发生，无论是在开车还是在公司，一定要学野鹅那样大声叫出来，千万别像鸽子似的小声嘀咕。

d: adj  懒散的； 不严格的， 马虎的 not strict or careful enough about standards of behaviour, work, safety etc

es.c: 其中一个问题是对机场人员的安全措施不严格。

d: n  比较， 对比； 比拟， 比喻 the process of comparing two or more people or things

es.e: Her paintings invite comparison with those of the early Impressionists (= they remind you of them ) .
es.c: 她的画作让人想起早期的印象派作品。

d: v  产； 放置； 铺； 筹划， 设置； 提出， 提交 to put someone or something down carefully into a flat position

es.c: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

es.e: They laid a wreath at the place where so many people died.
es.c: 他们在这么多人丧生的地方放了一个花圈。

es.e: Lay the material flat on the table.
es.c: 把布料平铺在桌上。

es.e: The eggs take three days to hatch.
es.c: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

d: n  爱国者 someone who loves their country and is willing to defend it – used to show approval

es.c: 有人指出创建者并非真正的爱国者，而是一些维护自己利益的人。

d: adj  有害的， 恶性的 very harmful or evil, often in a way that you do not notice easily

es.e: the pernicious effects of poverty
es.c: 贫穷的危害性

es.e: the media’s pernicious influence
es.c: 媒体的有害影响

es.c: 杰克逊说她的老板变得越来越抑郁，又重新大量吸烟了。

es.c: 夫妻间的同居义务是夫妻其他权利与义务的基础。

es.e: Or maybe it's about spending more time together if you're not at the cohabitation stage yet.
es.c: 或者如果你们还没有到同居的阶段，或许只是花时间在一起的问题。

es.c: 更多的第二次婚姻比第一次更差。伴随更多同居被接受，为什么要再婚？为什么要再冒险那个噩梦？

es.c: 食草动物的牙齿大部分是臼齿，通常没有犬齿。

es.e: Some examples of heavy herbivore pressure may help appreciation of the possible brevity of the selection process .
es.c: 植食动物强大压力的一些事例可以帮助我们对选择过程的简略性有所了解。

es.e: Kangaroo is a herbivore, eating a variety of plants, fungi and some food.
es.c: 袋鼠是食草动物，吃多种植物，有的还吃真菌类。

d: adj  接替的， 继承的； 接连的， 连续的 coming or following one after the other

es.c: 这支球队已经连胜五场了。

es.e: Successive governments have tried to deal with this issue.
es.c: 历届政府都试图解决这个问题。

d: n  奇遇； 冒险活动 an exciting experience in which dangerous or unusual things happen

es.e: a great adventure
es.c: 一大奇遇

es.e: Ahab’s adventures at sea
es.c: 亚哈的海上历险

es.e: an adventure story
es.c: 一个历险故事

d: n  典礼， 仪式； 礼节 an important social or religious event, when a traditional set of actions is performed in a formal way

es.e: a wedding ceremony
es.c: 婚礼

es.e: the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games
es.c: 奥运会开幕式

d: v  改善， 改进， 增进； 好转， 进步 to make something better, or to become better

es.e: a course for students wishing to improve their English
es.c: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

es.e: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
es.c: 医生说她正在康复。

es.e: You could use the money for improving your home.
es.c: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

d: adj  田园诗般的， 田园风光的， 牧歌的

es.e: This idyllic pastoral scene is only part of the picture.
es.c: 但这种田园诗般的乡村风光仅仅是一个侧面。

es.e: Some believe that lemurians were much more like early humans living in a sort of idyllic paradise largely agrarian with lush forests and an abundance of flowers and fruit trees.
es.c: 一些就相信利莫里亚更加像早期的人类，生活在一种田园诗般的天堂里，主要地与繁荣的森林，盛开的花朵和结果的树在一起。

es.e: I don't mind a bit of idiosyncrasy, but that strange ideology you believe in , coupled with your idyllic ideas on life, suggest to me that all you're doing is looking for some idol to follow.
es.c: 你有一点特殊的癖性我不在乎，但你相信的那种奇怪的意识形态，加上你向往田园诗般生活的想法，给我的印象是你在做的就是要找到一个偶像来效仿。

d: n 鹰，隼；主战分子 a large bird that hunts and eats small birds and animals；vt  叫卖， 兜售 to try to sell goods, usually by going from place to place and trying to persuade people to buy them

es.e: Oil thieves sometimes hawk stolen gasoline on the side of highways.
es.c: 石油大盗们有时在公路边上兜售偷来的石油。

d: n  硅 a chemical substance that exists as a solid or as a powder and is used to make glass, bricks, and parts for computers. It is a chemical element: symbol Si

es.e: But the brittleness of silicon limits its uses.
es.c: 但是，硅的脆性也限制了其应用范围。

es.e: They consist of silicon, sand and metal so there's no any connection to dinosaurs … Besides, we may see corrosion on some of them.
es.c: 它们是由硅砂和金属构成的，和恐龙蛋没有任何关系……除此之外，我们还能看到它们上面的腐蚀的部分。

es.e: Because silicon, the main component of semiconductors, breaks down at about 200 degrees Fahrenheit , some experts believe a new material will be needed in a decade or so.
es.c: 因为半导体的主要成分硅在大约华氏200度就会破裂。 一些专家认为大约十年后将需要一种新的材料。

d: n  硅酸盐 one of a group of common solid mineral substances that exist naturally in the Earth

es.e: Beryl is a beryllium-aluminum silicate, and its color comes from small amounts of chromium.
es.c: 绿宝石其实是一种铍铝硅酸盐，而它的颜色则来自于微量的铬元素。

es.e: This artist's concept illustrates how silicate crystals like those found in comets can be created by an outburst from a growing star.
es.c: 这幅艺术构想图说明了在彗星中发现的硅酸盐晶体是如何在生长中的恒星的喷发中生成的。

es.e: One question that has baffled planetary scientists is how oceans formed on the surface of terrestrial planets like Earth -- rocky planets made of silicate and metals.
es.c: 一个困扰着行星科学家的问题是：海洋是怎样在像地球这样由硅酸盐和金属组成的石质行星的表面形成的？

d: n 基金，专款；储备，蕴藏； an amount of money that is collected and kept for a particular purpose；vt  为…提供资金 to provide money for an activity, organization, event etc

es.e: The fund was set up to try to save the cathedral.
es.c: 设立基金以挽救大教堂。

d: n  重力； 严重性； 严肃， 庄严 the force that causes something to fall to the ground or to be attracted to another  planet

es.e: the force of gravity
es.c: 重力

d: n  接受者， 收受者 someone who receives something

es.e: ...the largest recipient of U.S. foreign aid.
es.c: …最大的美国对外援助接受方。

d: vt  施催眠术； 使入迷， 迷住 if you are mesmerized by someone or something, you cannot stop watching them or listening to them because they are so attractive or have such a powerful effect

es.e: The first time I saw Diana I was mesmerized by her beauty.
es.c: 我第一次见到戴安娜就被她的美貌迷住了。

d: vt 给…提供资金 to provide money, especially a lot of money, to pay for something；n 财政，金融； the management of money by governments, large organizations etc

es.e: The concerts are financed by the Arts Council.
es.c: 音乐会由艺术协会出资举办。

d: vt 隐藏，藏匿 to store something secretly or safely somewhere；n  贮藏物 an amount of something that is kept in a secret place, especially money, weapons, or drugs

es.e: We went for the bottle of whisky that we had stashed behind the bookcase.
es.c: 我们去取那瓶我们藏在书柜后面的威士忌。

d: n  机动车停放； 停车场 the act of parking a car or other vehicle

es.e: No Parking (= used on signs )
es.c: 禁止停车

es.c: 45英镑的违章停车罚款

d: n  工作室， 画室； 摄影室， 演播室， 录音室； 练习室； 电影公司 a room where television and radio programmes are made and broadcast or where music is recorded

es.e: a TV studio
es.c: 电视演播室

es.e: a recording studio in Nashville
es.c: 在纳什维尔的一间录音室

d: vt  招致， 招惹， 遭受 if you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done

es.e: The government had also incurred huge debts.
es.c: 政府也已承受了大笔债务。

d: adv 向下，往下 If you want to emphasize that a statement applies to everyone in an organization, you can say that it applies from its leader downward；adj  向下的 moving or pointing towards a lower position

es.e: ...from the president downward.
es.c: …自总经理而下。

d: adj  微胖的； 丰满的 slightly fat in a fairly pleasant way – used especially about women or children, often to avoid saying the word ‘fat’

es.e: The nurse was a cheerful plump woman.
es.c: 那护士是个性格开朗、体形丰满的女人。

es.e: The baby’s nice and plump.
es.c: 那个婴儿很可爱，胖嘟嘟的。

d: adv  并列地， 并排地 to walk, ride etc next to each other, all facing the same way

es.e: As the car drew abreast of him, Jack suddenly recognised the driver.
es.c: 那辆车追上来与杰克并行时，他一下子就认出了驾车的人。

d: vi 弹回；后退，退缩；产生后坐力 to move back suddenly and quickly from something you do not like or are afraid of；n  后退， 退缩； 反冲， 后坐力

es.e: We recoil in horror from the thought of subjecting someone to extreme pain.
es.c: 想到要让一个人经受极度的痛苦，我们就会恐惧地退缩。

d: v  管理， 控制； 调整， 调节； 校准 to control an activity or process, especially by rules

es.e: strict rules regulating the use of chemicals in food
es.c: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

d: adj  交互式的； 合作的， 互相配合的 an interactive computer program, television system etc allows you to communicate directly with it, and does things in reaction to your actions

es.e: interactive computer systems
es.c: 交互式电脑系统

es.e: the museum’s interactive exhibits
es.c: 博物馆的互动展品

d: adj  倦怠的， 没精打采的 feeling tired and not interested in things

es.e: The heat was making me listless.
es.c: 炎热的天气使我懒洋洋的。

d: n  腺 an organ of the body which produces a substance that the body needs, such as hormones, sweat, or saliva

es.e: the pituitary gland
es.c: 脑垂体腺

d: adj  补充的； 互补的 complementary things go well together, although they are usually different

es.e: The computer and the human mind have different but complementary abilities.
es.c: 电脑与人脑各不相同，却又互为补充。

d: n  浓度， 密度； 一致性， 协调； 连接， 结合 the quality of always being the same, doing things in the same way, having the same standards etc – used to show approval

es.e: She scores goals with remarkable consistency.
es.c: 她以非凡的连贯性进球得分。

d: n  折磨； 严峻考验

es.e: He was beginning to wonder if he would survive the ordeal.
es.c: 他开始怀疑自己能否熬过这场磨难。

d: n  灵长类， 灵长目动物； 大主教 a member of the group of animals that includes humans and monkeys

es.c: 绒毛蛛猴是美洲最大的灵长目动物。

d: adj  成束的； 纤细的

es.e: The white floodlight shines through the wispy tule and makes thin shadows.
es.c: 白色的灯光透过一缕缕的湖藨草，投下纤细的影子。

d: n  房屋和地基， 经营场址； 前提， 假设 the buildings and land that a shop, restaurant, company etc uses

es.c: 学校通过出租房屋场地可以获取额外收入。

es.e: business premises
es.c: 企业经营场所

d: vt  聚居于， 大批生长于； 开拓殖民地， 移居于 to establish political control over an area or over another country, and send your citizens there to settle

es.e: a dead tree that has been colonized by ants
es.c: 被蚂蚁占据的一棵死树

d: n  季节； 时节； 时期 one of the main periods into which a year is divided, each of which has a particular type of weather. The seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter

es.e: the effect on plants as the seasons start to change
es.c: 换季对植物的影响

d: adj  引起争论的， 有争议的 causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed

es.e: the controversial issue of welfare reform
es.c: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

es.e: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
es.c: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

es.e: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
es.c: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

d: vt  达到； 获得 to succeed in achieving something after trying for a long time

es.e: More women are attaining positions of power.
es.c: 越来越多的女性获得要职。

d: n 房客，承租人 someone who lives in a house, room etc and pays rent to the person who owns it；vt  居住

es.e: The desk was left by the previous tenant.

d: n  画廊， 美术馆 a large building where people can see famous pieces of art

es.c: 海沃德美术馆的非洲艺术展览

d: n  恢复； 整修， 修复； 复位， 复原； 归还 when you repair something such as an old building or a piece of furniture, so that it looks the same as when it was first built or made

es.e: Major restoration work will begin in May.
es.c: 大规模的修复工作将在5月开始。

d: vi  变得苍白， 变得暗淡 if your face pales, it becomes whiter than usual because you have had a shock；adj 苍白的；淡色的；暗淡的，微弱的 having a skin colour that is very white, or whiter than it usually is

es.e: Kent’s face paled when he saw that Rob had a knife.
es.c: 肯特看到罗布拿着把刀子，顿时面无血色。

d: n  五金制品， 金属制品； 硬件 computer machinery and equipment, as opposed to the programs that make computers work

es.e: ...a shop from which an uncle had sold hardware and timber.
es.c: …一家叔叔曾经在那里卖五金器具和木材的店铺。

d: v 连续猛击 to hit someone or something many times, in a way that hurts or damages them；n  击球手； 面糊 a mixture of flour, eggs, milk etc, used in cooking and for making bread, cakes etc

es.c: 他被殴打致死。

es.e: As a child, she was battered by her father.
es.c: 她小时候遭受过父亲的殴打。

d: n  不幸的人； 恶棍， 无赖 someone that you feel sorry for

es.e: He was a lonely, miserable wretch.
es.c: 他是一个孤独的可怜虫。

d: n  优先权， 优先； 优先考虑的事， 最重要的事 the right to be given attention first and before other people or things

es.e: I want to start work on the garden but the house must take priority .
es.c: 我想开始整修花园，不过还是先得打扫屋子。

es.e: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
es.c: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

es.e: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
es.c: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

d: adj  有创造力的， 创造性的 involving the use of imagination to produce new ideas or things

es.e: This job is so boring. I wish I could do something more creative.
es.c: 这工作太单调了，我希望能做些更有创造性的事情。

es.e: I teach creative writing at Trinity College.
es.c: 我在三一学院教创意写作。

es.e: the creative process of writing a poem
es.c: 写诗的创作过程

d: n  神话； 神话学； 虚幻的想法 set of ancient myths

es.e: characters from classical mythology
es.c: 古典神话中的人物

d: v 穿梭往返；短程往返运送 to travel frequently between two places；n  航天飞机； 梭子； 航班 a  space shuttle

es.e: The passengers were shuttled to the hotel by bus.
es.c: 旅客由班车送到酒店。

d: vt  分配， 分派， 把…拨给 to use something for a particular purpose, give something to a particular person etc, especially after an official decision has been made

es.e: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
es.c: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

d: n  硬面包圈 a small ring-shaped type of bread

es.c: 设想经济是一家百吉饼面包店正挣扎着度过一个低潮期。

d: adj  最初的； 首要的； 基本的 most important

es.e: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
es.c: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

es.c: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

es.e: Personal safety is of primary importance .
es.c: 人身安全至关重要。

d: n 原木，木材；日志，航海日志，飞行日志 a thick piece of wood from a tree；vt  记录； 伐木 to make an official record of events, facts etc

es.c: 原木燃烧的熊熊大火

d: n  企业， 公司； 事业 a company, organization, or business

es.c: 银行和食品制造厂等商业企业

es.c: 我看不到通风设备，连窗户或至少一个通风扇也没有。

es.c: 基地内的任何地方都没有单一的玻璃窗格，而且唯一的机械通风设备安装在了画廊中。

d: adj  太阳的， 日光的； 太阳能的 relating to the sun

es.c: 日食

es.c: 我们现在对行星形成过程的早期阶段有了更多的了解。

es.c: 在理论上，精神分析是一门关于无意识心理的哲学；在实践上，它又是一种治愈心理紊乱的方法。

es.c: 说起著名的心理学家，人们可能会想到西格蒙德弗洛伊德（如图），这位满脸大胡子的奥地利学者提出了精神分析的概念。

es.e: For the woman, her love can turn a frog into a beautiful man, while for the man love reduces the woman to what psychoanalysis calls a "partial object", that in you which makes me desire you.
es.c: 对女人而言，她的爱可以让一只青蛙变成一位英俊的男性，而对男人来说，他的爱则把女人降低为了精神分析所谓的“部分客体”，在你身上使我欲望你的东西。

d: n  双语现象 Bilingualism is the ability to speak two languages equally well

es.e: I recently had the pleasure of conducting an interview with him on bilingualism, translation, and interpreting.
es.c: 我最近有幸就双语教育，笔译和口译方面的有关问题对他进行了一次采访。

es.e: The scientists who studied this were motivated by earlier studies which showed that bilingualism enhances mental abilities in both children and older adults.
es.c: 科学家研究它的动机其实来源于早先的研究，这些研究显示了，双语能增强孩子和大人的大脑的能力。

d: n  能力， 胜任； 权限； 技能 the ability to do something well

es.c: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

es.c: 他们的音乐融合了卡津音乐、博普爵士乐和古巴华尔兹等不同元素。

es.c: 法院不鼓励随意上诉。

es.c: 他会以这样或那样的理由打电话的。

d: adj  突现的； 新兴的； 紧急的 An emergent country, political movement, or social group is one that is becoming powerful or coming into existence

es.e: ...an emergent state.
es.c: ...一个新兴国家。

es.e: ...an emergent nationalist movement.
es.c: ...一次新兴民族主义运动。

d: vt  确保； 使确信 to tell someone that something will definitely happen or is definitely true so that they are less worried

es.c: 我能向你保证，这文件是真的。

es.c: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

d: n  基金， 资金； 提供资金 Funding is money which a government or organization provides for a particular purpose

es.e: They hope for government funding for the programme.
es.c: 他们希望得到政府为这一计划提供的资金。

es.c: …使4名小学生在冰冷的海洋中挣扎求生超过4个小时的一连串事件。

es.c: 他在心脏搭桥手术中活了下来。

d: adj 开始的，最初的 happening at the beginning；n  词首大写字母 the first letter of someone’s first name

es.c: 5,000英镑的初始投资

es.c: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

d: adj  未充分发展的， 原始的； 基本的， 基础的 a rudimentary knowledge or understanding of a subject is very simple and basic

es.c: 他的老对手

es.c: 他无法接受的是假定人权标准在不同文化和地区有所不同。

es.c: …像蚜虫那样大肆侵害谷类作物的害虫。

d: adj  讽刺的， 嘲讽的

es.c: 梁缨早期的作品当中的意境饱含对中产及以上阶级的讽刺与挖苦，例如描绘桃树下或花园中散步的女人。

es.e: They researched the satiric art completely in "The Informal History of Intellectuals " on several aspects: the reason, the significance, the principle and the techniques.
es.c: 他们从运用讽刺手法的原因、目的、原则以及讽刺技法的使用等方面对《儒林外史》的讽刺艺术进行了全面的分析。

d: adj  永恒的， 不朽的 continuing for ever and having no end

es.c: 基督教承诺的永生

es.c: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

es.c: 她把手中的纸揉成了一团。

d: n  讽刺文学， 讽刺作品； 讽刺 a way of criticizing something such as a group of people or a system, in which you deliberately make them seem funny so that people will see their faults

es.e: the characteristic use of satire in Jonson’s work
es.c: 琼森作品中讽刺手法的独到运用

d: adj  流行的， 普遍的 common at a particular time, in a particular place, or among a particular group of people

es.e: the prevalent belief in astrology
es.c: 对占星术的普遍相信

d: vi  附着， 黏住； 紧紧抓住； 挨近 to hold someone or something tightly, especially because you do not feel safe

es.e: Some children tend to cling on their first day at school.
es.c: 有些小孩在上学第一天往往会有恋家的情绪。

d: v 夹住，扣住；修剪；剪下 to fasten something together or to be fastened together using a clip；n  夹子， 回形针， 别针； 弹夹， 弹仓； 电影片段， 剪报 a small metal or plastic object that holds or fastens things together

es.e: a stack of bills clipped together
es.c: 夹在一起的一沓钞票

d: n  绿洲； 避风港 a place with water and trees in a desert

es.e: The immaculately tended gardens are an oasis in the midst of Cairo's urban sprawl.
es.c: 那些打理得非常整洁的花园是杂乱扩张的开罗市区中的一片绿洲。

d: adj  滋养的， 有营养的；n 滋养物，营养品 a chemical or food that provides what is needed for plants or animals to live and grow

es.e: To examine the global impact of acidification, the researchers developed a series of world maps to show current coal use, nutrient consumption, and copper production and smelting by country.
es.c: 为检验酸性化过程对全球的影响，研究者们描绘出一系列世界地图来展示近期煤炭利用、营养消费和铜矿生产、冶炼的国家。

d: adj 紧凑的；简洁的 packed or put together firmly and closely；vt  压缩 to press something together so that it becomes smaller or more solid

es.e: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
es.c: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

d: vt 宣布…为非法 to completely stop something by making it illegal；n  罪犯， 歹徒， 亡命之徒； 被剥夺法律权益者 someone who has done something illegal, and who is hiding in order to avoid punishment – used especially about criminals in the past

es.e: The bill would have outlawed several types of guns.
es.c: 这项法案将全面禁用几种枪支。

d: vt  灌溉； 冲洗 to supply land or crops with water

es.e: The water in Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.
es.c: 包尔湖的水被用来灌溉该地区。

d: v  枯萎 if something shrivels, or if it is shrivelled, it becomes smaller and its surface becomes covered in lines because it is very dry or old

es.e: The leaves change colour, then shrivel.
es.c: 树叶变了颜色，然后干枯了。

d: v  在表面形成硬壳， 结壳； 用…装饰外层 to cover or overlay with or as with a crust or hard coating
n  高涨； 激增 a sudden strong feeling

es.e: ...the upsurge in oil prices.
es.c: …油价的暴涨。

d: n 坝，堤 a special wall built across a river or stream to stop the water from flowing, especially in order to make a lake or produce electricity；vt  筑坝； 控制 to stop the water in a river or stream from flowing by building a s

es.e: Before the dam was built, Campbell River used to flood in the spring.
es.c: 大坝建好之前，坎贝尔河常在春季发大水。

d: v  开花 if a plant or a flower blooms, its flowers appear or open；n 花；开花；青春焕发 a flower or flowers

es.e: These plants bloom in spring.
es.c: 这些植物在春天开花。

es.e: They bloom for a month and fade away in no time.
es.c: 它们开花为一个月的时间和逐渐消失很快。

es.e: We noticed that these women began to bloom into greater self-confidence and even to shed unhealthy relationships. At that point we knew we were onto something big.
es.c: 我们注意到，这些妇女开始开花到更大的自信，甚至摆脱不健康的关系。在这一点上，我们知道我们正在做一件大事。

d: v  表示， 意指； 标示， 预示， 象征 to mean something

es.e: What does the word ‘curriculum’ denote that ‘course’ does not?
es.c: curriculum一词的哪些含义是course没有的？

d: vt 将…划做特殊区域；分区，划分地带 if an area of land is zoned, it is officially kept separate from other land so that it can be used for a particular purpose；n  地区， 地域， 地带； 气候带 a large area that is different from other areas around it

es.e: The land is currently zoned for residential use.
es.c: 这片土地目前被划为住宅用地。

d: adj  听得见的 a sound that is audible is loud enough for you to hear it

es.e: His voice was barely audible (=  could only just be heard  ) above the roar of the crowd.
es.c: 人声嘈杂，几乎听不见他的说话声。

d: vt  劝告， 规劝， 告诫 If you exhort someone to do something, you try hard to persuade or encourage them to do it

es.e: Kennedy exhorted his listeners to turn away from violence.
es.c: 肯尼迪劝告他的听众要远离暴力。

es.e: He exhorted his companions, "Try to accomplish your aim with diligence."
es.c: 他勉励他的同志，“尝试以勤奋来实现目标。”

d: v  繁殖； 散布， 传播 to spread an idea, belief etc to many people

es.e: The group launched a website to propagate its ideas .
es.c: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

d: adj  格子花纹的； 棋盘状的 Something that is checked has a pattern of small squares, usually of two colours

es.e: He was wearing blue jeans and a checked shirt.
es.c: 他穿着蓝色牛仔裤和一件格子衬衫。

d: vt  需要， 使成为必要 to make it necessary for you to do something

es.e: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
es.c: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

d: adj  传统的； 正统的 orthodox ideas, methods, or behaviour are accepted by most people to be correct and right

es.e: orthodox medical treatments
es.c: 传统疗法

es.e: He challenged the orthodox views on education.
es.c: 他对传统的教育观念提出了质疑。

d: n  劫掠， 掠夺， 破坏 an act of taking or destroying something

es.e: Much of the region's environmental depredation is a result of poor planning.
es.c: 这个地区的环境破坏大都是规划不周的结果。

d: n  结合， 混合； 化合； 组合 two or more different things that exist together or are used or put together

es.e: a combination nightclub and café
es.c: 夜总会兼咖啡馆

d: n&vt  埋伏， 伏击 a sudden attack on someone by people who have been hiding and waiting for them, or the place where this happens

es.e: The soldiers were killed in an ambush.
es.c: 那些士兵遭伏击身亡。

es.e: In winter the danger of ambush is much reduced.
es.c: 冬天，遭伏击的危险大大减少。

d: n  〈总称〉首饰； 珠宝
v  获得； 通用， 流行 to get something that you want, especially through your own effort, skill, or work

es.e: These conditions no longer obtain.
es.c: 这些状况已不复存在。

d: n  政治家 a political or government leader, especially one who is respected as being wise and fair

es.e: a respected elder statesman
es.c: 一位受人尊敬的政界元老

d: v 成四倍 to increase and become four times as big or as high, or to make something increase in this way；adj 四部分组成的；四倍的 four times as big or as many；n  四倍

es.e: Food prices quadrupled during the war.
es.c: 战争期间食品价格翻了两番。

es.e: The company has quadrupled its profits in just three years.
es.c: 公司利润在短短三年里增长至原来的四倍。

d: adj 熟练的，精通的，内行的 good at something that needs care and skill；n  行家， 熟手

es.e: I’m afraid she’s also an adept liar.
es.c: 恐怕她还是一个撒谎专家。

d: n  好奇心， 求知欲； 罕见而有趣之物， 珍品 the desire to know about something

es.e: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
es.c: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

es.e: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.
es.c: 这条消息在当地人中间引起了很大的好奇心。

es.e: She decided to follow him out of curiosity .
es.c: 她出于好奇决定跟踪他。

d: v 称为，认为；n  名声， 名誉 reputation

es.e: Under his leadership, the U.N.'s repute has risen immeasurably.
es.c: 在他的领导下，联合国的名望得到了极大提升。

d: adj  敏捷的， 灵活的 able to move quickly and easily with light neat movements

es.e: nimble fingers
es.c: 灵巧的手指

es.e: a nimble climber
es.c: 敏捷的攀登者

d: adj  可爱的； 友好的， 和蔼的， 亲切的 friendly and easy to like

es.e: The driver was an amiable young man.
es.c: 司机是位友善的年轻人。

es.e: She was in an amiable mood.
es.c: 她心情很好。

d: n 设计，安排；格式，样式 the way in which something such as a television show or meeting is organized or arranged；vt  使格式化 to organize the space on a computer  disk  so that information can be stored on it

es.e: The courses were run to a consistent format.
es.c: 这些课程的编排是有连续性的。

d: v 牺牲，献出；以…做祭献 to willingly stop having something you want or doing something you like in order to get something more important；n  牺牲， 献身； 献祭， 祭品 when you decide not to have something valuable, in order to get something t

es.e: The priest sacrificed a chicken.
es.c: 牧师献祭了一只鸡。

d: adj 特定的；独特的；详细的；挑剔的 a particular thing or person is the one that you are talking about, and not any other；n  详情， 细目 the facts and details about a job, property, legal case etc

es.e: In this particular case, no one else was involved.
es.c: 这件事没有其他人牵涉其中。

es.e: Most students choose one particular area for research.
es.c: 大多数学生选择一个特定领域进行研究。

es.e: a particular type of food
es.c: 某一类食品

d: n  军团， 兵团； 特种部队； 一群人， 一组人 a group in an army with special duties and responsibilities

es.e: the medical corps
es.c: 医疗部队

es.e: the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
es.c: 美国陆军工程兵部队

d: n&v  中止， 暂停 to stop speaking or doing something for a short time before starting again

es.e: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
es.c: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

d: adj  正规的， 正式的； 形式的 made or done officially or publicly

es.e: formal recognition of the reformed church
es.c: 改革后的教会所获得的官方承认

es.e: a formal agreement between the countries
es.c: 两国间的正式协议

es.e: There is no formal structure for negotiating pay increases.
es.c: 加薪谈判没有正式的框架可循。

d: n  彩虹 a large curve of different colours that can appear in the sky when there is both sun and rain

es.e: ...silk and satin in every shade of the rainbow.
es.c: …如彩虹般五颜六色的丝绸与锦缎。

d: n  导师， 讲师； 教练， 指导员 someone who teaches a sport or practical skill

es.e: a driving instructor
es.c: 驾驶教练

es.e: ski instructors
es.c: 滑雪教练

d: n  热情， 热烈

es.e: He took up the cause with evangelical fervor .
es.c: 他以传道者般的热情投身于这一事业。

es.e: The cathedral at Chartres is an expression of the religious fervor of the Middle Ages.
es.c: 在查特雷斯的大教堂是中世纪时期宗教热情的表现之一。

es.e: As social conflicts continue tosharpen, the party needs to divert attention, and of course a parade is a goodway to do that by whipping up nationalist fervor.
es.c: 随着社会冲突继续深化，中共需要转移人们的注意力，而阅兵就是实现这一点的好办法，可以激起人们的民族主义热情。

d: adj  富足的， 充足的， 丰富的； 宽敞的 more than enough

es.e: an ample bosom
es.c: 丰满的胸部

d: n  内聚力； 凝聚力； 团结， 结合 if there is cohesion among a group of people, a set of ideas etc, all the parts or members of it are connected or related in a reasonable way to form a whole

es.e: a sense of community and social cohesion
es.c: 社区意识和社会凝聚力

d: v  招待， 款待； 使快乐， 娱乐 to invite people to your home for a meal, party etc, or to take your company’s customers somewhere to have a meal, drinks etc

es.e: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
es.c: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

es.e: Do you get an allowance for entertaining clients?
es.c: 你招待客户有补助吗？

d: v  缓和， 减轻 if something unpleasant eases, or if you ease it, it gradually improves or becomes less；n 不费力，容易；悠闲，自在 if you do something with ease, it is very easy for you to do it

es.e: measures to ease congestion in the city
es.c: 改善城市拥堵状况的措施

es.e: Her breathing had eased.
es.c: 她的呼吸平缓下来。

d: n  调味品 a powder or liquid, such as salt or  ketchup  , that you use to give a special taste to food

es.e: Friendship is not only the condiment but also the anodyne of life.
es.c: 友谊是人生的调味品，也是人生的止痛药。

d: n  确定， 确信； 必然性 the state of being or feeling certain about something
v 超过，溢出；泛滥；横行 if unwanted things or people overrun a place, they spread over it in great numbers；n  泛滥； 超出的部分 Overrun is also a noun

es.e: The final speaker overran by at least half an hour.
es.c: 最后一名发言人至少超时半小时。

d: adj  欺骗性的， 导致误解的 intended to make someone believe something that is not true

es.e: misleading and deceptive adverts
es.c: 误导人且带有欺骗性的广告

es.e: deceptive practices
es.c: 欺骗行为

d: n  数学 the science of numbers and of shapes, including  algebra  ,  geometry  , and  arithmetic

es.e: ...a professor of mathematics at Boston College.
es.c: …一位波士顿大学的数学教授。

d: n  反应堆 a  nuclear reactor

es.e: Where do you all live? Do you live near a reactor?
es.c: 你们都住在哪，你们接近一个反应堆吗？

es.e: Then you have, in terms of the barrier integrity, reactor cooling systems activity, cladding failure.
es.c: 然后你们会有，在屏障完整性，反应堆冷却系统行为，覆盖层失效。

es.e: For almost three years, AECL went through its calculations, but nothing changed: if its model of how the reactor functioned was correct, the PCR should be negative.
es.c: 在将近三年中，AECL仔细检查了枫叶的计算过程，但结果仍然如此：如果它的反应堆运行模式无误，那么PCR就应该是负值。

d: n  野外烧烤宴会 a party or occasion when a meal is cooked and eaten outdoors

es.e: a cookout on the beach
es.c: 海滩上的露天烧烤

d: vt  想象， 展望， 预想 to imagine something that you think might happen in the future, especially something that you think will be good

es.e: I envisioned a future of educational excellence.
es.c: 我展望了一个有着优质教育的未来。

d: n  大声疾呼， 强烈的抗议 an angry protest by a lot of ordinary people

es.e: The closure of the local hospital has caused a huge public outcry.
es.c: 当地医院的关闭激起了大规模的公众抗议。

d: v  刺穿； 渗透； 洞察 to enter something and pass or spread through it, especially when this is difficult

es.e: bullets that penetrate thick armour plating
es.c: 穿过厚装甲的子弹

es.e: Sunlight barely penetrated the dirty windows.
es.c: 阳光几乎照不进那些肮脏的窗户。

d: v  用桨划船； 涉水， 戏水 to move a small light boat through water, using one or more paddles；n 桨；桡足 a short pole that is wide and flat at the end, used for moving a small boat in water

es.e: children paddling in the sea
es.c: 在海边蹚水嬉戏的孩子们

d: vt  重新计划， 重订…的时间表 to arrange for something to happen at a different time from the one that was previously planned

es.e: Since I'll be away, I'd like to reschedule the meeting.
es.c: 既然我将要离开，我想重新安排一下这次会议的时间。

d: adj 主要的，最重要的 most important；n  校长； 资本； 主角 someone who is in charge of a school

es.e: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
es.c: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

es.e: Teaching is her principal source of income.
es.c: 教书是她主要的收入来源。

es.e: the principal character in the book
es.c: 书里的主人公

d: v  趋于， 易于； 照料， 看护 to look after someone or something

es.e: Sofia was in the bedroom tending to her son.
es.c: 索菲娅在卧室里照料她的儿子。

d: adj  昏暗的； 忧郁的

es.e: In the somber archives of a sedate museum a large archaic volume is somewhat conspicuously displayed.
es.c: 在一个平静的博物馆中昏暗的档案室里，一本厚厚的古书被摆在了很显著的位置。

es.e: Her 71-year-old husband, looking somber and composed, was brought into the church in a wheelchair and did not speak at the service.
es.c: 凯西71岁高龄的丈夫被人用轮椅推进教堂，看起来沉默忧郁，在葬礼仪式上也没有发言。

es.e: Don't ignore it because it makes you laugh — director Paul Feig's 2011 hit deserves as much respect as any somber, wintry, subtitled drama.
es.c: 不要因为它让你开怀大笑而忽略了它——总监保罗·法伊格在2011年引起的这场轩然大波与其他任何忧郁、寒冷、次要的戏剧一样值得尊重。

d: n  同义词 a word with the same meaning as another word in the same language

es.e: The term "industrial democracy" is often used as a synonym for worker participation.
es.c: “工业民主”这一词语常被用作“工人参与”的同义词。

d: adj  公平的， 公正的 treating all people in a fair and equal way

es.e: an equitable distribution of food supplies
es.c: 所供应食品的合理分配

d: adj  不引人瞩目的， 不显眼的 not easily seen or noticed

es.e: an inconspicuous little restaurant
es.c: 一家不起眼的小饭店

es.e: She stood by the wall, trying to look inconspicuous.
es.c: 她贴墙站着，尽量不引人注目。

d: n  标本， 样本； 范例； 抽样 a small amount or piece that is taken from something, so that it can be tested or examined

es.e: a blood specimen
es.c: 血样

d: adj  外来的， 来自异国的； 奇异的 something that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country – use this to show approval

es.e: exotic birds
es.c: 外国的奇异鸟类

es.e: exotic places
es.c: 有异国风情的地方

d: n  缓解， 减轻， 轻松； 援救， 救济； 宽慰； 浮雕 a feeling of comfort when something frightening, worrying, or painful has ended or has not happened

es.e: I felt a huge surge of relief and happiness.
es.c: 我如释重负，大感欣慰。

es.e: No one was hurt, and we all breathed a sigh of relief .
es.c: 没有人受伤，我们都松了一口气。

d: vt  联合抵制， 拒绝购买 to refuse to buy something, use something, or take part in something as a way of protesting

es.e: We boycott all products tested on animals.
es.c: 我们抵制所有拿动物做试验的产品。

d: n  介绍； 传入， 引进； 导言， 绪论 the act of formally telling two people each other’s names when they first meet

es.e: Pete, are you going to make the introductions?
es.c: 皮特，你来作一下介绍吧。

es.e: Our first contestant needs no introduction (= everyone already knows the person ).
es.c: 我们的第一位参赛者就不用介绍了。

d: v  订购， 订阅； 申请， 预订； 捐助， 赞助 to pay money, usually once a year, to have copies of a newspaper or magazine sent to you, or to have some other service

es.e: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
es.c: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

d: n  治疗， 疗法 the treatment of an illness or injury over a fairly long period of time

es.e: new drug therapies
es.c: 新的药物疗法

es.e: radiation therapy for cancer treatment
es.c: 治疗癌症的放射疗法

d: n  染色体 a part of every living cell that is shaped like a thread and contains the  gene s  that control the size, shape etc that a plant or animal has

es.e: Do we have a chromosome like that?
es.c: 那么我们真的有那么一条染色体么？

es.e: She is part of the chromosome of Kolkata.
es.c: 她就是加尔各答染色体的一部分。

es.e: The distances are additive along the length of the chromosome .
es.c: 其距离值就是沿着染色体长度方向的累加。

d: n  专注， 专心； 浓度， 含量； 集中， 聚集 the ability to think about something carefully or for a long time

es.e: She needed all her powers of concentration to stop herself from slipping on the icy road.
es.c: 她需要集中全部注意力才能不让自己在结冰的路上滑倒。

es.e: Lack of concentration was a real problem.
es.c: 注意力不集中是个大问题。

es.e: I lost my concentration and fell asleep.
es.c: 我精神一放松就睡着了。

d: n  速度， 速率； 迅速 the speed of something that is moving in a particular direction

es.e: the velocity of light
es.c: 光速

es.e: The speedboat reached a velocity of 120 mph.
es.c: 快艇的时速达到了120英里。

es.c: 高速子弹

d: n  友谊； 奖学金； 团体， 协会 a feeling of friendship resulting from shared interests or experiences

es.c: 经常外出游玩可以增进同事之间的友谊。

d: n  同事， 同僚 someone you work with – used especially by professional people

es.c: 她和几位同事讨论了这个想法。

d: adj  未装饰的， 朴实的 without unnecessary or special features or decorations

es.c: 他们希望他们的教堂朴素无华。

es.c: 桑切斯的供词在法庭上宣读了出来。

es.c: 我得承认，我喜欢布兰妮•斯皮尔斯的音乐。

es.c: 我的儿媳说我多管闲事，但我只是想帮忙。

d: n  公寓套房； 房间 a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives

es.c: 她住在一套小公寓里。

d: vt  忍受； 容许， 承认 to allow people to do, say, or believe something without criticizing or punishing them

es.c: 我们决不容许有自行惩办犯罪的组织出现在我们的街头。

d: v  堆积， 堆放 If you stack a number of things, you arrange them in neat piles；n 堆 a neat pile of things

es.e: Mrs. Cathiard was stacking the clean bottles in crates.
es.c: 卡提亚夫人当时正在把干净的瓶子堆放到板条箱里。

d: v  憎恶， 愤恨， 怨恨 If you resent someone or something, you feel bitter and angry about them

es.e: She resents her mother for being so tough on her.
es.c: 她恨她的妈妈对她如此苛刻。

d: adj  似火的； 易怒的， 暴躁的 becoming angry or excited very quickly

es.e: He has a fiery temper .
es.c: 他脾气火爆。

d: v 模拟，模仿 to pretend to play or sing a piece of music, without making any sound；n  喜剧； 哑剧； 哑剧演员； 模拟表演 the use of movements to express what you want to say without using words, or a play where the actors use only movements

es.c: 儿童通过角色表演、舞蹈和哑剧来学习。

es.e: They will perform a short mime later.
es.c: 稍后他们将表演一个哑剧小品。

es.e: a professional mime artist
es.c: 专业的哑剧表演艺术家

d: adj  不明确的， 模棱两可的 something that is ambiguous is unclear, confusing, or not certain, especially because it can be understood in more than one way

es.c: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

es.c: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

d: n  国会， 议会 the group of people who are elected to make a country’s laws and discuss important national affairs

es.c: 他们要求议会自由和新闻自由。

d: vt  减轻， 减少 to make someone feel less afraid, worried etc

es.c: 总统发表了一项声明以缓解公众的忧虑。

d: n  道路； 路线； 小路， 小径 a track that has been made deliberately or made by many people walking over the same ground

es.c: 我提心吊胆地沿着花园的小道向前门走去。

es.c: 草地上被踏出的小径

es.c: 沿着河边的小路走到那座桥。

es.e: Don’t put boiling water in the glass or it will crack.
es.c: 不要把沸水倒进这个玻璃杯里，否则它会破裂的。

es.c: 在严寒的天气条件下混凝土可能会开裂。

es.c: 他捡起一块石头，把它击碎成两半。

es.c: 他对自己9岁的儿子十分溺爱。

es.c: 我们正在从各个能想到的角度对问题进行讨论。

d: n  立方体； 立方形的东西； 立方 a solid object with six equal square sides

es.c: 一块方糖

es.c: 一小方块冰

es.e: Cut the meat into small cubes.
es.c: 把肉切成丁。

es.c: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。

es.c: ...一片高大的红杉树林。

d: v  影响； 冲击， 撞击 to have an important or noticeable effect on someone or something；n  影响； 冲击， 撞击 the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something

es.c: 除非能对人们造成影响，否则这样的计划意义不大。

d: adj  轻微的； 温和的； 随和的 fairly warm

es.c: 每年夏天开着汽车堵塞道路的游客

es.c: 这条大街从来没有铺过，深泥使其在冬天无法通行。

es.c: 人脑缺氧只需4分钟就会造成永久性损伤。

es.c: 地球沿椭圆形轨道运动。

d: adj 赤裸的；光秃的，无遮盖的；最基本的 not covered by clothes；vt  脱掉； 显露

es.e: a ragged child with bare feet
es.c: 一个衣衫褴褛、光着脚的小孩

es.e: She felt the sun warm on her bare arms.
es.c: 她感觉到阳光照在她裸露双臂上的暖意。

d: n  人行道 a hard surface or path at the side of a street for people to walk on

es.e: She walked along the sidewalk.
es.c: 她沿着人行道走着。

es.e: We stopped the pudgy kid in the middle of the sidewalk and surrounded him.
es.c: 我们在人行道的中间挡住了这个小胖墩儿的去路，将他围住。

es.e: Then we precarious moved on toward the sidewalk, where she pulled my face down to hers, kissed me on both cheeks, and then limped away, still smiling and waving back to me.
es.c: 这时，我们蹒跚地向人行道走去，她把我的脸拉向她的脸，在我两颊上各吻了一下，然后一瘸一拐地离开了，还不时地回头向我微笑和挥手。

d: adj  难对付的； 强大的； 令人敬畏的 very powerful or impressive, and often frightening

es.e: The building is grey, formidable, not at all picturesque.
es.c: 那幢建筑呈灰色，气势凛然，与漂亮沾不上边。

es.e: The new range of computers have formidable processing power.
es.c: 该系列的新型计算机处理能力惊人。

d: vi  富于； 大量存在； 充满 to exist in very large numbers

es.e: Rumours abound as to the reasons for his resignation.
es.c: 有关他辞职的原因有各种各样的谣传。

es.e: Examples of this abound in her book.
es.c: 这样的例子在她书中比比皆是。

d: n  手提箱， 衣箱 a large case with a handle, used for carrying clothes and possessions when you travel

es.e: It did not take Andrew long to pack a suitcase.
es.c: 安德鲁没有用多长时间就整理好了手提箱。

d: vt  使倒转， 使倒置， 使颠倒 to put something in the opposite position to the one it was in before, especially by turning it upside down (= the bottom is on the top and the top is on the bottom )

es.e: Invert the cake onto a serving plate.
es.c: 把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

d: adj  分离的， 个别的； 离散的 clearly separate

es.e: The change happens in a series of discrete steps.
es.c: 这个变化在一系列分离的步骤中发生。

d: adj  气候温和的， 温带的； 温和的， 自我克制的 behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible

es.e: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
es.c: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。

d: adj  不可改变的， 永恒不变的 never changing or impossible to change

es.e: This decision should not be seen as immutable.
es.c: 不该把这个决定看成是不可改变的。

d: vt  使中断； 扰乱； 使分裂， 使瓦解 to prevent something from continuing in its usual way by causing problems

es.e: Traffic was disrupted by a hoax bomb.
es.c: 有人虚报有炸弹，造成了交通混乱。

es.e: Climate change could disrupt the agricultural economy.
es.c: 气候变化可能给农业经济带来不良影响。

d: vt 给…留下疤痕；给…留下精神创伤；损害…的外观 if a wound or cut scars you, it leaves a permanent mark on your body；n  疤痕； 创伤 a permanent mark that is left on your skin after you have had a cut or wound

es.e: His hands were badly scarred by the fire.
es.c: 他的双手被那次大火烧得疤痕累累。

es.e: She will probably be scarred for life .
es.c: 她有可能留下永久的疤痕。

d: v  夭折， 中止； 使流产 to deliberately end a  pregnancy  when the baby is still too young to live

es.e: The rescue mission had to be aborted.
es.c: 救援任务不得不停止。

d: adj  假设的 based on a situation that is not real, but that might happen

es.e: The question is purely hypothetical .
es.c: 这个问题完全基于假设。

d: n  系数 the number by which an unknown quantity is multiplied

es.e: In 8pq, the coefficient of pq is 8.
es.c: 在8pq中pq的系数为8。

d: vi 交谈，会话 to have a conversation with someone；adj 逆向的，相反的 opposite；n  相反的事物； 反面 the converse of a fact, word, statement etc is the opposite of it

es.e: It lets me converse with the distinct voices of my past and quilt together a narrative about movement in place.
es.c: 它让我能够用可以彰显我的过去的独特声音与人交谈，并拼凑出一通有关地点变换的叙述。

es.e: From outside, from those who you love, converse, and make community with, telling you that you belong with them, if only you will give up those annoying, unacceptable parts, please.
es.c: 来自外界，来自那些你爱的、与你谈话的、与你团结在一起并告诉你你属于他们的人，只要你将放弃那些恼人的、无法接受的部分。

d: n  准则， 信条； 绝对真理； [G-]福音； 福音音乐； 训示 one of the four books in the Bible about Christ’s life

es.e: the Gospel according to St Luke
es.c: 路加福音

d: adj  古怪的， 反常的 behaving in a way that is unusual and different from most people；n 古怪的人 someone who behaves in a way that is different from what is usual or socially accepted

es.e: His eccentric behaviour lost him his job.
es.c: 他古怪的行为使他丢了工作。

es.e: Aunt Nessy was always a bit eccentric.
es.c: 内西姑妈总是有点古怪。

d: n  用具， 器具； 装置 a piece of equipment, especially electrical equipment, such as a  cooker  or  washing machine  , used in people’s homes

es.e: He could also learn to use the vacuum cleaner, the washing machine and other household appliances.
es.c: 他还能学习使用吸尘器、洗衣机和其他家用电器。

d: n  合金 a metal that consists of two or more metals mixed together；vt  使成合金 to mix one metal with another

es.e: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
es.c: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

d: v  推迟， 延期 to delay something until a later date

es.e: The committee deferred their decision .
es.c: 委员会延期作出决定。

d: adj  昏昏欲睡的； 催眠的 tired and almost asleep

es.e: The drug can make you drowsy.
es.c: 这种药会让人昏昏欲睡。

d: n  学问， 学识； 传说， 传统 knowledge or information about a subject, for example nature or magic, that is not written down but is passed from person to person

es.e: According to local lore, a ghost still haunts the castle.
es.c: 根据当地人的传说，城堡里至今仍然闹鬼。

d: n  船桅； 旗杆； 天线塔 a tall pole on which the sails or flags on a ship are hung

es.e: a radio mast
es.c: 无线电发射塔

d: adj  大量的 involving or intended for a very large number of people；n 质量；块，团；众多；群众，平民百姓 all the ordinary people in society who do not have power or influence

es.e: a mass protest
es.c: 大规模的抗议

es.e: weapons of mass destruction
es.c: 大规模杀伤性武器

es.e: the problem of mass unemployment
es.c: 大批人失业的问题

d: adj  闷热的 muggy weather is unpleasantly warm and the air seems wet

es.e: It was muggy and overcast.
es.c: 那天天气闷热又潮湿，阴沉沉的。

d: vt  撤销， 撤回； 取消， 废除 to officially state that a law, decision, or agreement is no longer effective

es.e: Their work permits have been revoked.
es.c: 他们的工作许可证被吊销了。

d: adj  正确的； 合乎体统的， 适当的； 固有的， 特有的 right, suitable, or correct

es.e: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
es.c: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

es.e: the proper way to clean your teeth
es.c: 正确的刷牙方法

es.e: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
es.c: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

d: n  [the R-] 文艺复兴， 文艺复兴时期； 复兴， 再生 a new interest in something, especially a particular form of art, music etc, that has not been popular for a long period

es.e: ...the Renaissance masterpieces in London's galleries.
es.c: …伦敦美术馆里文艺复兴时期的杰作。

d: adj  有毒的， 有害的； 恶毒的 containing poison or producing poison

es.e: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
es.c: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

es.e: poisonous gases such as hydrogen sulfide
es.c: 硫化氢等有毒气体

es.e: poisonous substances
es.c: 有毒物质

d: n&v  拍卖 a public meeting where land, buildings, paintings etc are sold to the person who offers the most money for them

es.e: The painting is expected to fetch up to $400,000 at auction.
es.c: 这幅画预计在拍卖会上能卖到40万美元。

d: vt  分配， 配给， 拨给 to use a particular amount of time for something, or give a particular share of money, space etc to someone or something

es.e: The seats are allotted to the candidates who have won the most votes.
es.c: 这些席位被分配给了赢得了最多选票的候选人。

d: vt  推进， 驱使； 激励 to move, drive, or push something forward

es.e: a boat propelled by a small motor
es.c: 由小马达驱动的小船

es.e: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
es.c: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

d: v  承认； 准许…进入， 接纳 to agree unwillingly that something is true or that someone else is right

es.e: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
es.c: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

es.e: I must admit , I didn’t actually do anything to help her.
es.c: 我必须承认，实际上我并没有帮她什么忙。

es.e: Admit it! I’m right, aren’t I?
es.c: 承认吧！我对了，是不是？

d: adj  猖獗的， 肆虐的； 蔓生的 if something bad, such as crime or disease, is rampant, there is a lot of it and it is very difficult to control

es.e: Pickpocketing is rampant in the downtown area.
es.c: 闹市区扒窃活动猖獗。

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["rampant inflation"]}
es.c: 失控的通货膨胀

d: n 兴趣，关注；业余爱好；利息；利害关系 if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them；vt  使感兴趣， 引起…关注 to make someone want to pay attention to something and find out more about it

es.e: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
es.c: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

es.e: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
es.c: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

es.e: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
es.c: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

d: adj  不平均的； 不平坦的； 不规则的； 不势均力敌的； 不公平的 not smooth, flat, or level

es.e: She walked back carefully over the uneven ground.
es.c: 她小心翼翼地从凹凸不平的地面上走回来。

d: n  嫩枝， 小枝 a small very thin stem of wood that grows from a branch on a tree

es.e: There is the bird, sitting on a twig halfway up the tree.
es.c: 鸟儿在那里，栖息在树中段的一根细枝上。

d: adj  未成熟的， 未充分发展的 not fully formed or developed

es.e: measures to protect immature whales
es.c: 保护幼鲸的措施

d: adj  有机的； 器官的； 有机体的 relating to farming or gardening methods of growing food without using artificial chemicals, or produced or grown by these methods

es.e: Organic farming is better for the environment.
es.c: 有机耕作对环境更有利。

es.e: organic gardening
es.c: 有机园艺

d: adj  贞洁的； 简朴的， 朴实的 not having sex with anyone, or not with anyone except your husband or wife

es.e: She led a chaste decent life.
es.c: 她过着贞洁正派的生活。

d: n 面具；面罩；假面具， something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it

es.e: a surgical face mask
es.c: 外科手术口罩

es.e: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing masks .
es.c: 他被两个蒙面人袭击并抢劫。

d: n  撤离

es.e: I ordered the evacuation of all Americans and sent troops to guarantee their safety.
es.c: 我下令撤离所有的美国人，并派部队去保证他们的安全。

es.e: The impact of evacuation and relocation on those with health or functional impairments can be tremendous .
es.c: 撤离和重新安置对这些健康状况欠佳或身体残疾的人影响极大。

d: n  资助人， 赞助人； 老主顾， 顾客 someone who supports the activities of an organization, for example by giving money

es.e: a wealthy patron
es.c: 富有的赞助人

d: v  申请， 请求； 适用； 应用， 运用； 涂， 敷， 施 to make a formal request, usually written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something

es.e: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
es.c: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

d: v  炖， 煨； 思考； 不安， 担忧 to cook something slowly in liquid；n 炖菜；不安，担忧

es.e: stewed apples
es.c: 炖苹果

d: vt  俯瞰， 眺望； 忽略； 对…不予考虑 to not notice something, or not see how important it is

es.e: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
es.c: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

es.e: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
es.c: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

d: adj  惊人的， 难以置信的 too strange to be believed, or very difficult to believe

es.e: It’s incredible that he survived the fall.
es.c: 他跌下去竟然能够生还，真不可思议。

es.e: It’s incredible how much Tom has changed since he met Sally.
es.c: 自从遇见萨莉后，汤姆的变化之大简直令人难以置信。

es.e: I find it almost incredible that no one noticed these errors.
es.c: 没人发现这些错误，真让我无法相信。

d: n  编排， 版面设计； 规划， 布局 the way in which something such as a town, garden, or building is arranged

es.e: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
es.c: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

d: n  登陆； 着陆， 降落 the action of bringing an aircraft down to the ground after being in the air

es.e: take-off and landing procedures
es.c: 起降程序

es.e: the Apollo Moon landings
es.c: 阿波罗宇宙飞船登月

d: n  公式， 方程式； 分子式； 配方 a series of numbers or letters that represent a mathematical or scientific rule

es.e: the formula for calculating distance
es.c: 计算距离的公式

es.e: Sugar is represented by the simple formula CHO.
es.c: 糖以简单的分子式CHO表示。

d: n&v  雪崩； 山崩 a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls down the side of a mountain

es.e: Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
es.c: 两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

d: v 反叛，反抗；违抗；厌恶，反感 if people revolt, they take strong and often violent action against the government, usually with the aim of taking power away from them；n  起义， 叛乱， 反抗 a refusal to accept someone’s authority or obey rules

es.e: He was revolted by the smell.
es.c: 那气味让他恶心。

d: vt  厌恶， 嫌恶 To disgust someone means to make them feel a strong sense of dislike and disapproval

es.e: He disgusted many with his boorish behaviour.
es.c: 他以其粗鲁的行为使许多人感到厌恶。

d: n  贡品； 颂词， 称赞； 悼念， 致哀； 礼物 something that you say, do, or give in order to express your respect or admiration for someone

es.e: The players wore black armbands as a tribute to their late teammate.
es.c: 球员们戴着黑纱悼念已故的队友。

es.e: I’d like to pay tribute to (= praise and admire publicly ) the party workers for all their hard work.
es.c: 我谨向党内工作人员致敬，感谢他们的辛苦努力。

d: vt  危及， 危害 to put someone or something in danger of being hurt, damaged, or destroyed

es.e: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
es.c: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

d: adj  卑鄙的， 不道德的 not having good moral principles；vt 把设在； to have your main place of work, business etc in a particular place

es.e: base attitudes and desires
es.c: 卑鄙的态度和欲望

d: vt 阻止，遏制；起源 to stop something from happening, spreading, or developing；n  茎， 干 the long thin part of a plant, from which leaves, flowers, or fruit grow

es.e: A tight bandage should stem the bleeding.
es.c: 扎紧绷带可以止血。

d: adj 次要的；下级的 in a less important position than someone else；vt  使处于次要地位， 使从属于 to put someone or something in a less important position；n  部属， 下属 someone who has a lower position and less authority than someone else in an

es.e: a subordinate officer
es.c: 下级官员

d: n  趋势， 倾向 a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing

es.e: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
es.c: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

es.e: the general trend towards the centralization of political power
es.c: 政治权力集中化的普遍趋势

es.e: A disturbing trend is that victims of violence are getting younger.
es.c: 一个令人担心的趋势是，暴力行为的受害者越来越年轻。

d: n  技工， 机修工 someone who is skilled at repairing motor vehicles and machinery

es.e: a garage mechanic
es.c: 汽车修理厂的技工

d: n  革命； 巨变； 旋转 a complete change in ways of thinking, methods of working etc

es.e: the French Revolution of 1789
es.c: 1789年法国大革命

d: adj  可靠的， 可信赖的 someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on

es.e: a birth control method that is cheap and reliable
es.c: 既便宜又可靠的避孕方法

es.e: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
es.c: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

d: n  刺激； 动机 something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc

es.e: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
es.c: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

d: v  叙述， 讲述； 有关联 if two things relate, they are connected in some way

es.e: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
es.c: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

d: adj 预备的，初步的 happening before something that is more important, often in order to prepare for it；n  初步做法， 起始行为

es.e: the preliminary stages of the competition
es.c: 竞赛的预赛阶段

es.e: a preliminary draft
es.c: 初稿

d: n  障碍， 妨害物 something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing

es.e: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
es.c: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

es.e: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
es.c: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

es.e: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
es.c: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

d: adj  剩余的 remaining after all the rest has been used, taken, or eaten

es.e: leftover vegetables
es.c: 吃剩的蔬菜

es.e: a few pieces of leftover carpet
es.c: 剩余的几块地毯

d: adj  合作的， 协作的 a job or piece of work that involves two or more people working together to achieve something

es.e: ...a collaborative research project.
es.c: …一个合作研究项目。

d: v  组成； 设立； 制定 if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it

es.e: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
es.c: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

d: vt  控诉， 起诉， 控告 to officially charge someone with a criminal offence

es.e: He was later indicted on corruption charges.
es.c: 他后来被控贪污。

d: n  送急件的人， 信使； 旅游服务员 A courier is a person who is paid to take letters and packages direct from one place to another

es.e: ...a motorcycle courier.
es.c: …一名骑摩托车的信使。

d: vt  使确信， 说服 to make someone feel certain that something is true

es.e: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
es.c: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

d: v  交配 if animals mate, they have sex to produce babies；n 配偶；朋友，伙伴；同事；大副 someone you work with, do an activity with, or share something with

es.e: Rabbits can be mated as early as six months old.
es.c: 兔子在六个月大时就可以交配了。

d: v 狂奔，涌向；使仓促行事 to be made frightened or worried so that you do something too quickly, without thinking enough about it；n  逃窜， 狂奔； 热潮， 风尚 when a group of large animals or people suddenly start running in the same direction

es.e: a herd of stampeding buffalo
es.c: 一群狂奔的水牛

d: v 狼吞虎咽 If you gorge on something or gorge yourself on it, you eat lots of it in a very greedy way；n  山峡， 峡谷 a deep narrow valley with steep sides

es.e: I could spend each day gorging on chocolate.
es.c: 我可以将每一天都花在狂吃巧克力上。

d: v  停止， 结束 if something terminates, or if you terminate it, it ends
