es.e: He was an early proponent of the theory that life on Earth may have come from Mars in rocks ejected by asteroid and comet impacts.
es.c: 他是这项理论早期的支持者：地球生命也许来自火星，通过小行星和彗星冲撞而由岩石喷射而出。

es.e: Moving on through the asteroid belt we enter the realms of the gas giant planets: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, all of which dwarf the Earth.
es.c: 穿过小行星带继续前进，我们进入了气体巨行星区域：木星、土星、天王星、海王星，所有这些都使地球看起来像个侏儒。

d: adj  普通的， 平凡的；n 平凡的事；老生常谈 something that has been said so often that it is no longer interesting or original

es.e: Car thefts are commonplace in this part of town.
es.c: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

d: vt 诽谤 to write or print a libel against someone；n  诽谤； 诽谤性文字 when someone writes or prints untrue statements about someone so that other people could have a bad opinion of them

es.e: The newspaper which libelled him had already offered compensation.
es.c: 那家诽谤他的报纸已经提出赔偿。

d: n  参量， 参数； 界限， 范围 a set of fixed limits that control the way that something should be done

es.e: The inquiry has to stay within the parameters laid down by Congress.
es.c: 调查必须局限于国会设定的范围之内。

d: adj  灭绝的， 不存在的； 不再活跃的 an extinct type of animal or plant does not exist any more

es.e: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
es.c: 恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。

es.e: Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
es.c: 熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。

es.e: an extinct species
es.c: 已灭绝的一个物种

d: n  先驱者， 开路人； 先兆， 预兆 someone or something that existed before something similar that developed or came later

es.e: ...a machine which, in some respects, was the forerunner of the modern helicopter.
es.c: …一台在某些方面是现代直升飞机的前身的机器。

d: n  立体派； 立体主义 a 20th-century style of art, in which objects and people are represented by  geometric  shapes

es.e: By 1918 he had moved away from realism again and was blending fantasy—including abstract flying figures—and cubism in his work.
es.c: 到1918年，他再次摆脱现实主义，而将幻想画的手法（包括抽象的飞行物）与立体派的风格揉合于他的作品之中。

d: vi  苦苦思索； 焦虑不已 to think about a difficult decision very carefully and with a lot of effort
v 过滤；渗入，渗透；逐渐流传，传开 if an idea, feeling, or piece of information percolates through a group, it gradually spreads；n  滤液

es.e: These ideas were slow to percolate.
es.c: 这些观念流传得很慢。

d: adj  不透明的， 不透光的； 难懂的， 晦涩的 opaque glass or liquid is difficult to see through and often thick

es.e: a shower with an opaque glass door
es.c: 装有不透明玻璃门的淋浴间

d: n 优点；优势，有利条件 something that helps you to be more successful than others, or the state of having this；vt  有益于

es.e: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
es.c: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

es.e: It might be to your advantage (=  it might help you  ) to take a computer course of some kind.
es.c: 上一门计算机课程可能对你有利。

d: adj 辅助的，助理的；副的 Assistant is used in front of titles or jobs to indicate a slightly lower rank. For example, an assistant director is one rank lower than a director in an organization.；n  助手， 助教 someone who helps someone

es.e: ...the assistant secretary of defence.
es.c: …助理国防部长。

d: adj  湿的， 潮湿的； 湿润的 if the weather is humid, you feel uncomfortable because the air is very wet and usually hot

es.e: Tokyo is extremely humid in mid-summer.
es.c: 仲夏的东京十分潮湿。

d: adv  代替， 顶替； 反而， 却 used to say what is done, when you have just said that a particular thing is not done

es.e: Geoff didn’t study law. Instead, he decided to become an actor.
es.c: 杰夫没学法律，相反，他决定当演员。

es.e: If Jo can’t attend the meeting, I could go instead.
es.c: 如果乔不能去开会，我可以代他去。

d: n  争论， 辩论 a serious argument about something that involves many people and continues for a long time

es.e: a political controversy
es.c: 政治争议

es.e: the controversy surrounding Skinner’s theories
es.c: 围绕斯金纳的理论的争议

es.e: (= began ) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
es.c: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

d: n&v  命令； 指挥， 统率 an order that should be obeyed

es.e: Shoot when I give the command .
es.c: 我一下命令就开枪。

d: adj  必须做的， 义务的； 强制性的； 必修的 something that is compulsory must be done because it is the law or because someone in authority orders you to

es.e: the threat of compulsory redundancies
es.c: 强制性裁员的威胁

es.e: Car insurance is compulsory.
es.c: 汽车保险是强制性的。

d: adj  落空的， 失败的 an abortive action is not successful

es.e: an abortive military coup
es.c: 一场未遂的军事政变

d: vi 云集；v  密集， 云集； 成群地飞行；n 群，一大群 a large group of insects, especially  bee s  ,moving together

es.e: Photographers were swarming around the princess.
es.c: 摄影师们一窝蜂地围在公主身边。

d: v  预见， 预期； 先于…行动 to expect that something will happen and be ready for it

es.e: Sales are better than anticipated.
es.c: 销量比预期要好。

es.e: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
es.c: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

d: adj 易变的； likely to change often

es.e: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
es.c: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

es.e: Interest rates can be highly variable.
es.c: 利率有时会大幅波动。

d: n  寺庙， 教堂； 太阳穴 one of the two fairly flat areas on each side of your  forehead
v 砍；大幅削减 to cut or try to cut something violently with a knife, sword etc；n  砍痕， 伤痕； 斜线号 a line (/) used in writing to separate words, numbers, or letters

es.e: Someone had slashed the tires.
es.c: 有人把轮胎割破了。

d: vt  编造； 制造 to invent a story, piece of information etc in order to deceive someone

es.e: The police were accused of fabricating evidence.
es.c: 警方被控捏造证据。

d: v  根除； 离开家园 If you uproot yourself or if you are uprooted, you leave, or are made to leave, a place where you have lived for a long time

es.e: ...the trauma of uprooting themselves from their homes.
es.c: …他们背井离乡的痛苦经历。

es.e: He had no wish to uproot Dena from her present home.
es.c: 他没想让德娜搬离她现在的家。

d: v  吻合 if numbers or statements tally, they match exactly；n 记录；账 a record of how much you have spent, won etc by a particular point in time

es.e: Some of the records held by the accounts departments did not tally.
es.c: 会计部门的一些账目有出入。

d: n 风景，景色；地貌，地形；风景画 an area of countryside or land of a particular type, used especially when talking about its appearance；vt  美化…的环境 to make a park, garden etc look attractive and interesting by changing its design, and b

es.e: the beauty of the New England landscape
es.c: 新英格兰风光之美

d: n  除外， 例外 something or someone that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern

es.e: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
es.c: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

es.e: The law applies to all EU countries; Britain is no exception.
es.c: 这项法律适用于所有欧盟国家，英国也不例外。

es.e: We don’t usually accept checks, but for you we’ll make an exception (= not include you in this rule ).
es.c: 我们一般不接受支票，但对你我们就破个例。

d: adj  普遍的； 流行的； 一地常刮的， 盛行的 existing or accepted in a particular place or at a particular time

es.e: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
es.c: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。

es.e: the prevailing economic conditions in Northern Ireland
es.c: 北爱尔兰普遍的经济状况

d: adj  暂时的， 临时的 continuing for only a limited period of time

es.e: temporary pain relief
es.c: 疼痛的暂时缓解

es.e: I’m living with my parents, but it’s only temporary.
es.c: 我和父母住在一起，但这只是暂时的。

es.e: You might want to consider temporary work until you decide what you want to do.
es.c: 在你定下来想做什么之前，也许可以考虑干点临时性工作。

d: n  自然环境， 栖息地 the natural home of a plant or animal

es.e: watching monkeys in their natural habitat
es.c: 观察自然生活环境中的猴子

es.e: The grassland is an important habitat for many wild flowers.
es.c: 这片草原是很多野花的重要生长地。

d: adj  最佳的， 最理想的 the best or most suitable

es.e: However, if you want optimal shadow quality and performance, there are some additional things to consider.
es.c: 不过，如果你想要最佳的阴影质量和性能，有一些其他的事情要考虑。

es.e: Although the optimal user path is a straight line from search and results to customization and purchase, the interface offers several detours from this route.
es.c: 尽管最佳的用户路径是从搜索和结果到定制和购买的直线路径，但该界面却提供了一些迂回的路径。

d: adj  绝望的； 不顾死活的， 拼命的； 极度渴望的 willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger

es.e: I had no money left and was desperate.
es.c: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

es.e: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
es.c: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

es.e: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
es.c: 失踪少年绝望的父母

d: adj  不舒服的； 糟糕的； 可怕的； 非常的 very bad or unpleasant

es.e: The weather was awful.
es.c: 天气很糟糕。

es.e: He is a pretty awful driver.
es.c: 他开车水平相当糟糕。

es.e: That fridge smells awful.
es.c: 那台冰箱气味难闻极了。

d: v 促进，力劝；驱赶，驱策 formal to make someone or something move by shouting, pushing them etc；n  强烈的欲望， 冲动 a strong wish or need

es.e: The charity urged quick action.
es.c: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

d: adj  可用的； 易使用的， 便利的； 手巧的 useful

es.e: It’s quite a handy little tool.
es.c: 这件小工具非常有用。

es.e: It’s very handy having a light above your desk.
es.c: 书桌上方有盏灯很有用。

es.e: Take your swimming trunks with you – they might come in handy (= be useful ).
es.c: 带上你的游泳裤，可能会派上用场的。

d: v  极度痛苦；n 极度痛苦 mental or physical suffering caused by extreme pain or worry

es.e: And we know of your anguish.
es.c: 我们了解你们的痛苦。

es.e: She suffered the anguish of despair.
es.c: 她忍受着绝望的痛苦。

es.e: And in their anguish, they both forgot the nearness of my bedroom.
es.c: 极度的痛苦让他们忘记我的卧室就在附近。

d: n  折射

es.e: The sonobuoy permits recording a refraction profile with only one ship.
es.c: 声纳浮标允许只以一艘船来记录折射剖面。

es.e: We did work in thermonuclear energy, laser beam refraction, hydrogen molecule development, and heavy - water computer data.
es.c: 我们从事过热核能、 激光束折射， 氛分子发展和电脑重水数据的研究工作。

es.e: With all that reflection and refraction, modernism creates the illusion that there is an illusion when in fact it is a straightforward statement of money and power.
es.c: 通过反射和折射，现代主义创造了一个幻觉存在的假象，而实际上它是对金钱和权力不加掩饰的声明。

d: adj  视觉的 relating to seeing

es.e: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
es.c: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

es.e: The tall tower adds to the visual impact of the building.
es.c: 高高的塔楼增强了这幢大楼的视觉效果。

d: n  禁猎区， 动物保护区； 庇护所， 避难所； 圣所， 圣殿 an area for birds or animals where they are protected and cannot be hunted

es.e: His church became a sanctuary for thousands of people who fled the civil war.
es.c: 他的教堂成了数千逃避内战的人们的一个避难所。

d: n  有氧运动 a very active type of physical exercise done to music, usually in a class

es.e: Yoga has become the new aerobics and some people are getting it out of a book or video.
es.c: 瑜珈已经成为一种新型有氧运动，有些人从书本或录像中学习瑜珈。

es.e: She teaches swimming, lifesaving and water aerobics.
es.c: 她教授游泳、救生术和水中有氧运动。

d: adj  动人的， 诱人的； 引人注目的 something that is inviting is very attractive and makes you want to be near it, try it, taste it etc

es.e: The log fire looked warm and inviting.
es.c: 篝火看上去温暖诱人。

d: vt  指示； 教授 to officially tell someone what to do

es.e: Eva went straight to the hotel, as instructed (= as she had been told ).
es.c: 伊娃按照指示径直去了宾馆。

d: adj  使人愉快的； 欣然同意的 pleasant

es.e: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
es.c: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

es.e: an agreeable young man
es.c: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

d: n  商人 someone whose job is to buy and sell wine, coal etc, or a small company that does this

es.e: He had a job with an Edinburgh wine merchant.
es.c: 他在爱丁堡的一个葡萄酒商那里做过事。

d: n  社会； 社团； 群落； 共同体 the people who live in the same area, town etc

es.e: The new arts centre will serve the whole community.
es.c: 这座新的艺术中心将为整个社区服务。

d: n  小病 an illness that is not very serious

es.e: minor ailments
es.c: 小恙

d: n  译文， 译本； 版本 a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different

es.e: the human version of mad cow disease
es.c: 疯牛病的人类变体

d: adj  蒙受神恩的； 有超凡魅力的 having charisma

es.e: Martin Luther King was a very charismatic speaker.
es.c: 马丁•路德•金是个很有感召力的演说家。

d: vt  使超载， 使过载； 使超负荷； 给…增加负担 to put too many things or people on or into something；n  超载； 超负荷

es.e: Be careful not to overload the washing machine.
es.c: 注意别让洗衣机负荷过重。

d: adj  青铜色的 made of bronze；n 青铜；青铜色；青铜制品；铜牌 a hard metal that is a mixture of  copper  and  tin

es.e: a bronze statuette
es.c: 小青铜雕像

d: adj  坚定的， 忠诚的 giving strong loyal support to another person, organization, belief etc

es.e: a staunch conservative
es.c: 忠实的保守党党员

d: n  选择， 挑选； 精选； 被挑选出来的人， 精选品； 可供选择的事物 the careful choice of a particular person or thing from a group of similar people or things

es.e: The judges have made their final selection.
es.c: 评委已经作出最后的评选。

d: n  青春 the time, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, when a young person is developing into an adult

es.e: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
es.c: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

d: n 等级，档次； a level on a scale that measures something, for example quality or achievement

es.e: Her new book is several notches above anything else she has written.
es.c: 她的新书比她的其他作品高出了好几个等级。

es.e: Jackson raised his voice by a notch.
es.c: 杰克逊将嗓音提高了一度。

es.e: The Spartans turned it up a notch in the second half.
es.c: 斯巴达人队在下半场中比分有所提高。

d: n  亚文化行为观念， 次文化 a particular group of people within a society and their behaviour, beliefs, and activities – often used to show disapproval

es.e: the drug subculture of the inner city
es.c: 旧城区的吸毒亚文化群

d: v  呼出； 散发 to breathe air, smoke etc out of your mouth

es.e: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
es.c: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。

d: adj  适当的 correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose；vt  拨款； 占用， 挪用 to take something for yourself when you do not have the right to do this

es.e: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
es.c: 通告发布的时机很合适。

es.e: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
es.c: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

es.e: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
es.c: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

d: adv  最小； 最少； 微不足道 less than anything or anyone else；adj 最小的；最少的；最不重要的 You use the least to mean a smaller amount than anyone or anything else, or the smallest amount possible

es.e: The journey would impose extra expense on those least able to afford it.
es.c: 这次旅行会给那些最负担不起的人增加额外的开支。

es.e: It is quite amazing what turns up when you are least expecting it.
es.c: 真的很奇妙，你根本想不到会有什么出现。

es.e: He’s my least favourite member of staff.
es.c: 他是最不讨我喜欢的员工。

d: n  功用， 效用； 公用事业 a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use

es.e: Does your rent include utilities?
es.c: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

d: n  表面磨损 the process of rubbing a surface very hard so that it becomes damaged or disappears

es.e: extra protection against abrasion
es.c: 防止磨损的额外保护

d: n  交响乐， 交响曲； 和谐， 协调 a long piece of music usually in four parts, written for an  orchestra

es.e: Bruckner’s Fifth Symphony
es.c: 布鲁克纳的《第五交响曲》

d: adj  雄辩的 ； 动人的 able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people

es.e: an eloquent appeal for support
es.c: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

d: n  天文台， 天文观测站 a special building from which scientists watch the moon, stars, weather etc

es.e: They visited the observatory yesterday.
es.c: 他们昨天参观了天文台。

es.e: When a piece of antimatter strikes the observatory and collides with "normal" matter, both particles immediately annihilate and are transformed into gamma rays — which Fermi can detect.
es.c: 当一小块反物质击打天文台并与“正常”的物质相碰撞时，两个粒子都立即湮灭，并转变为伽马射线- 费米就可以检测到它。

d: adj  乐观的 believing that good things will happen in the future

es.e: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
es.c: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

d: n  支持者； 倡导者 someone who supports something or persuades people to do something

es.e: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
es.c: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的首要支持者。

d: adj  财力不足的， 破产的 not having enough money to pay what you owe

es.e: The company was later declared insolvent (= officially said to be insolvent ).
es.c: 公司随后被宣布破产。

d: adj  水下的， 海底的 growing or used under the sea；n 潜水艇 a ship, especially a military one, that can stay under water

es.e: submarine plant life
es.c: 海生植物

d: n  经验论， 经验主义 the belief in basing your ideas on practical experience

es.e: A basic principle of empiricism is to insist that all knowledge comes from experience.
es.c: 坚持一切知识都来自于经验，这是经验论的基本原则。

d: adj 光滑而有光泽的；线条流畅的；时髦的 a vehicle or other object that is sleek has a smooth attractive shape；vt  使平整光亮 to make hair or fur smooth and shiny by putting water or oil on it

es.e: the sleek lines of the new Mercedes
es.c: 这款新梅赛德斯汽车的优美外形

d: n  微粒， 颗粒； 【语】小品词 a very small piece of something

es.e: dust particles
es.c: 尘埃

d: n  音乐家， 乐师 someone who plays a musical instrument, especially very well or as a job

es.e: a talented young musician
es.c: 有天赋的年轻音乐家

d: vt  是…的典范； 成为…的特征 to be a typical example of something

es.e: the features which typify a Scottish Highland landscape
es.c: 苏格兰高地典型的地貌特征

es.e: non-violent protest, typified by Gandhi
es.c: 以甘地为典型代表的非暴力抗议

d: adj  不景气的； 停滞的； 迟钝的； 因不流动而污浊的 stagnant water or air does not move or flow and often smells bad

es.e: a stagnant pond
es.c: 死水塘

d: adj  感知的， 知觉的； 有洞察力的， 理解力强的 someone who is perceptive notices things quickly and understands situations, people’s feelings etc well – used to show approval

es.e: a perceptive young man
es.c: 一个观察敏锐的年轻人

es.e: highly perceptive comments
es.c: 精辟的评论

es.e: You’re right. That’s very perceptive of you.
es.c: 你说得对，你看得很透。

d: n  注释， 注解 Annotation is the activity of annotating something

es.e: She retained a number of copies for further annotation.
es.c: 她为进一步解释保留了好多复印件。

d: vt  将…减到最少， 使最小化； 降低， 贬低 to reduce something that is difficult, dangerous, or unpleasant to the smallest possible amount or degree

es.e: Every effort is being made to minimize civilian casualties.
es.c: 正在尽最大努力减少平民伤亡。

es.e: The rail company is bringing in more trains in an effort to minimize disruption to travellers.
es.c: 铁路公司正投入更多的列车来减少旅客的不便。

d: v 打扫；席卷，横扫；挥动，舞动；迅速传播； to clean the dust, dirt etc from the floor or ground, using a brush with a long handle

es.e: Bert swept the path in front of the house.
es.c: 伯特清扫了屋前的小路。

d: v  遗传； 下降； 起源； 降临， 来临 to move from a higher level to a lower one

es.e: Our plane started to descend.
es.c: 我们的飞机开始下降。

es.e: I heard his footsteps descending the stairs.
es.c: 我听到他下楼的脚步声。

d: n  机械学， 力学； 技巧， 方法 Mechanics is the part of physics that deals with the natural forces that act on moving or stationary objects

es.e: He has not studied mechanics or engineering.
es.c: 他没有学习过力学或者工程学。

d: adj  有趾的 having a part resembling a toe

es.e: They then found the same virus lurking in the genome of the three-toed sloth .
es.c: 然后他们发现同样的病毒也潜伏在三趾树懒基因组里。

es.e: Women should go for close-toed heels, and if they wear a dress suit, the skirt should fall at or below the knee.
es.c: 女士则应穿不露脚趾的高跟鞋，如穿着裙装套装，那么裙子要及膝或到膝盖以下。

d: n  磁力悬浮火车 a type of high-speed train that runs on magnets supported by a magnetic field generated around the track

es.e: The engine for maglev trains is rather in noticeable.
es.c: 磁悬浮列车的车头是相当值得注意的。

es.e: A good example of how transportation is changing is the new maglev train, which is environmentally friendly, energy-saving and travels at an amazing 430 km/h.
es.c: 新型的磁悬浮列车就是交通运输变化的一个很好的例子。它既环保，又节约能源，还能以430公里的惊人时速行驶。

d: adj  逻辑的； 符合逻辑的， 合理的； 有逻辑头脑的 seeming reasonable and sensible

es.e: It’s a logical site for a new supermarket, with the housing development nearby.
es.c: 附近有住宅区，新的超级市场选址在此是合情合理的。

es.e: a logical conclusion
es.c: 合理的结论

d: vt  以…为特征； 刻画； 描述 to describe the qualities of someone or something in a particular way

es.e: Bright colours characterize his paintings.
es.c: 明亮的色彩是他绘画作品的特点。

d: n  血统， 世系； 下降 the process of going down

es.e: Passengers must fasten their seat belts prior to descent.
es.c: 乘客在飞机降落之前必须系好安全带。

d: vt 阻碍生长；遏制 to stop something or someone from growing to their full size or developing properly；n  特技表演； 噱头； 愚蠢行为 a dangerous action that is done to entertain people, especially in a film

es.e: Lack of sunlight will stunt the plant’s growth.
es.c: 缺乏阳光会阻碍植物的生长。

d: adj  怪异的， 神秘的 very strange and unusual, and difficult to understand or explain

es.e: A really weird thing happened last night.
es.c: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

es.e: He’s a weird bloke.
es.c: 他是个古怪的家伙。

es.e: They sell all sorts of weird and wonderful (= very strange ) products.
es.c: 他们出售各种稀奇古怪的产品。

d: n  笑剧， 滑稽剧； 闹剧 a humorous play or film in which the characters are involved in complicated and silly situations, or the style of writing or acting that is used

es.e: She admitted that the interview had been a complete farce from start to finish.
es.c: 她承认，采访从头到尾完全是一场闹剧。

d: adj  荒唐的， 可笑的 very silly or unreasonable

es.e: That’s a ridiculous idea!
es.c: 那主意很荒唐！

es.e: Don’t be ridiculous!
es.c: 别傻了！

es.e: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
es.c: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

d: n  侵扰， 干扰； 侵犯； 侵入， 闯入 when someone does something, or something happens, that affects your private life or activities in an unwanted way

es.e: the unwelcome intrusion of the press
es.c: 不受欢迎的新闻界的侵扰

d: vt  反驳， 驳斥 to prove that a statement or idea is not correct

es.e: It was the kind of rumour that it is impossible to refute.
es.c: 这是那种不可能推翻的谣言。

d: adj  严重的； 严厉的； 剧烈的； 严峻的， 艰巨的； 朴素的， 不加装饰的 severe problems, injuries, illnesses etc are very bad or very serious

es.e: His injuries were quite severe.
es.c: 他的伤势很严重。

es.e: She’s suffering from severe depression.
es.c: 她患有严重的抑郁症。

es.e: The US faces severe economic problems.
es.c: 美国面临严重的经济问题。

d: vt  是…的典型； 例示， 举例证明 to be a very typical example of something

es.e: The building exemplifies the style of architecture which was popular at the time.
es.c: 这栋大楼代表了当时流行的建筑风格。

d: vi  显露， 暴露； 出来， 现出 to appear or come out from somewhere

es.e: The flowers emerge in the spring.
es.c: 花儿在春天开放。

d: n 租约；租期 a legal agreement which allows you to use a building, car etc for a period of time, in return for rent；vt  出租 to use a building, car etc under a lease

es.e: The landlord refused to renew his lease.
es.c: 房东拒绝和他续签租约。

es.e: The 99-year lease expired in 1999.
es.c: 99年期的租约于1999年到期。

es.e: Do you understand all the terms of the lease?
es.c: 租约条款你都理解吗？

d: vt  开发； 利用； 剥削 to treat someone unfairly by asking them to do things for you, but giving them very little in return – used to show disapproval；n  英勇行为， 业绩， 功绩 a brave and exciting adventure that someone has had

es.e: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
es.c: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

d: adj  渴望的， 热切的 very keen and excited about something that is going to happen or about something you want to do

es.e: He’s a bright kid and eager to learn.
es.c: 他是个聪明的孩子，热爱学习。

es.e: She’s a very hard worker and very eager to please.
es.c: 她工作很卖力，而且很希望别人满意。

es.e: A crowd of eager young students were already waiting outside.
es.c: 一群急不可待的青年学生已经在外面等着。

d: vt 证明 to show that something exists or is true；n  证据； 迹象； 根据 facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true

es.e: The volcano is still active, as evidenced by the recent eruption.
es.c: 最近的喷发证明，这座火山依然活跃。

d: n  共和国； 共和政体 a country governed by elected representatives of the people, and led by a president, not a king or queen

es.e: the former Federal Republic of Germany
es.c: 前德意志联邦共和国

es.e: Nine republics took part in the referendum.
es.c: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

d: n  差事， 差使 a short journey in order to do something for someone, for example delivering or collecting something for them

es.e: I seemed to spend my life running errands for people.
es.c: 我好像一辈子都在为别人跑腿。

es.e: She was always sending me on errands.
es.c: 她老是支使我。

es.e: He quickly set out on his errand of mercy (= journey to help someone in danger ).
es.c: 他迅速启程参加救援行动。

d: adj  艳丽的， 绚丽夺目的； 炫耀的 behaving in a confident or exciting way that makes people notice you

es.e: He lifted his arms in a flamboyant gesture .
es.c: 他抬起胳膊，做了个炫耀的手势。

d: adj  致命的； 破坏性极大的， 极其有害的 likely to be powerful or dangerous – often used humorously

es.e: They were all drinking lethal amounts of tequila!
es.c: 他们都在不要命地喝特奎拉酒！

es.e: Higher taxes and higher inflation were a lethal combination.
es.c: 重税加上高通货膨胀真是让人没法活了。

d: vt  使昏迷； 使震惊； 使…目瞪口呆， 给以深刻印象 to surprise or upset someone so much that they do not react immediately

es.e: Redfern stunned the crowd with a last-minute goal.
es.c: 雷德芬在最后一分钟进球，使观众很是震惊。

d: n  重复， 反复； 重复的事 doing or saying the same thing many times

es.e: Children used to learn by repetition.
es.c: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

d: v  乘雪橇， 用雪橇运 If you sled or go sledding, you ride on a sled；n 雪橇；摘棉机 A sled is the same as a

es.e: We got home and went sledding on the small hill in our back garden.
es.c: 我们回到家，去后院的小山丘上滑雪橇。

d: adj  一夫多妻的， 一妻多夫的 In a polygamous society, people can be legally married to more than one person at the same time. A polygamous person, especially a man, is married to more than one person.

es.e: Less than 1 percent of the men in any Muslim country are polygamous.
es.c: 任何一个穆斯林国家都有不到1%的男子是有多位妻子的。

d: n  担心， 焦虑； 悬念， 不确定 a feeling of excitement or anxiety when you do not know what will happen next

es.e: Come on then, tell me what happened; the suspense is killing me (= I feel very excited or anxious because I do not know what will happen next ) .
es.c: 快来，告诉我发生了什么事。急死我了。

es.e: She couldn’t bear the suspense a moment longer.
es.c: 这样提心吊胆，她再也受不了了。

d: n  经雕琢的宝石 A gemstone is a jewel or stone used in jewellery

es.e: Blue turquoise is valued as a gemstone.
es.c: 蓝色的绿松石被视为宝石。

es.e: Ruby, the common name for the mineral corundum in its red form, is a precious gemstone.
es.c: 红宝石是对红色矿物刚玉的俗称，它是一种珍贵的宝石。

es.e: In particular, we carefully selected for you 12 beautiful gemstone pendants in the hope it can help you resist following illness.
es.c: 我们特别为您精心挑选了12种漂亮的宝石垂饰，希望它能助您抵抗以下病痛。

d: v  讲述， 叙述 to tell a story by describing all the events in order, for example in a book

es.e: The main character narrates the story.
es.c: 主人公讲述故事。

d: v 跳跃；涌现，突然出现；突然提出 to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction, especially by jumping；n  泉； 弹簧， 发条； 春天； 跳， 跃 the season between winter and summer when leaves and flowers appear

es.e: He sprang to his feet (= stood up suddenly ) and rushed after her.
es.c: 他腾地站起身，冲过去追她。

d: n  自治， 自治权； 自主， 自主权 freedom that a place or an organization has to govern or control itself

es.e: campaigners who want greater autonomy for Corsica
es.c: 希望科西嘉有更多自治权的活动家

d: n&v   嘲弄， 讥笑

es.e: It's impolite to gibe at a foreign student's English.
es.c: 嘲笑外国学生的英语是不礼貌的。

es.e: It's unkind to gibe at a foreign student's english even though it may sound amusing.
es.c: 嘲笑一个外国学生的英语是不应该的，就算他的英语令人捧腹。

es.e: "Please don't gibe me, " Lydia said. "I feel as repulsive and small as one of those deadly germs often portrayed in the horror movie genre. "
es.c: “请不要嘲笑我，”利迪娅说。“我觉得自己令人讨厌，渺小，像恐怖类电影描述的那些致命的细菌那样。”

d: n  健康， 健壮； 适合 when you are healthy and strong enough to do hard work or play sports

es.e: an exercise programme to improve your fitness
es.c: 增进健康的锻炼计划

es.e: Running marathons requires a high level of physical fitness .
es.c: 跑马拉松需要身体十分强健。

d: n 碎片，细条；些许，少量 a small thin piece that is torn or cut roughly from something；vt  切碎， 撕碎 to cut or tear something into small thin pieces

es.e: Cut the cabbage into fine long shreds.
es.c: 把这棵卷心菜切成细长条。

d: v  点燃， 开始燃烧； 激起 if you kindle a fire, or if it kindles, it starts to burn

es.e: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
es.c: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

d: v 投降；放弃，交出 to say officially that you want to stop fighting, because you realize that you cannot win；n  投降； 屈服， 屈从； 放弃 when you say officially that you want to stop fighting because you realize that you cannot win

es.e: Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
es.c: 德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。

es.e: The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
es.c: 恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

d: vi 昏厥，晕倒 to suddenly become unconscious for a short time；adj 模糊的，不清楚的；无力的，虚弱的；眩晕的 difficult to see, hear, smell etc；n  昏厥 an act of becoming unconscious

es.e: Several fans fainted in the blazing heat.
es.c: 几个球迷在炽热高温下晕过去了。

d: n  榆树 a type of large tree with broad leaves, or the wood from this tree

es.e: It was a good table too, sturdily constructed of elm.
es.c: 这也是一张好桌子，榆木做的，很结实。

d: n 阴凉处，遮光物；阴暗；色度；差别 slight darkness or shelter from the direct light of the sun made by something blocking it；vt  遮蔽， 遮光 to protect something from direct light

es.e: a plant that needs a lot of shade
es.c: 喜阴植物

d: vi  碰撞， 互撞； 冲突， 抵触 to hit something or someone that is moving in a different direction from you

es.e: A car and a van collided on the motorway.
es.c: 一辆汽车和一辆小型货车在高速公路上相撞了。

es.e: Two trains collided head-on (= when they were moving directly towards each other ) .
es.c: 两辆火车迎头相撞。

d: adj 主要的，最重要的 very important or basic；n  红衣凤头鸟 a North American bird. The male is a bright red colour.

es.e: Having clean hands is one of the cardinal rules when preparing food.
es.c: 双手洁净是准备食物时的一项最基本要求。

es.e: an issue of cardinal importance
es.c: 至关重要的问题

d: v  坚持要求； 坚决主张 to say firmly and often that something is true, especially when other people think it may not be true

es.e: Stay for supper – I insist!
es.c: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

d: adj 常绿的 an evergreen tree or bush does not lose its leaves in winter；n  常绿树， 常青树 a tree or bush that does not lose its leaves in winter

es.e: Plant evergreen shrubs around the end of the month.
es.c: 大约在月末种植常绿灌木。

d: adj  交错的， 错开的； 震惊的

es.e: I was absolutely staggered when I saw the bill.
es.c: 看到账单时，我大吃一惊。

d: n  体积， 容积， 容量； 音量； 卷， 册； 书 the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc

es.e: the volume of trade
es.c: 贸易量

d: v  交易； 执行， 处理 to do business with someone

es.e: Most deals are transacted over the phone.
es.c: 大多数生意都是在电话里成交的。

d: n  催化剂， 触媒； 促使变化的人 a substance that makes a chemical reaction happen more quickly without being changed itself

es.e: I very much hope that this case will prove to be a catalyst for change.
es.c: 我非常希望这件事终将成为促成变化的催化剂。

d: n 指导方针，指导原则 rules or instructions about the best way to do something

es.e: This chapter gives you some guidelines to help you in your work.
es.c: 本章将介绍一些指导性原则，为你的工作提供帮助。

d: adj  松散的， 宽松的； 不精确的， 不严密的； 不牢固的； 自由的， 散漫的 not firmly fastened in place

es.e: a loose floorboard
es.c: 松动的地板

es.e: This tooth feels very loose.
es.c: 这颗牙感觉松动得厉害。

es.e: The screw has come loose (= become loose ) .
es.c: 螺丝松了。

d: adj  令人厌恶的， 讨厌的 very unpleasant or cruel

es.e: that loathsome little man
es.c: 那个讨厌的小男人

d: n  燧石， 打火石 a type of smooth hard stone that makes a small flame when you hit it with steel

es.e: ...a flint arrowhead.
es.c: ...一个燧石箭头。

d: adj  卓越的， 杰出的 If someone or something is preeminent in a group, they are more important, powerful, or capable than other people or things in the group

es.e: ...some of the preeminent names in baseball.
es.c: …棒球史上一些杰出的名字。

d: adj  愤慨的， 恼怒的 angry and surprised because you feel insulted or unfairly treated

es.e: an indignant reply
es.c: 愤慨的回复

d: adj 十进位的，小数的 a decimal system is based on the number 10；n  小数 a  fraction (= a number less than 1 )  that is shown as a  full stop  followed by the number of  tenth s  ,  hundredth s  etc. The numbers 0.5, 0.175, and 0.6

es.e: changing to a decimal system
es.c: 改为十进制

es.e: calculations accurate to three decimal places
es.c: 精确到小数点后三位的计算

d: adv  几乎不， 简直不； 刚刚， 仅仅 used to say that something has only just happened

es.e: The building work has hardly begun.
es.c: 施工才刚刚开始。

d: adj  持久的， 永久的 strong enough, well enough planned etc to continue for a very long time

es.e: The reforms will bring lasting benefits.
es.c: 改革将带来长久的利益。

es.e: Their generosity made a lasting impression on me.
es.c: 他们的慷慨给我留下了难忘的印象。

es.e: a solution that would bring lasting peace
es.c: 将带来持久和平的解决方案

d: adj  愤世嫉俗的， 冷嘲热讽的 unwilling to believe that people have good, honest, or sincere reasons for doing something

es.e: a cynical view of human nature
es.c: 认为人性本恶的一种观点

d: adj  技术的， 工艺的； 专业的 connected with knowledge of how machines work

es.e: Our staff will be available to give you technical support .
es.c: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

es.e: I have no technical knowledge at all.
es.c: 我一点技术知识都没有。

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["technical training"]}
es.c: 技术培训

d: adj  最外面的， 离中心最远的 furthest from the middle

es.e: the outermost stars
es.c: 最远的恒星

d: n  同伴， 共事者 someone you spend a lot of time with, especially a friend

es.e: For ten years he had been her constant companion .
es.c: 十年来他一直陪伴她左右。

es.e: His dog became his closest companion .
es.c: 他的狗成了他最亲密的伙伴。

es.e: a travelling companion
es.c: 旅伴

d: vi  达到顶点； 告终； 【天】到中天

es.e: They had an argument, which culminated in Tom getting drunk.
es.c: 他们发生了争论，结果导致汤姆喝醉了酒。

d: adj  折磨人的， 令人痛苦的； 曲折的， 蜿蜒的； 含混不清的， 拐弯抹角的 a tortuous path, stream, road etc has a lot of bends in it and is therefore difficult to travel along

es.e: a tortuous path over the mountains to Kandahar
es.c: 翻山越岭通往坎大哈的一条蜿蜒小径

d: n  极小量， 少量
v  延伸， 拉长 to reach a long way for something；n 一段路程；延伸 A stretch of road, water, or land is a length or area of it

es.e: The procession stretched for several miles.
es.c: 游行队伍延伸了数英里。

es.e: It's a very dangerous stretch of road.
es.c: 这是一段非常危险的路。

d: n 股，缕；部分，方面 a single thin piece of thread, wire, hair etc；vt  使滞留； 使搁浅 If you are stranded, you are prevented from leaving a place, for example because of bad weather

es.e: She tried to blow a grey strand of hair from her eyes.
es.c: 她试图吹开眼前的一缕白发。

es.e: The climbers had been stranded by a storm.
es.c: 这些登山者被暴风雨困住了。

d: vt  达到； 完成； 实现 to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard

es.e: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
es.c: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

es.e: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
es.c: 大功告成。

d: adj  有宪法制定或修改权的； 组成的， 构成的 being one of the parts of something；n 选民；要素，成分 someone who votes in a particular area

es.e: the EU and its constituent members
es.c: 欧盟及其成员国

d: adv  有意地， 故意地

es.e: Or you can choose to accelerate your growth and intentionally devour life and all it offers .
es.c: 或者你可以选择加速你的成长，有意地吞噬生活及生活所赐予你的一切。

es.e: But in the past, we almost never intentionally or successfully utilized such wealth of information in creating, and reusing our knowledge and developed capability.
es.c: 但是在过去，我们几乎从未有意或成功地利用这些丰富的信息创建、重用我们的知识和拓展我们的能力。

es.e: Before it was fired, it was perfectly round, but the artist intentionally roughed up the edges.
es.c: 在它被烧制出来前，它相当的圆润。 但艺术家有意地把它的边缘弄粗糙。

d: vt  激怒， 使烦躁； 刺激 to make someone feel annoyed or impatient, especially by doing something many times or for a long period of time

es.e: It really irritates me when he doesn’t help around the house.
es.c: 家里的事情他一点都不帮忙，真让我恼火。

d: n  混乱， 大破坏 a situation in which there is a lot of damage or a lack of order, especially so that it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way

es.e: policies that would wreak havoc on the country’s economy
es.c: 会危害该国经济的政策

es.e: Rain has continued to play havoc with sporting events.
es.c: 下雨一直影响着体育比赛的进行。

d: adj  有责任感的， 负责的； 需负责任的； 责任重大的， 重要的 if someone is responsible for an accident, mistake, crime etc, it is their fault or they can be blamed

es.e: We are determined to bring the people responsible to justice.
es.c: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

d: adj  漂泊的；n 无业游民，流浪者 someone who has no home or work, especially someone who begs

es.e: He lived on the street as a vagrant.
es.c: 他作为一个流浪者露宿街头。

d: n  奖牌， 奖章 a flat piece of metal, usually shaped like a coin, that is given to someone who has won a competition or who has done something brave

es.e: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
es.c: 她在上届奥运会上赢得一枚金牌。

es.e: The two boys were awarded medals for their bravery.
es.c: 这两个男孩因勇敢而获得勋章。

d: n  亚麻织品； 亚麻布 cloth made from the flax plant, used to make high quality clothes, home decorations etc

es.e: a linen jacket
es.c: 亚麻布夹克

d: n  卫星； 人造卫星 a machine that has been sent into space and goes around the Earth, moon etc, used for radio, television, and other electronic communication

es.e: the launch of a communications and weather satellite
es.c: 气象通信卫星的发射

d: adj  拥挤的； 压紧的 extremely full of people

es.e: a packed courtroom
es.c: 挤满人的法庭

d: vt  照亮； 启发， 启迪； 阐明， 说明 to make a light shine on something, or to fill a place with light

es.e: A single candle illuminated his face.
es.c: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

es.e: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
es.c: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

d: n  蜥蜴 a type of reptile that has four legs and a long tail

es.e: Neither the lizard nor the glass has any secrets.
es.c: 无论是蜥蜴还是玻璃，都没有任何秘密。

es.e: Meetings are just one symptom of an organization run by the lizard brain.
es.c: 会海只是这类靠蜥蜴脑运作的组织的一个症状。

es.e: When air cools at night, dew collects on the lizard's skin and is pulled to its mouth by capillary action.
es.c: 待晚间空气温度下降，凝结在蜥蜴皮肤上的露珠就可以通过毛细管作用输送到它的口中。

d: n  精神错乱， 神志失常

es.e: Before she died she had fits of delirium.
es.c: 去世前她一阵阵地胡言乱语。

d: n  主要考虑因素； 全神贯注 when someone thinks or worries about something a lot, with the result that they do not pay attention to other things

es.e: Karouzos's poetry shows a profound preoccupation with the Orthodox Church.
es.c: 卡鲁佐斯的诗歌表现出对东正教的深切关注。

d: v 发誓 to make a serious promise to yourself or someone else；n  誓约 a serious promise

es.e: While many models vow to go back to college, few do.
es.c: 很多模特儿发誓要重返大学，但几乎无人做到。

d: n  密码， 暗号 a system of secret writing

es.e: an expert in ciphers
es.c: 密码专家

es.e: messages written in cipher
es.c: 用密码写的信息

d: v  突出， 伸出 to stick out from somewhere

es.e: ...a huge round mass of smooth rock protruding from the water.
es.c: …从水中突出来的一块光滑的圆形巨石。

d: n  剩余物， 残余物 a substance that remains on a surface, in a container etc and cannot be removed easily, or that remains after a chemical process

es.e: The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
es.c: 苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。

es.e: Rinse off any soap residue.
es.c: 冲净残留的肥皂。

d: adj  著名的 well known or famous, especially because of some special quality or ability

es.e: a noted author
es.c: 著名作家

d: n  狂暴， 狂热， 疯狂 a state of great anxiety or excitement, in which you cannot control your behaviour

es.e: Doreen had worked herself into a frenzy .
es.c: 多琳一阵狂怒。

d: n  论坛； 讨论会 an organization, meeting, TV programme etc where people have a chance to publicly discuss an important subject

es.e: Members of the council agreed that was an important forum for discussion.
es.c: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

d: n  轻视， 鄙视， 轻蔑 a feeling that someone or something is not important and deserves no respect

es.e: The public is treated with contempt by broadcasters.
es.c: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

es.e: How could she have loved a man who so clearly held her in contempt ?
es.c: 她怎么会爱上一个明显看不起她的男人呢？

d: n 地平线； the line far away where the land or sea seems to meet the sky

es.e: In the distance, the dot of a boat appeared on the horizon.
es.c: 远处小黑点般的一条小船出现在地平线上。

d: n  任务， 项目； 事业， 企业； 承诺， 保证 an important job, piece of work, or activity that you are responsible for

es.e: Starting a new business can be a risky undertaking.
es.c: 创办新企业有时是一件有风险的事情。

d: adj  比喻的， 借喻的， 象征的； 形象的 a figurative word or phrase is used in a different way from its usual meaning, to give you a particular idea or picture in your mind

es.e: He’s my son, in the figurative sense of the word.
es.c: 打个比方，他就像是我的儿子。

d: v  出汗 to have drops of salty liquid coming out through your skin because you are hot, ill, frightened, or doing exercise；n 汗；一身汗 drops of salty liquid that come out through your skin when you are hot, frightened, ill, or

es.e: I was sweating a lot despite the air conditioning.
es.c: 尽管开着空调，我仍是满头大汗。

d: adj  进步的； 逐步的， 渐进的； 【语】进行时的 supporting new or modern ideas and methods, especially in politics and education

es.e: a progressive administration
es.c: 进步的政府

es.e: progressive and forward-looking policies
es.c: 有前瞻性的进步政策

d: vt  出卖， 泄露； 辜负， 对…不忠； 流露情感 to be disloyal to someone who trusts you, so that they are harmed or upset

es.e: He felt that she had betrayed him.
es.c: 他感觉她背叛了自己。

es.e: She had betrayed her parents' trust .
es.c: 她辜负了父母对她的信任。

es.e: I would never betray a confidence (=  tell a secret that someone has trusted me with  ) .
es.c: 我永远不会泄露秘密。

d: adv  在高处； 在空中 high up in the air

es.e: He held the trophy proudly aloft.
es.c: 他骄傲地把奖杯举向空中。

d: adj  贡献的； 捐助的； 促进的 being one of the causes of a particular result

es.e: Smoking is a contributory factor in lung cancer.
es.c: 抽烟是导致肺癌的一个因素。

d: adj  故意的， 蓄意的； 审慎的， 深思熟虑的 intended or planned；v  深思熟虑 to think about something very carefully

es.e: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
es.c: 对她的故意羞辱

es.e: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
es.c: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

d: v  诅咒； 宣誓， 发誓 to make a public official promise, especially in a court of law

es.e: Remember that you have sworn an oath and so must tell the truth.
es.c: 记住你已经宣过誓了，所以必须讲真话。

es.e: Presidents must swear allegiance to the US constitution.
es.c: 总统必须宣誓效忠美国宪法。

d: n  大气， 大气层； 空气； 气氛， 氛围 the feeling that an event or place gives you

es.e: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
es.c: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

es.e: The atmosphere at home was rather tense.
es.c: 家里的气氛很紧张。

d: v  装饰， 布置 to make something look more attractive by putting something pretty on it

es.e: Children’s pictures decorated the walls of the classroom.
es.c: 教室的墙上装点着儿童画。

d: n  生涯， 经历； 职业 a job or profession that you have been trained for, and which you do for a long period of your life

es.e: a teaching career
es.c: 教学事业

es.e: He realized that his acting career was over.
es.c: 他意识到自己的演艺事业已走到了尽头。

es.e: a physiotherapist who wanted to make a dramatic career change by becoming an author
es.c: 想彻底改行当作家的理疗师

d: v  松弛， 放松； 减缓， 放慢 to gradually become slower, weaker, less active etc, or to make something do this

es.e: The heavy rain showed no signs of slackening off.
es.c: 大雨没有减弱的迹象。

d: n&vt  释放； 发布， 公开； 发泄 to let someone go free, after having kept them somewhere

es.e: Police arrested several men, who were later released.
es.c: 警察逮捕了几个人，后来都释放了。

es.e: The bears are eventually released into the wild.
es.c: 这些熊最后被放回野生环境中。

d: vt 特许设立，给予特权；包租 to pay a company for the use of their aircraft, boat etc；n  纲领， 宣言； 宪章； 特许状 a statement of the principles, duties, and purposes of an organization

es.e: We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
es.c: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

d: adj  持久的， 永久的 an abiding feeling or belief continues for a long time and is not likely to change

es.e: Phil has a deep and abiding love for his family.
es.c: 菲尔对家人怀有深厚不渝的爱。

d: vt  解放； 释放 to free prisoners, a city, a country etc from someone’s control

es.e: A few days later, our armies liberated the city.
es.c: 几天以后，我军解放了这座城市。

d: adj 道德的，道义上的；有道德的，品行端正的；精神的 relating to the principles of what is right and wrong behaviour, and with the difference between good and evil

es.e: It is easy to have an opinion on a moral issue like the death penalty for murder.
es.c: 对于判谋杀犯死刑这种涉及伦理道德的问题，有个观点并非难事。

es.e: If we accept that certain babies should be allowed to die, we place doctors in a moral dilemma .
es.c: 如果我们同意应该允许某些婴儿死去，那就是让医生在道德上处于两难境地了。

es.e: Man is gifted with a moral sense by which he distinguishes good from evil.
es.c: 人类天生有道德意识，能区分善与恶。

d: n  减少， 缩减 a reduction in the size, number, or amount of something

es.e: ...despite a slight diminution in asset value.
es.c: ...尽管资产价值略有减少。

d: v  有志于； 热望， 向往 to desire and work towards achieving something important

es.e: ...people who aspire to public office.
es.c: …志在获得公职的人们。

d: v  爆炸； 激增； 冲动， 发怒 to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage

es.e: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
es.c: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

es.e: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
es.c: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

d: n  发作； 爆发 if there is an outbreak of fighting or disease in an area, it suddenly starts to happen

es.e: a cholera outbreak
es.c: 霍乱的爆发

d: n  小睡， 打盹 a short sleep, especially during the day

es.e: an afternoon nap
es.c: 午睡

d: vt  操作， 处理； 利用， 操纵 to make someone think and behave exactly as you want them to, by skilfully deceiving or influencing them

es.e: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
es.c: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

es.e: You have the constant feeling you are being manipulated.
es.c: 你总感觉自己是被人控制着的。

d: adj  相似的， 类似的 almost the same

es.e: We have similar tastes in music.
es.c: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

es.e: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
es.c: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

es.e: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
es.c: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

d: adj  生态的 connected with the way plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment

es.e: an ecological disaster
es.c: 生态灾难

d: v  反驳； 同…矛盾， 相抵触 to disagree with something, especially by saying that the opposite is true

es.e: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
es.c: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

es.e: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
es.c: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

es.e: The article flatly contradicts their claims.
es.c: 这篇文章断然驳斥他们的说法。

d: vt  数字化 to put information into a digital form

es.e: The picture is digitized by a scanner.
es.c: 该图通过扫描仪被数字化。

d: n  合伙； 伙伴关系； 合伙人身份 the state of being a partner in business

es.e: It’s one of the most successful partnerships in the country.
es.c: 它是该国最成功的合伙企业之一。

d: n 形状，外形，样子；体形，身材；形式；幻象；情况，状况 the form that something has, for example round, square,  triangular  etc；vt  使成为…形状， 塑造； 决定…的形成 to make something have a particular shape, especially by pressing it

es.e: What shape is the table?
es.c: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

es.e: You can recognize a tree by the shape of its leaves.
es.c: 可以根据树叶的形状辨认出是什么树。

es.e: His battered old hat had completely lost its shape.
es.c: 他那顶破旧的帽子已经完全变形了。

d: v  用言语表达 to express something in words

es.e: Urge your child to verbalize his feelings.
es.c: 鼓励你的孩子用言语表达自己的情感。

d: adj  重大的， 重要的 a momentous event, change, or decision is very important because it will have a great influence on the future

es.e: a momentous decision
es.c: 重大决定

es.e: Momentous events are taking place in the US.
es.c: 美国正在发生重大事件。

es.e: His colleagues all recognized that this was a momentous occasion .
es.c: 他的同事都认识到这是一个重要时刻。

d: vt  使具体化； 明确规定， 详细说明 to state something in an exact and detailed way

es.e: Payments will be made for a specified number of months.
es.c: 款项将在规定的几个月内支付。

d: n  忠诚， 效忠， 拥戴 loyalty to a leader, country, belief etc

es.e: an oath of allegiance
es.c: 效忠宣誓

es.e: The people here have strong political allegiances .
es.c: 这里的民众政治忠诚度很高。

d: v  想要

es.e: I wanna be with you.
es.c: 我想要和你在一起。

es.e: I wanna save you, save you, save you tonight.
es.c: 我想要拯救你，拯救你，拯救你就在今晚。

es.e: Am I the one you wanna place in your heart – why me ?
es.c: 我是你想要放在心上的人吗？为什么是我？

d: n  十字路口， 人行横道； 过境处； 交叉点； 穿越， 横渡 a place where you can safely cross a road, railway, river etc

es.e: You must give way to any pedestrians on the crossing.
es.c: 必须让人行横道上的行人先行。

d: n  有关， 相关； 中肯， 适当； 重大关系， 意义； 实用性 Something's relevance to a situation or person is its importance or significance in that situation or to that person

es.e: Politicians' private lives have no relevance to their public roles.
es.c: 政治家的私生活与他们的公众角色没有相关性。

d: v  采石； 采集 to dig stone or sand from a quarry；n 采石场，石矿；猎物，追捕的对象 a place where large amounts of stone or sand are dug out of the ground

es.e: The large limestone caves are also quarried for cement.
es.c: 这些大石灰岩洞也用来开采水泥原料。

d: n  沙砾， 砾石 small stones, used to make a surface for paths, roads etc

es.e: a gravel path
es.c: 石子小道

d: n  营养不良 when someone becomes ill or weak because they have not eaten enough good food

es.e: refugees suffering from malnutrition
es.c: 营养不良的难民

d: v  浸没， 淹没 to cover something completely with water or another liquid

es.e: The tunnel entrance was submerged by rising sea water.
es.c: 隧道入口被涨起的海水淹没。

d: vi  汇聚， 聚集， 聚合； 相交， 会合； 趋于一致 to come from different directions and meet at the same point to become one thing

es.e: The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
es.c: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

d: adj  相关的； 恰当的， 贴切的 directly relating to something that is being considered

es.e: He asked me a lot of very pertinent questions .
es.c: 他问了我许多直接相关的问题。

d: v  创作； 组成； 使安定 to write a piece of music

es.e: Barrington has composed the music for a new production of ‘A Midsummer Night’s Dream’.
es.c: 巴林顿为新版的《仲夏夜之梦》谱了曲。

d: n  长颈鹿 a tall African animal with a very long neck and legs and dark spots on its yellow-brown fur

es.e: I/ you/ we/ they like giraffe.
es.c: 我/你/我们/他们喜欢长颈鹿。

es.e: So they sent me a … giraffe!
es.c: 于是他们又送我一只…长颈鹿。

es.e: Can I get the mommy giraffe for Christmas?
es.c: 我在圣诞节能得到一个长颈鹿妈妈吗？

d: adj 超音速的，超声波的 faster than the speed of sound；n  超音速， 超声波

es.e: supersonic aircraft
es.c: 超音速飞机

d: n  细胞； 基层组织； 单人房间； 电池 the smallest part of a living thing that can exist independently

es.e: cancer cells
es.c: 癌细胞

es.e: Embryos grow by cell division (= the splitting of cells ) .
es.c: 胚胎通过细胞分裂而成长。

d: v 增加，扩大；膨胀，肿胀 to become larger and rounder than normal – used especially about parts of the body；n  波浪的涌动； 隆起； 增强， 增加 the way the sea moves up and down

es.e: Her ankle was already starting to swell.
es.c: 她的脚踝已经开始肿起来了。

es.e: The window frame was swollen shut.
es.c: 窗框膨胀变形，关得死死的。

d: vt  提醒； 使想起； 使发生联想 to make someone remember something that they must do

es.e: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
es.c: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

es.e: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
es.c: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

d: adj  天然的， 未提炼的； 粗糙的； 粗俗的 not exact or without any detail, but generally correct and useful

es.e: a crude estimate of the population available for work
es.c: 对劳动力人口的粗略估计

d: adj  有根据的， 合理的； 有效的 a valid ticket, document, or agreement is legally or officially acceptable

es.e: a valid credit card
es.c: 有效信用卡

es.e: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
es.c: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

d: vt  经受住， 耐； 抵挡 to be strong enough to remain unharmed by something such as great heat, cold, pressure etc

es.e: This fabric can withstand steam and high temperatures.
es.c: 这种织物耐蒸汽和高温。

d: n  惯性； 惰性 when no one wants to do anything to change a situation

es.e: political inertia
es.c: 政治上的保守

d: vt  成为…的缩影； 摘要， 概括， 缩写

es.e: This building epitomizes the spirit of the nineteenth century.
es.c: 这栋建筑体现了19世纪的时代精神。

d: adj  冬天的； 寒冷的； 冷淡的 cold or typical of winter

es.e: a wintry day
es.c: 一个冬日

es.e: wintry showers
es.c: 冬季的阵雪

d: v  鼓励， 激励； 促进， 激发 to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

es.e: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
es.c: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

d: n 真空；真空状态，空白， a space that is completely empty of all gas, especially one from which all the air has been taken away

d: n  学徒的身份； 学徒的年限 the job of being an apprentice, or the period of time in which you are an apprentice

es.e: He’s serving an apprenticeship as a printer.
es.c: 他现在是一名印刷工学徒。

es.e: a five-year apprenticeship
es.c: 五年学徒期

d: vt  打扰； 搅乱， 弄乱； 使烦恼， 使不安 to change a normal situation in a way that causes problems

es.e: My hormone balance is disturbed by my pregnancy.
es.c: 怀孕打乱了我的荷尔蒙平衡。

es.e: New procedures often disturb the comfortable habits of the workforce.
es.c: 新的程序常常会打乱职工习以为常的习惯。

d: vi  坚持； 持续 to continue to do something, although this is difficult, or other people oppose it

es.e: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
es.c: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

d: n 泵 a machine for forcing liquid or gas into or out of something；vt  抽 to make liquid or gas move in a particular direction, using a pump

es.e: ...pumps that circulate the fuel around in the engine.
es.c: …使燃料在发动机内循环的压泵。

d: v  刺穿， 刺破； 穿孔， 打眼 to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point

es.e: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
es.c: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

es.e: Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
es.c: 罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

d: n  日历， 挂历， 月历； 日程表 a set of pages that show the days, weeks, and months of a particular year, that you usually hang on a wall

es.e: There was a calendar on the wall above, with large squares around the dates.
es.c: 墙的上方曾有一本日历，日期框在大方格里。

d: n  家长， 族长 an old man who is respected as the head of a family or tribe

es.e: The patriarch of the house, Mr. Jawad, rules it with a ferocity renowned throughout the neighbourhood.
es.c: 那户人家的家长贾瓦德先生治家严苛，名闻乡里。

d: n  实习生 someone who has nearly finished training as a doctor and is working in a hospital；vt  拘禁， 软禁

es.e: ...a medical intern.
es.c: …一位实习医生。

d: adj  感觉的， 感官的； 肉欲的； 耽于感官享受的 relating to the feelings of your body rather than your mind

es.e: the sensual pleasure of good food
es.c: 美食的感官享受

d: adj  正直的， 公正的； 正义的， 正当的 strong feelings of anger when you think a situation is not morally right or fair

es.e: He was full of righteous indignation about the attack.
es.c: 他对这次袭击事件义愤填膺。

d: v  推测； 深思， 沉思； 投机， 做投机买卖 to guess about the possible causes or effects of something, without knowing all the facts or details

es.e: She refused to speculate.
es.c: 她拒绝猜测。

d: adj  隐蔽的； 私下的， 秘密的；vt 把…关在房间里 to shut someone in a room away from other people in order to discuss something private, to be alone etc；n 橱，壁橱 a cupboard built into the wall of a room from the floor to the ceiling

es.e: Don’t let her closet herself away in her room.
es.c: 别让她把自己关在房间里。

d: n&v  注意， 留心 to pay attention to someone’s advice or warning

es.e: If she had only heeded my warnings , none of this would have happened.
es.c: 要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。

d: vt  装饰， 装扮 to decorate something

es.e: His watercolour designs adorn a wide range of books.
es.c: 他的水彩设计装饰着各种各样的书籍。

d: adj  巨大的， 庞大的 unusually large；n 怪物；庞然大物；恶魔 an imaginary or ancient creature that is large, ugly, and frightening

es.e: a monster cat
es.c: 巨型猫

es.e: The song was a monster hit.
es.c: 这首歌大受欢迎。

d: n 水泥；胶合剂 a grey powder made from  lime  and clay that becomes hard when it is mixed with water and allowed to dry, and that is used in building；vt  巩固； 使团结 to make a relationship between people, countries, or organizatio

es.e: a bag of cement
es.c: 一袋水泥

d: n  地铁 a railway system that runs under the ground below a big city

es.e: the New York City subway
es.c: 纽约市的地铁

es.e: a crowded subway station
es.c: 拥挤的地铁站

es.e: Boston has the oldest subway system in the US.
es.c: 波士顿拥有美国最老的地铁运输系统。

d: vt 鞭笞；使受苦，折磨 to hit someone with a whip as punishment in the past；n  鞭子； 祸害； 鞭笞 something that causes a lot of harm or suffering

es.e: Economic anarchy scourged the post-war world.
es.c: 经济混乱蹂躏战后世界。

d: vt  使认识； 使熟悉

es.e: I need to acquaint myself with the new regulations.
es.c: 我得熟悉一下新的规章制度。

d: n  萎缩

es.e: More exercises can avoid atrophy of cartilage.
es.c: 多加锻炼可以避免软骨萎缩。

es.e: If you don't exercise your muscles, they weaken and atrophy.
es.c: 如果不锻炼你的肌肉，肌力就削弱和萎缩了。

es.e: Some areas of the brain, if not stimulated, will atrophy and die.
es.c: 大脑的某些区域如果没有受到促进就会萎缩更甚死亡。

d: vt 使成浆状 to beat or crush something until it becomes very soft and almost liquid；n  纸浆； 浆状物 a very soft substance that is almost liquid, made by crushing plants, wood, vegetables etc

es.e: pulped apples
es.c: 苹果泥

d: n  大学肄业生； 大学本科生 a student at college or university, who is working for their first degree

es.e: second-year undergraduates
es.c: 大学二年级学生

d: adj  抗菌的

es.e: Thatreally sped up the development of penicillin as an antibiotic.
es.c: 这确实加快了青霉素作为抗生素的发展。

es.e: The efficiency of testing at the tanker level is why regulations require such testing for antibiotic residues.
es.c: 在罐水平检测的效率是为什么条例要求这类抗生素残留检测的原因。

d: adj  连接的； 共同的， 共有的， 联合的 involving two or more people or groups, or owned or shared by them；n 关节，骨节；接头，接合处 a part of your body that can bend because two bones meet there

es.e: The two ministers have issued a joint statement.
es.c: 两位部长发布了一项联合声明。

es.e: Both companies are involved in the joint development of a new medium-sized car.
es.c: 两家公司联合开发一款新的中型汽车。

es.e: The meal was a joint effort(= two or more people worked on it together ).
es.c: 这顿饭是大家一起做的。

d: v  分离； 划分； 区别； 分居 to divide or split into different parts, or to make something do this；adj  分离的； 个别的 not joined to or touching something else

es.e: This will keep your dressing from separating.
es.c: 这样可以防止调味汁分层。

es.e: First, separate the eggs (= divide the white part from the yellow part ) .
es.c: 第一步，把蛋清和蛋黄分开。

d: adj  合理的， 适当的； 通情达理的； 公道的 fair and sensible

es.e: a reasonable request
es.c: 合情合理的要求

es.e: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
es.c: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

es.e: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (= completely reasonable ) question.
es.c: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

d: adj  濒危的， 将要灭绝的

es.e: I think there are many endangered animals in the world, such as tigers and pandas.
es.c: 我认为有许多濒临灭绝的动物，如老虎和大熊猫，在世界。

es.e: I think our government should punish those people severely who kill the rare animals. It is our duty to protect the endangered animals.
es.c: 我认为政府应该严厉惩罚那些捕杀稀有动物的人。保护濒临灭绝的动物是我们的责任。

es.e: However, it holds six language families, two of which have only one remaining language, and almost all of the languages here are endangered.
es.c: 然而，它拥有六个语族，其中两个语族仅剩下一种语言，而且这儿几乎所有的语言都濒临灭绝。

d: adj  偶然的， 任意的； 无计划的， 无秩序的 happening or done in a way that is not planned or organized

es.e: Educational provision in the country is haphazard.
es.c: 该国提供的教育毫无计划性。

d: n  蜡烛芯； 灯芯 the piece of thread in a candle, that burns when you light it

es.e: A tallow candle with a rush stem as the wick.
es.c: 一种以灯芯草茎为灯芯的动物脂肪作成的蜡烛。

d: adj  一年两次的 happening twice each year

es.e: a biannual report
es.c: 半年度报告

d: vt  得出， 引出； 诱出 If you elicit a response or a reaction, you do or say something that makes other people respond or react

es.e: Mr. Norris said he was hopeful that his request would elicit a positive response.
es.c: 诺里斯先生说他希望他的要求会引起积极的回应。

d: vt  使贬职， 使降级； 放逐， 贬谪 if a sports team is relegated, it is moved into a lower  division

es.e: Might it not be better to relegate the king to a purely ceremonial function?
es.c: 使该国王降级到一种纯粹礼仪性的职能难道不更好吗？

d: n  模棱两可的话； 歧义 the state of being unclear, confusing, or not certain, or things that produce this effect

es.e: legal ambiguities
es.c: 法律上含混不清的地方

d: adj  琐碎的， 微不足道的 not serious, important, or valuable

es.e: a trivial sum
es.c: 一笔极小的金额

es.e: Her feelings for Simon seemed trivial by comparison .
es.c: 相比之下，她对西蒙的感情就显得微不足道了。

d: n  知道， 意识， 察觉 knowledge or understanding of a particular subject or situation

es.e: Health officials have tried to raise awareness (=  improve people’s knowledge  ) about AIDS.
es.c: 卫生部官员努力提高人们对艾滋病的认识。

d: n  明信片 a card that can be sent in the post without an envelope, especially one with a picture on it

es.e: Don’t forget to send us a postcard!
es.c: 别忘了给我们寄张明信片！

d: n  长寿； 寿命 the amount of time that someone or something lives

es.e: The ancient Chinese claimed that garlic promoted longevity.
es.c: 中国古人说蒜能延寿。

d: adj 军事的 used by, involving, or relating to the army, navy, or airforce；n  [the ～]军队， 军方 the military forces of a country

es.e: a military helicopter
es.c: 军用直升机

es.e: military equipment
es.c: 军事设备

es.e: The government has threatened to take military action if the rebels do not withdraw from the area.
es.c: 政府警告说，如果叛乱分子不从该地区撤出，就要采取军事行动。

d: adj  不情愿的， 勉强的 slow and unwilling

es.e: She gave a reluctant smile.
es.c: 她勉强笑了笑。

d: adj  凭良心的； 认真谨慎的， 一丝不苟的 careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do

es.e: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
es.c: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

es.e: a conscientious and hard-working student
es.c: 勤勉刻苦的学生

d: v 盘绕，卷 to wind or twist into a series of rings, or to make something do this；n  卷； 线圈 a continuous series of circular rings into which something such as wire or rope has been wound or twisted

es.e: The snake coiled around the branches of the tree.
es.c: 这条蛇盘在树枝上。

es.e: Her long hair was coiled up in a plait at the top of her head.
es.c: 她的长发编成辫子盘在头顶。

es.e: He coiled the rope.
es.c: 他把绳子卷了起来。

d: adj  官方的； 权威性的， 可信的； 专断的， 命令式的 an authoritative book, account etc is respected because the person who wrote it knows a lot about the subject

es.e: the most authoritative work on English surnames
es.c: 有关英语姓氏的最权威著作

d: vt  确保， 担保， 保证 to make certain that something will happen properly

es.e: facilities to ensure the safety of cyclists
es.c: 确保骑车人安全的设施

d: n  生物， 有机物； 有机体 an animal, plant, human, or any other living thing

es.e: All living organisms have to adapt to changes in environmental conditions.
es.c: 一切生物都要适应环境条件的变化。

es.e: Genes operate together in determining the characteristics of an individual organism.
es.c: 基因的共同作用决定生物个体的特性。

d: adj  流行性的， 传染性的；n 流行；流行病 a large number of cases of a disease that happen at the same time

es.e: Over 500 people died during last year’s flu epidemic.
es.c: 去年流感大暴发期间有五百多人死亡。

d: v  假设， 推测； 认为， 料想； 要不 to think that something is probably true, based on what you know

es.e: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
es.c: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

es.e: (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
es.c: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

d: n&vi  踌躇， 顾忌， 顾虑 a belief about what is right and wrong that prevents you from doing bad things

es.e: a man with no moral scruples
es.c: 一个道德上无所顾忌的男人

d: adj  显著的， 值得注意的； 非凡的 unusual or surprising and therefore deserving attention or praise

es.e: She has made remarkable progress.
es.c: 她取得了显著的进步。

es.e: a remarkable coincidence
es.c: 不寻常的巧合

es.e: He’s a remarkable man .
es.c: 他是个了不起的人。

d: n 风味，滋味；调味品；vt  给…调味
n 休会期；休庭；暂停；凹室， a time during the day or year when no work is done, especially in parliament, law courts etc

es.e: Parliament’s summer recess
es.c: 议会的夏季休会期

d: vt  取出； 提取， 榨取 to remove an object from somewhere, especially with difficulty；n  提出物； 摘录， 选段； 精， 汁 a short piece of writing, music etc taken from a particular book, piece of music etc

es.e: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
es.c: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

d: adj  直言不讳的， 坦率的 expressing your opinions honestly and directly, even when doing this might annoy some people

es.e: an outspoken critic of the education reforms
es.c: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

d: adj 暗的，模糊的，朦胧的；费解的，晦涩的；不著名的，不重要的 not well known and usually not very important；vt  使变模糊； 使费解

es.e: an obscure poet
es.c: 名不见经传的诗人

es.e: The details of his life remain obscure.
es.c: 他的生平不详。

d: adj  有害的； 有毒的 harmful or poisonous

es.e: noxious fumes
es.c: 有毒烟雾

d: vt 支持；改善 to improve something；n  垫子， 枕垫 a long firm  pillow  , usually shaped like a tube

es.e: his efforts to bolster his career
es.c: 他为发展事业所付出的努力

d: n  层； 地区， 区域； 范围 a large area of a country or of the world, usually without exact limits

es.e: efforts to bring peace to the region
es.c: 给这个地区带来和平的努力

d: v  欺骗 to make someone believe something that is not true

es.e: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
es.c: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

d: adj  巧妙的； 聪明的， 机敏的； 善于创造发明的； 设计独特的， 别致的 an ingenious plan, idea, or object works well and is the result of clever thinking and new ideas

es.e: Many fish have ingenious ways of protecting their eggs from predators.
es.c: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

es.e: an ingenious device
es.c: 精巧的装置

d: n  问卷， 调查表 a written set of questions which you give to a large number of people in order to collect information

es.e: Teachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
es.c: 教师们将被要求填写一份调查问卷。

d: n  突破， 重大进展 an important new discovery in something you are studying, especially one made after trying for a long time

es.e: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
es.c: 该公司看上去稳将在中国实现一次重大突破。

d: n  快餐， 小吃， 点心 a small amount of food that is eaten between main meals or instead of a meal

es.e: I grabbed a quick snack.
es.c: 我赶紧吃了点零食。

es.e: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
es.c: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

es.e: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
es.c: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

d: adj  两栖的； 水陆两用的 able to live both on land and in water

es.e: amphibious creatures
es.c: 两栖生物

d: vt  使铭记， 使牢记； 压印 When something is imprinted on your memory, it is firmly fixed in your memory so that you will not forget it；n  印记， 印痕； 持久的影响 the mark left by an object being pressed into or onto something

es.e: As I arrived, the shimmering skyline of domes and minarets was imprinted on my memory.
es.c: 当我到达时，穹顶和尖塔形成的泛着微光的空中轮廓线铭刻在我的记忆中。

d: n  目的地， 终点 the place that someone or something is going to

es.e: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
es.c: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

d: n 裤腰；牛轭；奴役，束缚 a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads；vt  使结合， 连接 to closely connect two ideas, people, or things

es.e: the yoke of tradition
es.c: 传统的枷锁

d: adj 垂直的，竖直的 pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface；n  垂直线 the direction of something that is vertical

es.e: a vertical line
es.c: 垂直线

es.e: the vertical axis of a graph
es.c: 图的纵轴

es.e: vertical window blinds
es.c: 垂直百叶窗

d: adj 相互的；互惠的；相应的； a reciprocal arrangement or relationship is one in which two people or groups do or give the same things to each other

es.e: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
es.c: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

es.e: Such treaties provide reciprocal rights and obligations.
es.c: 此类协议规定了相互之间的权利与义务。

d: vt  使永存， 使持续 to make a situation, attitude etc, especially a bad one, continue to exist for a long time

es.e: an education system that perpetuates the divisions in our society
es.c: 使我们的社会持续分化的一种教育制度

d: adj  纯洁的； 纯净的； 完全的； 纯理论的， 抽象的 a pure substance or material is not mixed with anything

es.e: rings made of pure gold
es.c: 纯金制成的戒指

es.e: Our beef patties are 100% pure .
es.c: 我们的牛肉饼是100%的纯牛肉。

d: adj 潮湿的 slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way；n 潮湿；湿气 water in walls or in the air that causes things to be slightly wet；vt  弄湿； 减弱， 抑制

es.e: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth.
es.c: 用湿布擦拭皮面。

es.e: a cold, damp day
es.c: 寒冷潮湿的一天

d: vt  强调， 着重 to say something in a strong way

es.e: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
es.c: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

es.e: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
es.c: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

d: v  更明亮； 快活起来； 有希望 If your eyes brighten, you suddenly look interested or excited

es.e: His eyes brightened and he laughed.
es.c: 他眼睛一亮,笑了起来。

d: n  矿； 矿物， 矿石 rock or earth from which metal can be obtained

es.e: iron ore
es.c: 铁矿石

es.e: veins of rich ore
es.c: 富矿脉

d: adj 轻微的，微小的 small in degree；v 侮慢；轻视，冷落 to offend someone by treating them rudely or without respect

es.e: a slight improvement
es.c: 些许的改进

es.e: a slight increase
es.c: 少许的增加

es.e: a slight change of plan
es.c: 计划的略微变动

d: adj  先前的， 在前的 A previous event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about

es.e: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
es.c: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

d: v  争论， 辩论； 主张， 论证； 说服， 劝说 to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way

es.e: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
es.c: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

d: adj 伴随的 existing or happening together, especially as a result of something；n  伴随物 something that often or naturally happens with something else

es.e: war with all its concomitant sufferings
es.c: 战争及其引起的一切苦难

d: adj  笨重的； 麻烦的； 累赘的， 冗长的 a process or system that is cumbersome is slow and difficult

es.e: Doctors are complaining that the system is cumbersome and bureaucratic.
es.c: 医生抱怨说该体制复杂繁琐，很官僚。

es.e: cumbersome procedures
es.c: 繁琐的程序
