es.c: 他们都信奉同一个神。

es.e: a church where people have worshipped for hundreds of years
es.c: 人们做了几百年礼拜的一座教堂

d: n  草地， 草坪； 操场 an area of ground in a garden or park that is covered with short grass

es.e: I spent all morning mowing the lawn (= cutting the grass ).
es.c: 我整个上午都在修剪草坪。

es.e: a carefully tended lawn
es.c: 受到细心呵护的草坪

d: n  传染， 感染； 传染病 a disease that affects a particular part of your body and is caused by bacteria or a virus

es.e: The baby had an ear infection.
es.c: 宝宝耳朵感染了。

d: adj  笨重的； 笨拙的； 沉闷的 slow or awkward because of being very big and heavy

es.e: an elephant’s ponderous walk
es.c: 大象笨拙的步态

d: adj  顽固的， 倔强的； 难对付的 determined not to change your mind, even when people think you are being unreasonable

es.e: Why are you so stubborn?
es.c: 你怎么这么固执？

es.e: I’ve got a very stubborn streak (= a tendency to be stubborn ) .
es.c: 我的个性很固执。

es.e: Paul can be as stubborn as a mule (= very stubborn ) .
es.c: 保尔有时倔得像头驴。

d: adj  不精确的； 不严密的 not clear or exact

es.e: vague imprecise estimates
es.c: 粗略的、不精确的估计

es.e: Alcohol affects the brain, making speech slurred and imprecise.
es.c: 酒精影响大脑，使言语含糊不清。

d: vt  阐明， 确切表达； 规划， 构想； 制定 to develop something such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done

es.e: We are studying the situation but have not formulated any response yet.
es.c: 我们正在研究形势，但尚未考虑好如何回应。

d: vt  吹捧， 美化； 赞美， 赞扬 to make someone or something seem more important or better than they really are

es.e: films which glorify violence
es.c: 美化暴力的影片

d: v  移民， 移居国外 to leave your own country in order to live in another country

es.e: He emigrated to Belgium.
es.c: 他移民去了比利时。

d: adj  蜿蜒的； 迂回的 with many smooth twists and turns

es.e: They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
es.c: 他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。

d: n  三角形； 三角形物体 a flat shape with three straight sides and three angles

es.e: a triangle of land
es.c: 一块三角地

d: n 外星人；组织之外的人；外国人， someone who is not a legal citizen of the country they are living or working in

es.e: illegal aliens entering the country.
es.c: 非法入境的外国人

d: n  层， 层次 an amount or piece of a material or substance that covers a surface or that is between two other things

es.e: He pulled off layer upon layer of clothing (= many layers of clothing ).
es.c: 他把衣服一件件地脱掉。

d: adj  语言的， 语言学的 related to language, words, or linguistics

es.e: a child’s linguistic development
es.c: 儿童的语言发展

d: n  卫生； 卫生设施， 卫生设备 the protection of public health by removing and treating waste, dirty water etc

es.e: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
es.c: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

d: adj 卓越的，精锐的 an elite group contains the best, most skilled or most experienced people or members of a larger group；n  精英 a group of people who have a lot of power and influence because they have money, knowledge, or spec

es.e: an elite group of artists
es.c: 一批出类拔萃的艺术家

es.e: elite universities
es.c: 精英大学

d: n  装饰 a small object that you keep in your house because it is beautiful rather than useful；vt  装饰， 点缀 to be decorated with something

es.e: a shelf covered with books and ornaments
es.c: 摆满书籍和装饰品的架子

es.e: a cabinet in which she kept her collection of china ornaments
es.c: 她放置瓷器摆设收藏品的柜子

d: adj  丰满的， 圆胖的 slightly fat in a way that looks healthy and attractive

es.e: a chubby six-year-old
es.c: 一个胖乎乎的六岁孩子

es.e: a baby with round chubby cheeks
es.c: 脸蛋圆嘟嘟的婴儿

d: n  象牙； 象牙制品； 象牙色， 乳白色 the hard smooth yellowish-white substance from the  tusks(= long teeth )  of an  elephant

es.e: an ivory chess set
es.c: 一副象牙国际象棋

d: adj  异常的； 不规则的 different from what you expected to find

es.e: a highly anomalous situation
es.c: 极其反常的形势

es.e: anomalous results
es.c: 异常的结果

d: adj  不足的， 缺乏的； 有缺陷的， 不完善的 not containing or having enough of something

es.e: Women who are dieting can become iron deficient.
es.c: 节食的女性有可能缺铁。

d: adv  从此以后 from this time on

es.e: multiple sclerosis (henceforth referred to as MS)
es.c: 多发性硬化（以下称为MS）

d: n  优势 if there is a preponderance of people or things of a particular type in a group, there are more of that type than of any other

es.e: There is a preponderance of female students in the music department.
es.c: 在音乐系里女学生占大多数。

d: n  桶 a large curved container with a flat top and bottom, made of wood or metal, and used for storing beer, wine etc

es.e: The wine is aged in oak barrels.
es.c: 这种葡萄酒是用橡木酒桶放陈的。

d: n 链； a series of metal rings which are joined together in a line and used for fastening things, supporting weights, decoration etc；vt  用链条拴住； 联号， 连锁店 to fasten someone or something to something else using a chain, especi

es.e: She had a gold chain around her neck.
es.c: 她脖子上戴了条金项链。

es.e: a length of heavy chain
es.c: 一段沉重的链条

es.e: the Mayor’s chain of office
es.c: 市长的链徽

d: adj  有效的， 有效率的； 有能力的， 能胜任的 if someone or something is efficient, they work well without wasting time, money, or energy

es.e: a very efficient secretary
es.c: 效率高的秘书

es.e: an efficient use of land
es.c: 土地的有效使用

es.e: Lighting is now more energy efficient.
es.c: 如今的照明设备更加节能。

d: vt  统一， 联合 if you unify two or more parts or things, or if they unify, they are combined to make a single unit

es.e: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
es.c: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

es.e: His music unifies traditional and modern themes.
es.c: 他的音乐结合了传统和现代的主题。

d: adj  一致的； 稳定的； 调和的； 始终如一的 a consistent argument or idea does not have any parts that do not match other parts

es.e: The evidence is not consistent.
es.c: 证词前后不一致。

d: v 反转；彻底转变，颠倒；撤销，废除；交换； to change something, such as a decision, judgment, or process so that it is the opposite of what it was before；adj  相反的 the opposite order etc to what is usual or to what has just been stated

es.e: Reverse the paper in the printer.
es.c: 把打印机中的纸翻过来。

d: vt  毁坏； 抢劫， 掠夺 A town, country, or economy that has been ravaged is one that has been damaged so much that it is almost completely destroyed

es.e: The country has been ravaged by civil war.
es.c: 这个国家被内战摧毁了。

d: adj  贫瘠的， 荒芜的； 不结果实的， 不育的 land or soil that is barren has no plants growing on it

es.e: Thousands of years ago the surface was barren desert.
es.c: 很久很久以前，地面还是一片荒漠。

d: n  [fungus的复数]真菌

es.e: Without the fungi, this would be just another sandbar.
es.c: 如果没有真菌，这里将成为另一个沙洲。

es.e: But without fungi we would not have gardens, houses or even feet at all.
es.c: 但是，如果没有真菌，我们就不会有花园、住宅，甚至脚。

es.e: Some of those carbon products transfer from the roots to symbiotic fungi and soil microbes, which store the carbon in the soil as humus.
es.c: 这些含碳化合物有部分从根部被共生真菌和土壤中的微生物摄取，最后变成腐殖质储存在土壤里。

d: adj  持久的， 永久的； 固定不变的 continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future

es.e: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
es.c: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

es.e: a permanent change in your eating habits
es.c: 饮食习惯的永久改变

es.e: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
es.c: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

d: v 鼓励，促进，助长；培养，抚育；领养 to help a skill, feeling, idea etc develop over a period of time；adj  代养的 Foster parents are people who officially take a child into their family for a period of time, without becoming the child's leg

es.e: The bishop helped foster the sense of a community embracing all classes.
es.c: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

es.e: Little Jack was placed with foster parents.
es.c: 小杰克被安置在养父母家。

d: n  容器； 插座 a container for putting things in

es.e: a trash receptacle
es.c: 垃圾箱

d: v  概括， 总结 to make a short statement giving only the main information and not the details of a plan, event, report etc

es.e: The authors summarize their views in the introduction.
es.c: 作者在序言里概述了他们的观点。

d: n 设施；设备；容易；灵巧 Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose

es.e: What recreational facilities are now available?
es.c: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

d: adj  群居的； 合群的， 爱社交的 friendly and preferring to be with other people

es.e: She is such a gregarious and outgoing person.
es.c: 她就是这样一个爱社交而且外向的人。

d: v 面露喜色；发射，播送；照射 to send a radio or television signal through the air, especially to somewhere very distant；n  束， 波束， 光线； 梁； 笑容， 喜色 a wide happy smile

es.e: the first sports broadcast to be beamed across the Atlantic
es.c: 首次向大西洋彼岸播送的体育节目

d: n  鸟嘴， 喙 the hard pointed mouth of a bird

es.e: ...a black bird with a yellow beak.
es.c: …一只有着黄喙的黑鸟。

d: n  小说； 虚构， 编造 books and stories about imaginary people and events

es.e: romantic fiction
es.c: 爱情小说

es.e: historical fiction
es.c: 历史小说

d: n  珠子； 小滴 one of a set of small, usually round, pieces of glass, wood, plastic etc, that you can put on a string and wear as jewellery

es.e: She wore a string of green glass beads around her neck.
es.c: 她脖子上戴着一串绿色的玻璃珠子。

d: vt  替换， 取代； 归还， 把…放回原处 to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing

es.e: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
es.c: 我将接替队里的休。

es.e: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
es.c: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

d: n  航空， 航空学； 飞行 the science or practice of flying in aircraft

es.e: ...the aviation industry.
es.c: …航空工业。

d: n  约会， 约定； 任命， 委派； 职位 an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose

es.e: All consultations are by appointment only .
es.c: 就诊必须预约。

d: vt  合成； 综合 to make something by combining different things or substances

es.e: DDT is a pesticide that was first synthesized in 1874.
es.c: 滴滴涕是最初合成于1874年的杀虫剂。

d: n&v  艰苦跋涉 a long and difficult journey, made especially on foot as an adventure

es.e: a lonely trek through the forest
es.c: 穿越森林的孤独跋涉

d: v 压碎，挤压；挤进，塞入；制止 to press something into a flatter shape, often breaking or damaging it；n  软式墙网球， 壁球； 果汁汽水 a game played by two people who use  rackets  to hit a small rubber ball against the walls of a square court

es.e: The cake got a bit squashed on the way here.
es.c: 蛋糕在送来这里的路上有点压坏了。

es.e: Move over - you’re squashing me.
es.c: 挪过去点，你挤着我了。

d: vi  主修， 专攻；adj 较大的；主要的；主修的 having very serious or worrying results；n 专业 the main subject that a student studies at college or university

es.e: Why do you like your major?
es.c: 你为什么喜欢你的主修科目?。

es.e: What are your major subject and minor subject?
es.c: 你的主修科目和辅修科目是什么?。

d: n  剧作家 someone who writes plays

es.e: The playwright does something remarkable in this scene, but without any impression of straining after an effect.
es.c: 剧作家在这场中有许多惊人妙笔，但并不给人留下竭力追求表面效果的印象。

es.e: His plays have been translated into every major living language and are performed more often than those of any other playwright.
es.c: 他的剧本被翻译成所有主要使用着的语言，并且表演次数远远超过其他任何剧作家。

es.e: An English teacher's life is disrupted when a former student returns to her small town after failing as a playwright in New York.
es.c: 以前的一个学生时，返回失败后，她的小城镇作为一个剧作家在纽约的一名英语教师的生活被打乱。

d: v  打扰； 中断； 阻碍 to stop someone from continuing what they are saying or doing by suddenly speaking to them, making a noise etc

es.e: Will you stop interrupting me!
es.c: 别打断我的话！

es.e: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
es.c: 很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。

d: v 打拍子，指挥；敲打；打败，胜过；跳动 to get the most points, votes etc in a game, race, or competition；adj  疲惫的；n 跳动；节拍，节奏；有规律的敲击 one of a series of regular movements or hitting actions

es.e: Brazil were beaten 2–1.
es.c: 巴西队以1比2告负。

es.e: Labour easily beat the Conservatives in the last election.
es.c: 工党在上一届选举中轻松击败保守党。

d: adj  可行的， 行得通的 a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work

es.e: a feasible solution
es.c: 可行的解决方法

d: v  开处方； 规定； 指示 to say what medicine or treatment a sick person should have

es.e: What punishment does the law prescribe for this crime?
es.c: 法律规定这种罪行应受何处罚？

d: v  校对， 校正 to read through something that is written or printed in order to correct any mistakes in it

es.e: I didn't even have the chance to proofread my own report.
es.c: 我甚至没有机会校对自己的报告。

d: adj  潜在的； 可能的 likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future；n 潜能，潜力 the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect

es.e: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
es.c: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

d: vi  懒洋洋地站 to stand, sit, or lie in a lazy or relaxed way；n 等候室，休息室 a  waiting room  at an airport

es.e: Nathan was lounging on the grass bank outside the cottage.
es.c: 内森正懒洋洋地躺在小屋外的草堤上。

d: adj 总的，毛的；粗俗的，粗野的；令人不快的 a gross sum of money is the total amount before any tax or costs have been taken away；vt 总收入为 If a person or a business grosses a particular amount of money, they earn that amount of money before

es.e: a gross profit of $5 million
es.c: 500万美元的毛利

es.e: The company grossed $16.8 million last year.
es.c: 该公司去年税前收入为1680万美元。

d: v  抵抗； 耐， 抗 to try to prevent a change from happening, or prevent yourself from being forced to do something

es.e: He resisted pressure to resign.
es.c: 他顶住压力，没辞职。

d: n 档案室 a place where a large number of historical records are stored, or the records that are stored；vt  存档 to put documents, books, information etc in an archive

es.e: an archive of the writer’s unpublished work
es.c: 那位作家未发表作品的档案

d: v  解除武装； 裁军； 消除， 消解 to reduce the size of your army, navy etc, and the number of your weapons

es.e: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
es.c: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。

d: v  外推； 推断， 推知 to use facts about the present or about one thing or group to make a guess about the future or about other things or groups

es.e: Extrapolating from his latest findings, he reckons about 80% of these deaths might be attributed to smoking.
es.c: 从他最近的发现推断，他估计大约80%的这类死亡可能归因于吸烟。

d: vt  刺激； 激励， 激发 to encourage someone by making them excited about and interested in something

es.e: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father.
es.c: 她对艺术的兴趣是她父亲激发的。

d: n  互惠， 互助； 互惠主义 a situation in which two people, groups, or countries give each other similar kinds of help or special rights

es.e: They said they would press for reciprocity with Greece in the issuing of visas.
es.c: 他们说，他们将会对希腊施压，以达成签证发放的互惠。

d: vt 遮住光；使相形见绌；n  日食， 月食 an occasion when the sun or the moon cannot be seen, because the Earth is passing directly between the moon and the sun, or because the moon is passing directly between the Earth and the sun

es.e: an eclipse of the sun
es.c: 日食

es.e: a total eclipse
es.c: 全食

d: adj 正方形的；成直角的，方的；平方的 having four straight equal sides and 90˚ angles at the corners；n 正方形；广场；平方 a shape with four straight equal sides with 90˚ angles at the corners；vt  使成正方形； 求平方； 使打成平局 to multiply a number by itself

es.e: a large square room
es.c: 一个正方形的大房间

d: adj  粗心的， 疏忽的； 无忧无虑的； 不关心的， 冷漠的 not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes, damage things etc

es.e: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
es.c: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

es.e: a careless mistake
es.c: 粗心造成的错误

es.e: careless driving
es.c: 粗心驾驶

d: v  浸泡， 浸湿， 浸透 if you soak something, or if you let it soak, you keep it covered with a liquid for a period of time, especially in order to make it softer or easier to clean

es.e: Soak the clothes in cold water.
es.c: 把衣服浸泡在冷水里。

es.e: Let the pans soak; I’ll wash them later.
es.c: 把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

d: vt  消除； 抵消 to reduce or prevent the bad effect of something, by doing something that has the opposite effect

es.e: They gave him drugs to counteract his withdrawal symptoms.
es.c: 他们给他服药以消除他的脱瘾症状。

d: adj  荒废的， 空无一人的； 被离弃的， 被遗弃的 empty and quiet because no people are there

es.e: The streets were deserted.
es.c: 街上空无一人。

es.e: The old mine now stands completely deserted .
es.c: 那座旧矿现在完全废弃了。

d: v  上下班往返， 经常往返； 代偿； 减刑 to change the punishment given to a criminal to one that is less severe

es.e: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
es.c: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

d: vt  保持， 维持； 支持， 支撑； 经受， 承受 to make something continue to exist or happen for a period of time

es.e: She found it difficult to sustain the children’s interest.
es.c: 她发现很难保持孩子们的兴趣。

es.e: He was incapable of sustaining close relationships with women.
es.c: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

es.e: the policies necessary to sustain economic growth
es.c: 维持经济增长必需的政策

d: n  无政府主义者 someone who believes that governments, laws etc are not necessary

es.e: West Berlin always had a large anarchist community.
es.c: 西柏林一直存在一个大的无政府主义群体。

d: vt  分类； 分等 to decide what group something belongs to

es.e: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
es.c: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

es.e: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
es.c: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

d: n 海拔，高度； the height of an object or place above the sea

es.e: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
es.c: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

d: n&vt  要求， 请求 a polite or formal demand for something

es.e: To request more information, please call our toll free number.
es.c: 欲知详情，请拨打我们的免费电话。

d: n  群， 群体； 殖民地； 聚居地 a country or area that is under the political control of a more powerful country, usually one that is far away

es.e: Algeria was formerly a French colony.
es.c: 阿尔及利亚以前是法国的殖民地。

d: n  四轮马车； 货车 a strong vehicle with four wheels, used for carrying heavy loads and usually pulled by horses

es.e: In the wagon.
es.c: 在货车里。

d: adj  数字的

es.c: 说明：在从数字到字符科协截断有效数字。

es.c: 复杂介质中地震波的传播多是通过求取单程或双程波动方程的数值解进行模拟的。

d: n  首次演出； 初次亮相 the first public appearance of an entertainer, sports player etc or of something new and important

es.c: 她在1937年《哈姆雷特》的演出中首次登台。

d: vt  支持， 维护； 维持 to defend or support a law, system, or principle so that it continues to exist

es.e: a committee that aims to uphold educational standards
es.c: 旨在保持教育水准的委员会

d: n 维，元；尺寸；方面；特点； a part of a situation or a quality involved in it

es.e: You can have a spiritual dimension to your life without being religious.
es.c: 即使你不信宗教，也可以在生命中拥有精神层面的内容。

d: n  思乡病， 乡愁； 怀旧之情， 恋旧 Nostalgia is an affectionate feeling you have for the past, especially for a particularly happy time

es.e: He might be influenced by nostalgia for the surroundings of his happy youth.
es.c: 他也许被他对快乐青年时代的环境的怀念影响了。

d: v  应得， 值得 to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour

es.e: What have I done to deserve this?
es.c: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

es.e: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
es.c: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

es.e: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
es.c: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

d: vt 加工，处理 to make food, materials, or goods ready to be used or sold, for example by preserving or improving them in some way；n  过程； 程序， 手续； 工序， 制作法 a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular resul

es.c: 山羊奶干酪可以有多种加工方法。

es.c: 200 万名工人受雇为电子公司加工产品。

d: n  工匠， 手艺人 someone who does skilled work, making things with their hands
v 发芽，抽条，生长；迅速出现，涌现出 if vegetables, seeds, or plants sprout, they start to grow, producing  shoots  ,  buds  , or leaves；n  新芽， 嫩枝， 苗 a new growth on a plant

es.e: Move the pots outside when the seeds begin to sprout.
es.c: 种子开始发芽时把盆搬到外面去。

es.e: Trees were starting to sprout new leaves.
es.c: 树上开始抽出新叶。

d: vt  恢复； 修复； 归还， 交还 to make something return to its former state or condition

es.e: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
es.c: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

es.e: The National Guard was called in to restore order (= make people stop fighting and breaking the law ) when riots broke out.
es.c: 暴乱爆发后，国民警卫队被调来恢复秩序。

es.e: initiatives to restore peace in the Middle East
es.c: 恢复中东和平的倡议

d: adj  黏滞的， 黏性的 a viscous liquid is thick and sticky and does not flow easily

es.e: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
es.c: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。

d: adj  思乡的； 怀旧的 if you feel nostalgic about a time in the past, you feel happy when you remember it, and in some ways you wish that things had not changed

es.e: Seeing those old school photographs has made me feel quite nostalgic.
es.c: 看到那些学生时代的旧照片，我不禁产生了怀旧之情。

es.e: a nostalgic look back at the 1950s
es.c: 对20世纪50年代的怀念

d: adj  可供替代的； 非传统的 an alternative idea, plan etc is different from the one you have and can be used instead；n 可供选择的事物；选择的自由，选择的余地 something you can choose to do or use instead of something else

es.e: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
es.c: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

d: n  横幅 a long piece of cloth on which something is written, often carried between two poles

es.e: The onlookers were shouting, cheering, and waving banners.
es.c: 观众挥动着横幅，又是叫喊又是欢呼。

d: vt&v  偶然碰到； 遭遇 to experience something, especially problems or opposition

es.e: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
es.c: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

d: n  苏打， 纯碱 water that contains bubbles and is often added to alcoholic drinks

es.e: a Scotch and soda
es.c: 一杯加苏打水的苏格兰威士忌

d: n  山崩， 塌方； 压倒性胜利 a sudden fall of a lot of earth or rocks down a hill, cliff etc

es.e: a landslide election victory
es.c: 压倒性的选举胜利

d: n  大草原 a wide open area of fairly flat land in North America which is covered in grass or wheat

es.c: 大约有160种珍稀鸟类栖息在这里的沼泽地和大草原上。

es.e: How many an afternoon antinia and i have trailed along the prairie under the magnificence .
es.c: 有多少个下午，我同安东妮亚在大草原上这种壮丽的景色中慢慢地走着啊！

es.e: From your English garden variety to your prairie wildflower, floral prints tell a sweet story.
es.c: 从英式花园的百花齐放到大草原的野花儿，印花叙述着甜美的故事。

d: v  批准； 赞成 to officially accept a plan, proposal etc

es.e: The conference approved a proposal for a referendum.
es.c: 会议通过了举行全民公决的提议。

d: v  擦破， 擦痛； 恼怒， 焦躁 if a part of your body chafes or if something chafes it, it becomes sore because of something rubbing against it

es.e: Wear a T-shirt under your wet suit to stop it chafing.
es.c: 在潜水服里面穿一件T恤防止蹭痛皮肤。

d: v  咀嚼； 思量， 熟思 to bite food several times before swallowing it

es.e: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
es.c: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

d: n  住处， 住所 the place where someone lives

es.e: Military service entails frequent changes of domicile.
es.c: 服兵役需要频繁更换住所。

d: adj  徒步的； 缺乏想象力的 ordinary and uninteresting and without any imagination；n 步行者，行人 someone who is walking, especially along a street or other place used by cars

es.e: a painting that is pedestrian and unimaginative
es.c: 乏味又缺乏想象力的画作

es.e: a rather pedestrian student
es.c: 一名相当平庸的学生

d: v 使加快，催促；赶快，匆忙 to do something or go somewhere more quickly than usual, especially because there is not much time；n  急忙， 匆忙， 仓促 more quickly than usual

es.e: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
es.c: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

es.e: I hate having to hurry a meal.
es.c: 我讨厌匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

es.e: We’ll have to hurry, otherwise we’ll miss the start.
es.c: 我们得赶紧，否则就会错过开头部分了。

d: v 说明，解释；占；n  解释， 描述， 叙述； 账目； 账户 a written or spoken description that says what happens in an event or process

es.e: Chomsky’s account of how children learn their first language
es.c: 乔姆斯基关于儿童如何学习第一语言的描述

d: adj  放射性的， 有辐射的 a radioactive substance is dangerous because it contains  radiation (= a form of energy that can harm living things )

es.e: the problem of how to dispose of radioactive waste
es.c: 如何处理放射性废物的问题

es.e: a consignment of highly radioactive plutonium
es.c: 发送的一批高放射性钚

d: adj  天真的； 清白的； 无恶意的 not guilty of a crime

es.e: Nobody would believe that I was innocent.
es.c: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

es.e: The court found him innocent and he was released.
es.c: 法庭判他无罪，他被释放了。

d: n  字母表 a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing

es.e: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
es.c: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

d: n 大步；步法； a long step you make while you are walking

es.e: Paco reached the door in only three strides.
es.c: 帕科三大步就走到了门口。

d: v 前进，向前移动；发展，进步；促进；预付 to move towards someone or something, especially in a slow and determined way – used especially to talk about soldiers；adj  预先的； 先头的 Advance booking, notice, or warning is done or given before an ev

es.c: 一列美军坦克缓缓前进。

es.e: They don't normally give any advance notice about which building they're going to inspect.
es.c: 他们对要视察哪座大楼通常不作事先通知。

d: vt  赏识； 鉴赏， 欣赏； 感激 used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done

es.e: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
es.c: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

es.e: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
es.c: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

es.e: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
es.c: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

d: v  变白， 漂白 to make something pale or white, especially by using chemicals or the sun；n 漂白剂 a chemical used to make things pale or white, or to kill  germ s

es.e: She bleached her hair blonde.
es.c: 她把头发漂成了金黄色。

es.e: The wood had been bleached by the sun .
es.c: 木头已被太阳晒得褪了色。

d: adj  不同的； 多样的 very different from each other

es.e: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
es.c: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

d: v 集合，召集；恢复，重新振作 to come together, or to bring people together, to support an idea, a political party etc；n  集会， 大会 a large public meeting, especially one that is held outdoors to support a political idea, protest etc

es.e: an attempt to rally support for the party
es.c: 为政党争取支持的努力

d: adj  柔软的； 柔和的； 不强烈的； 心肠软的； 软性的 having a surface that is smooth and pleasant to touch

es.c: 婴儿细嫩的皮肤

es.c: 这皮毛摸起来很柔滑。

d: adj  虚构的； 假的； 假装的， 虚伪的 not true, or not real

es.c: 虚构的人物

d: adj 主要的；最初的；最好的；首先的 most important；n 全盛时期，盛年 the time in your life when you are strongest and most active；vt  使准备好； 事先指点 to prepare someone for a situation so that they know what to do

es.c: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

es.c: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

es.c: 在那宗谋杀案的调查中他被定为主要嫌疑人。

d: n  智力， 理解力； 知识分子 the ability to understand things and to think intelligently

es.c: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

d: vi  缓行， 漫步 to walk slowly in a relaxed way

es.c: 一个老人出来，缓步走过去聊天。

d: adj  忠诚的， 忠贞的 always supporting your friends, principles, country etc

es.c: 球队的忠实支持者

es.c: 她在公司多年的忠诚服务

es.c: 忠实客户

d: n  偏爱； 优先 if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can

es.c: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

es.e: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
es.c: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

es.e: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
es.c: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

d: n  主流， 主要倾向； 主流思想 the most usual ideas or methods, or the people who have these ideas or methods

es.c: 热内起初很叛逆，但不久就回归了文学主流。

d: n  机会， 时机 a chance to do something or an occasion when it is easy for you to do something

es.c: 今年新毕业的大学生就业机会较少。

es.c: 这无法在法庭上证实。

es.c: 这场诉讼持续了六个星期。

es.e: Four people will appear in court today, charged with fraud.
es.c: 今天将有四个人因被指控犯有欺诈罪出庭受审。

es.c: 贝唐每个星期天都去教堂做礼拜。

es.c: 一个附带假设

es.c: 天黑以后，他就会壮着胆子出去。

d: adj  腐蚀的 a corrosive liquid such as an acid can destroy metal, plastic etc

es.c: 一种腐蚀性很强的物质

d: n  热情； 积极性； 热衷的事物 a strong feeling of interest and enjoyment about something and an eagerness to be involved in it

es.c: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

es.e: We went along to the local diving club, full of enthusiasm.
es.c: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

es.e: They go about their tasks with little enthusiasm.
es.c: 他们执行任务时没多大干劲。

d: vt  洞悉； 识别

es.c: 宾特先生有一种将决定拖到最后一分钟的倾向。

d: v  乞求， 恳求， 请求 to ask someone, in a very emotional way, to do something for you

es.e: He entreated them to delay their departure.
es.c: 他恳求他们晚些再走。

d: adj  易弯曲的； 柔韧的； 灵活的， 可变通的 a person, plan etc that is flexible can change or be changed easily to suit any new situation

es.c: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

es.c: 政府在处理教育问题上需要更加灵活。

d: adj  敏捷的， 灵活的 able to move quickly and easily

es.c: 狗出奇地敏捷。

d: vi  正式脱离， 退出 if a country or state secedes from another country, it officially stops being part of it and becomes independent

d: adj 内部的；内地的 inside or indoors；n  内部； [the ～]内陆 the inner part or inside of something

es.c: 室内墙壁都粉刷成了白色。

es.c: 对那些人来说，土地和生活本身紧密交织在一起。

d: vt  唤起， 唤醒； 激起， 鼓舞； 激怒 to wake someone who is sleeping deeply

es.c: 他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

es.c: 该国的生产能力

es.c: 我能讲法语，但是同声传译我做不了。

es.c: 哈雷彗星

es.c: 苏格兰长老会大会

d: adj  感情的， 情绪的； 引起情感的； 易动感情的 relating to your feelings or how you control them

es.c: 安患了抑郁症，还遇到一些其他的情绪问题。

es.c: 患者的生理和情绪状态

es.c: 显而易见，他们中的许多人对这个问题都避而不答。

es.c: 一大群人聚集在美国大使馆外。

es.c: 她收集了一些自己最喜欢听的歌。

d: n  冬眠； 休眠， 蛰伏

es.c: 大约有五千人在市里游行示威，抗议关闭工厂。

d: v  击退， 驱逐； 排斥； 抵制， 拒绝； 使反感， 使厌恶 if something repels you, it is so unpleasant that you do not want to be near it, or it makes you feel ill

es.c: 这气味让他反感。

d: n  海岸， 海滨 the land at the edge of the sea, consisting of sand and rocks

es.c: 她从她在海岸边发现的贝壳和石头里获取灵感。

d: vt  耕种； 培养 to plant and take care of a particular crop

es.c: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

es.c: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

d: adj  富有想象力的； 创新的 containing new and interesting ideas

es.c: 儿童富有想象力的游戏

d: vt  代表； 表现； 描绘； 象征 to officially speak or take action for another person or group of people

d: vt&n  分派， 派遣； 发送 to send someone or something somewhere for a particular purpose

es.e: a corpus of spoken English
es.c: 英语口语语料库

es.c: 你能10:30来吗？我知道这不方便，但是我必须要见你。

d: v  改编成戏剧； 戏剧化， 戏剧性地表现 to make a book or event into a play or film

es.c: 被改编成电视剧的小说

d: adj  可笑的， 荒唐的 completely stupid or unreasonable

es.c: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

d: adj  在…前的； 优先的 existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation

es.c: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

es.c: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

es.c: 经事先协商可提供素食。

es.c: 一根27号针

es.c: 威廉斯老师没收了我们所有的糖果。

d: adj  子女的； 子孙后代的 relating to the relationship of a son or daughter to their parents

es.c: 台风是热带气旋的一个类别。在气象学上，按世界气象组织定义：热带气旋中心持续风速达到12级。

es.c: 昆虫的叮咬

es.c: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

d: vi  预示 If something bodes ill, it makes you think that something bad will happen in the future. If something bodes well, it makes you think that something good will happen.

es.e: She says the way the bill was passed bodes ill for democracy.
es.c: 她说议案通过的方式预示民主的恶运。

d: adv  已， 已经 before now, or before a particular time

es.c: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

es.c: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

d: n  普韦布洛印第安人村落； 普韦布洛人 A pueblo is a village, especially in the southwestern United States

es.c: 圣达菲附近有几十个印第安人村庄。

d: adj  可应用的， 可实施的； 适当的， 合适的 if something is applicable to a particular person, group, or situation, it affects them or is related to them

es.c: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

d: n  全景， 全貌； 概观， 综述 an impressive view of a wide area of land

es.c: 霍顿眺望着那一片肥沃山谷和平缓山脉的景象。

es.c: 事实证明美国宪法能适应政治形势的变化。

d: adj 当代的； belonging to the present time

d: n  可信性， 真实性； 信任； 信念 the acceptance of something as true

es.c: 要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。

es.c: 测量杆

es.c: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

es.c: 一知道我们在哪里，刘易斯就每隔几小时发一份电报来。

es.c: 我不愿意让她失望。

es.e: Great things were expected of this band, and they didn’t disappoint.
es.c: 大家对这支乐队的期望很高，而他们也不负众望。

d: adj  反叛的， 叛逆的； 叛乱的 deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour

es.c: 叛逆的青少年

es.c: 他向来个性叛逆。

es.c: 添加在粉末涂料中的能够改善如流动性、光泽和纹理控制的一些材料。

es.c: 税收制度的彻底改革

es.c: 这两个组织有着根本差异。

es.c: 河水变成了翻滚的洪流。

es.c: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

es.e: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
es.c: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

es.e: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
es.c: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

d: adv 垂直地，陡峭地 straight up or down in an almost vertical line；vi  急转， 偏离；adj 陡峭的；完全的，十足的，全然的；绝对的；极薄的 a sheer drop, cliff, slope etc is very steep and almost vertical

es.e: cliffs which rose sheer from the sea
es.c: 从海面垂直拔起的悬崖

d: n  模仿， 仿效； 仿制； 仿造品 when you copy someone else’s actions

es.e: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
es.c: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

d: vt  赞美， 称赞 to say something nice to someone in order to praise them；n  赞美； a remark that shows you admire someone or something

es.e: The groom was so nervous he forgot to compliment the bridesmaids.
es.c: 新郎太紧张了，都忘了夸奖伴娘。

d: n  奇事， 奇迹 something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible

es.e: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
es.c: 你没有死真是奇迹！

es.e: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
es.c: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

es.e: the economic miracle of the 1950s
es.c: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

d: vt 冲洗，漂洗，冲刷 to wash clothes, dishes, vegetables etc quickly with water, especially running water, and without soap；n  漂洗， 冲洗， 洗涤； 染发剂 when you rinse something

es.e: Let me just rinse my hands.
es.c: 让我冲个手。

es.e: Rinse the vegetables under a cold tap.
es.c: 把蔬菜放在冷水龙头下冲洗。

d: vi 总计 If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total；n  总额 a quantity of something such as time, money, or a substance

es.e: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to $9.75 billion.
es.c: 消费者在体育相关用品上的消费总共达到了97.5亿美元。

d: vi  服从； 遵守 to do what you have to do or are asked to do

es.e: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
es.c: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

d: vt 使衰竭；削弱，逐渐破坏 If something saps your strength or confidence, it gradually weakens or destroys it；n  液， 汁； 精力； 笨蛋 the watery substance that carries food through a plant

es.e: I was afraid the sickness had sapped my strength.
es.c: 恐怕这场病已经消耗了我的力气。

d: vt  用妖术迷惑； 迷住， 使入迷 to cause to be spellbound; entrance or enthral
n  花蜜； 甘美的饮料， 琼浆玉液 the sweet liquid that bees collect from flowers
adj  封建的 relating to feudalism

es.e: the feudal system
es.c: 封建制度

es.e: feudal society
es.c: 封建社会

d: n  王国； 领域， 界 a country ruled by a king or queen

es.e: the United Kingdom
es.c: 联合王国

d: v 展开；蔓延，扩散；散布；涂，敷 if something spreads or is spread, it becomes larger or moves so that it affects more people or a larger area；n  传播， 蔓延； 涉及幅度， 活动范围 when something affects or is known about by more people or involves a

es.e: She spread a towel on the sand and lay on it.
es.c: 她把一块浴巾铺在沙地上，然后躺在上面。

d: n  木偶； 玩偶； 傀儡， 受人操纵的人 a model of a person or animal that you move by pulling wires or strings, or by putting your hand inside it

es.e: When the invasion occurred he seized power and ruled the country as a puppet of the occupiers.
es.c: 他趁入侵之时夺取了政权，作为占领者的傀儡统治着这个国家。

d: adj  受过教育的， 有教养的 having been well taught and learned a lot

es.e: a highly educated woman
es.c: 很有修养的女子

d: n  帮助； 赞同， 支持； 偏爱
adj 后面的，后半期的；后者的 being the second of two people or things, or the last in a list just mentioned；n  后者 the second of two people or things just mentioned

es.e: In the latter case, buyers pay a 15% commission.
es.c: 在后一种情况下，买家付15%的佣金。

d: n  门诊部， 诊所 a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital

es.e: an appointment at an outpatient clinic
es.c: 门诊预约

d: vt  使隶属于 if a group or organization affiliates to or with another larger one, it forms a close connection with it；n  分公司 a company, organization etc that is connected with or controlled by a larger one

es.e: He wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed expert advice in legal affairs.
es.c: 他想成为一家美国公司的会员，因为他需要法律事务方面的专家意见。

d: adv  简单地， 简明地； 简直； 仅仅， 只； 朴素地， 简朴地 only

es.e: Some students lose marks simply because they don’t read the question properly.
es.c: 有些学生丢分只是因为没有好好读题目。

es.e: It’s not simply a question of money.
es.c: 这不仅仅是钱的问题。

es.e: What we need is not simply a smaller organization, but a more efficient one.
es.c: 我们需要的不仅仅是一个精简的机构，而是一个更有效率的机构。

d: adj  隐性的 a recessive  gene  is passed to children from their parents only if both parents have the gene

es.e: In normal seedlings the deleterious recessive genes are not expressed.
es.c: 有害的隐性基因在正常菌木中不表现出来。

es.e: An example of negative eugenics would be the attempt to eradicate a harmful recessive gene.
es.c: 消极优生学的范例是试图破坏一种对人体有害的隐性基因。

es.e: Most plants carry a large genetic load for deleterious recessive genes of which a few are homozygous and depress growth.
es.c: 多数植物带有大量有害的隐性基因的“遗传负荷”，其中少数是纯合的，因而降低了生长。

d: adj  相同的； 相当的 having the same value, purpose, job etc as a person or thing of a different kind；n 对等物；等价物 something that has the same value, purpose, job etc as something else

es.e: I had no dollars, but offered him an equivalent amount of sterling.
es.c: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

d: adj  片刻的， 瞬间的， 暂时的 continuing for a very short time

es.e: There was a momentary pause.
es.c: 停顿了片刻。

d: adj  伪善的， 虚伪的 behaving in a way that is different from what you claim to believe – used to show disapproval

es.e: It would be hypocritical to say I travel at 70 mph simply because that is the law.
es.c: 如果仅仅因为法律规定的时速是70英里我就说自己的行驶时速是70英里，那就太虚伪了。

d: adj  狭窄的； 收缩的； 抑制的， 约束的
adj  轰动性的， 引起哗然的， 耸人听闻的； 〈口〉极好的， 绝妙的 very interesting, exciting, and surprising

es.e: a sensational discovery
es.c: 引起轰动的发现

es.e: The show was a sensational success.
es.c: 这次演出取得了轰动性的成功。

es.e: a sensational 6-0 victory
es.c: 轰动性的6比0大胜

d: vi 乘独木舟，划独木舟 to travel by canoe；n  独木舟 a long light boat that is pointed at both ends and which you move along using a  paddle

es.e: Get out on the water - Rent a sailboat, rowboat, paddleboat, kayak, or canoe. Grab a pole and go fishing or don your swimsuit and jump in.
es.c: 水上约会活动——你可以租一艘帆船，皮划艇，划艇，皮艇，或独木舟。有了船，你可以划船和钓鱼，或是穿上泳衣潜水去。

d: n 楔子；楔形物 a piece of wood, metal etc that has one thick edge and one pointed edge and is used especially for keeping a door open or for splitting wood；vt  ■入， 塞入 If you wedge something somewhere, you fit it there tightly

es.e: Garnish with lemon wedges.
es.c: 用几角柠檬片作装饰。

es.e: Wedge the plug into the hole.
es.c: 把塞子塞进洞里。

d: vt  使疏远， 使不友好； 转让， 让渡 to make it difficult for someone to belong to a particular group or to feel comfortable with a particular person

es.e: The latest tax proposals will alienate many voters.
es.c: 最新的纳税提案将失去远许多选民的支持。

d: v 唤醒；醒；觉醒，醒悟 to wake up, or to make someone wake up；adj  醒着的； 警觉的 not sleeping

es.e: It was midday when she awoke.
es.c: 她醒来时已是中午。

es.e: We awoke to a day of brilliant sunshine.
es.c: 我们醒来时阳光明媚。

d: vt 困扰，使苦恼；纠缠 to cause pain, suffering, or trouble to someone, especially for a long period of time；n  鼠疫； 传染病； 祸患， 灾害 a disease that causes death and spreads quickly to a large number of people

es.e: Financial problems continued to plague the company.
es.c: 资金问题持续困扰着该公司。

d: adj  连续不断的； 永久的， 长期的 continuing all the time without changing or stopping

es.e: the perpetual noise of the machines
es.c: 机器连续不断的噪音

es.e: a little girl with a perpetual smile
es.c: 总是带着微笑的小女孩

d: n  回顾， 反顾 thinking back to a time in the past, especially with the advantage of knowing more now than you did then

es.e: In retrospect, I wonder if we should have done more.
es.c: 回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

d: v  深深吸引， 迷住 if someone or something fascinates you, you are attracted to them and think they are extremely interesting

es.e: The idea of travelling through time fascinates me.
es.c: 穿越时光的想法深深吸引着我。

d: v 提供；自愿给予；提出，提议 to ask someone if they would like to have something, or to hold something out to them so that they can take it；n  提议； 报价， 出价； 特价 a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give

es.e: I don’t need any help, but it was nice of you to offer.
es.c: 我不需要任何帮助，但是我谢谢你的好意。

d: adj  外交的， 从事外交的； 有策略的， 有手腕的， 老练的 relating to or involving the work of diplomats

es.e: Diplomatic efforts to end the fighting began on October 25.
es.c: 停战的外交努力于10月25日开始。

d: n  放映机， 幻灯机， 投影仪 a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface

es.e: ...a slide projector.
es.c: …幻灯机。

d: adj  供役使的；n 草图，草稿；汇票；气流 a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form；vt 起草；征募，选派 to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form

es.e: the rough draft of his new novel
es.c: 他的新小说的草稿

es.e: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
es.c: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

es.e: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
es.c: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

d: adj  不情愿的， 勉强的 If you are loath to do something, you do not want to do it

es.e: Sensing he held the advantage, Mr. Danbar was loath to change the subject.
es.c: 丹巴先生觉得占有优势，不愿改变话题。

d: adj  合成的， 综合的； 复杂的， 错综的， 难以理解的 consisting of many different parts and often difficult to understand；n  建筑群； 综合体， 集合体； 情结 a group of buildings, or a large building with many parts, used for a particular purpose

es.e: a complex system of highways
es.c: 复杂的公路网

es.e: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
es.c: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

es.e: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
es.c: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

d: n  湿度； 潮湿 the amount of water contained in the air

es.e: The room is kept at 72 degrees and 50% relative humidity.
es.c: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

d: adj  液体的； 流动的 fluid movements are smooth, relaxed, and graceful；n 液体，流体 a liquid

es.e: a loose, fluid style of dancing
es.c: 舒展而优美的舞姿

d: n  小册子 a very thin book with paper covers, that gives information about something

es.e: a political pamphlet
es.c: 政治宣传册

d: adj  有益健康的 likely to make you healthy

es.e: healthful mountain air
es.c: 有利于健康的山区空气

d: vt  安排； 假定 to suggest that a particular idea should be accepted as a fact

es.e: Several writers have posited the idea of a universal consciousness.
es.c: 几个作者都假设一种普遍意识的思想。

d: adj  华丽的， 豪华的 covered with a lot of decoration

es.e: an ornate gold mirror
es.c: 华丽的金镜子

d: n  首府； 大都市 a very large city that is the most important city in a country or area

es.e: The city has become a huge, bustling metropolis.
es.c: 这座城市已变成繁忙的大都市。

d: n  文件； 归档， 文献记录 the act of recording information in writing, on film etc

es.e: Applicants must provide supporting documentation .
es.c: 申请人必须提供证明文件。

d: vi  激增， 迅速繁殖 if something proliferates, it increases quickly and spreads to many different places

es.e: Computer courses continue to proliferate.
es.c: 计算机课程层出不穷。

d: adj  个人的， 私人的； 亲自的 belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general

es.e: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
es.c: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

es.e: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
es.c: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

es.e: She took full personal responsibility for all the arrangements.
es.c: 她个人对所有的安排承担全部责任。

d: adj  塑料的； 可塑的； 做作的， 虚伪的 made of plastic；n 塑料 a light strong material that is produced by a chemical process, and which can be made into different shapes when it is soft

es.e: a plastic spoon
es.c: 塑料汤匙

es.e: plastic bags
es.c: 塑料袋

d: v 耽搁，延迟 to wait until a later time to do something；n  耽搁， 延迟 when someone or something has to wait, or the length of the waiting time

es.e: Don’t delay – send off for the information now.
es.c: 别犹豫——即刻去函索取信息。

es.e: He delayed his decision on whether to call an election.
es.c: 在是否宣布举行选举一事上，他推迟作出决定。

d: n  冲击； 攻击， 猛攻 a large violent attack by an army

es.e: The press launched another vicious onslaught on the president.
es.c: 新闻界对这位总统进行了新一轮的恶毒抨击。

d: adj  短暂的， 转瞬即逝的； 临时的 continuing only for a short time

es.e: transient fashions
es.c: 短暂的时尚

d: n  坏名声， 不光彩 a situation in which people no longer admire or trust someone or something

es.e: He faces six charges of bringing the game into disrepute .
es.c: 他面临六项破坏这项运动声誉的指控。

es.e: This theory fell into disrepute in the fifties.
es.c: 这一理论在50年代时声誉尽失。

d: n  木板； 政策要点， 政纲的核心 a long narrow piece of wooden board, used especially for making structures to walk on

es.e: a long plank of wood
es.c: 一长条厚木板

es.e: a bridge made of planks
es.c: 用厚木板搭成的桥

d: n  全盛期 the time when someone or something was most popular, successful, or powerful

es.e: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
es.c: 该制片厂吹嘘，它在鼎盛时期拥有的明星比天上的星星还多。

d: v  用海绵擦， 揩 to put paint on a surface using a sponge；n 海绵；寄生虫 a piece of a soft natural or artificial substance full of small holes, which can suck up liquid and is used for washing

es.e: Clean the rug by sponging it gently.
es.c: 用湿布轻轻擦洗以清洁小地毯。

d: v  处理， 对付； 给予； 做买卖， 经营 to buy and sell illegal drugs；n 交易，买卖；协议 an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that helps both sides involved

es.e: Many users end up dealing to support their habit.
es.c: 许多吸毒者最后都是靠做毒品买卖来供自己吸毒。

d: n  意大利式细面条 a type of  pasta  in very long thin pieces, that is cooked in boiling water

es.e: Bill: I would like mashed potato and spaghetti.
es.c: 比尔：我想要份土豆泥和意大利面条。

es.e: Dawson: Suppose I tell them how you followed her to that studio in Chelsea and watched them cooking spaghetti and all that rubbish. Wouldn't that ring a bell?
es.c: 道森：假设我告诉他们你怎样尾随她到了切尔西的工作室，看他们煮意大利面条，以及所有那些废话。那不会使他们有所警觉吗?。

d: vt  使隔离， 使隔绝 to cover or protect something with a material that stops electricity, sound, heat etc from getting in or out

es.e: an insulated attic
es.c: 隔热[隔音]的阁楼

d: v  密谋， 秘密策划， 图谋 to secretly make clever and dishonest plans to get or achieve something；n 计划，方案；阴谋；体系，体制 an official plan that is intended to help people in some way, for example by providing education or training

es.e: She’s nothing but a lying, scheming little monster!
es.c: 她就是个爱撒谎、爱算计的小巫婆！

d: vt  影响； 感染 to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation

es.e: the areas affected by the hurricane
es.c: 受飓风影响的地区

es.e: a disease that affects the central nervous system
es.c: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

es.e: decisions which affect our lives
es.c: 影响我们生活的决定

d: v 流走，流出；使耗尽 to use too much of something, especially money, so that there is not enough left；n  下水道， 排水沟； 排放； 消耗 a pipe that carries water or waste liquids away

es.e: Huge imports were draining the country’s currency reserves.
es.c: 大量的进口正在耗尽该国的货币储备。

d: adv  顺利地； 平稳地； 平静地 in a steady way, without stopping and starting again

es.e: Traffic flowed smoothly.
es.c: 路上交通畅通。

d: vt  使隔离， 使孤立 to separate one person, group, or thing from other people or things

es.e: The town was isolated by the floods.
es.c: 洪水使该镇与外界隔绝。

es.e: The US has sought to isolate Cuba both economically and politically.
es.c: 美国一直想在经济和政治上孤立古巴。

d: adj  市民的， 公民的， 平民的； 民事的； 国家的， 政府的； 文明的， 有教养的 relating to the people who live in a country

es.e: They were married in a civil ceremony in May.
es.c: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

d: adj  随后的； 并发的 happening or coming after something else

es.e: These skills were passed on to subsequent generations.
es.c: 这些技能代代相传。

es.e: subsequent pages of the book
es.c: 接下去的书页

d: v  表明， 显示； 指出， 指示； 象征， 预示； 暗示， 间接提及 to show that a particular situation exists, or that something is likely to be true

es.e: The study indicates a connection between poverty and crime.
es.c: 研究显示贫穷和犯罪有关联。

d: adj  新陈代谢的 relating to your body’s metabolism

es.e: Exercise can increase your metabolic rate.
es.c: 运动可以提高新陈代谢率。

es.e: the metabolic activity of the brain
es.c: 大脑的新陈代谢活动

d: n  完成， 实现； 结束 the state of being finished

es.e: The house is nearing completion (= almost finished ) .
es.c: 房子即将完工。

es.e: The project has a completion date of December 22nd.
es.c: 该项目的完成日期是12月22日。

d: vt  包含， 容纳； 控制； 防止…蔓延 if something such as a bag, box, or place contains something, that thing is inside it

es.e: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
es.c: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

es.e: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
es.c: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

d: v  乱扔； 使凌乱 if things litter an area, there are a lot of them in that place, scattered in an untidy way；n 废弃物，垃圾；一窝幼崽 waste paper, cans etc that people have thrown away and left on the ground in a public place

es.e: Clothes littered the floor.
es.c: 衣服扔了一地。

d: v  缝， 做针线活； 缝补， 缝上 to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes or to fasten something such as a button to them

es.e: I learned to sew at school.

es.c: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

d: adj  茂盛的 plants that are lush grow many leaves and look healthy and strong

es.e: a lush green mountainous island
es.c: 草木茂盛苍翠、山峦起伏的岛

es.e: The fields were lush with grass and flowers.
es.c: 田野里花草繁茂。

d: vt  建立， 设立； 安置， 使定居； 确定， 证实 to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time

es.e: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
es.c: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

es.e: Our goal is to establish a new research centre in the North.
es.c: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

d: adj 巨大的 extremely large；n  猛犸， 毛象 an animal like a large hairy  elephant  that lived on Earth thousands of years ago

es.e: Reforming the prison system would be a mammoth task.
es.c: 改革监狱制度将是一项巨大的任务。

es.e: a mammoth corporation
es.c: 庞大的公司

d: adj  相关的， 有关的； 中肯的， 贴切的； 有价值的， 有意义的 directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered

es.e: Relevant documents were presented in court.
es.c: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

es.e: We received all the relevant information.
es.c: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

d: v  威慑， 阻止 To deter someone from doing something means to make them not want to do it or continue doing it

es.e: Supporters of the death penalty argue that it would deter criminals from carrying guns.
es.c: 死刑的支持者辩称，死刑可以阻止罪犯携带枪支。

d: adj 合成的，综合的；人造的 produced by combining different artificial substances, rather than being naturally produced

es.e: synthetic chemicals
es.c: 合成化学品

d: v  宣布， 声明； 显示 to say publicly or officially that something important is true or exists

es.e: The President proclaimed the republic’s independence.
es.c: 总统宣布共和国独立。

d: v  捆成一束； 聚集 to hold or tie things together in a bunch；n 簇，束，捆；帮，伙 a group of things that are fastened, held, or growing together

es.e: The ancient Egyptians were a clever bunch.
es.c: 古埃及人很聪明。

d: v 震动，颠簸；震惊 to move suddenly and roughly, or to make someone or something move in this way；n  震动， 颠簸； 震惊； 一阵强烈的感情等 a sudden shock

es.e: We jolted along rough wet roads through an endless banana plantation.
es.c: 我们沿崎岖潮湿的公路颠簸着驶过无边无际的香蕉种植园。

d: vt  破坏， 危及 to risk losing or spoiling something important

es.e: large-scale military offensives which could jeopardize the UN peace process
es.c: 可能会破坏联合国和平进程的大规模军事进攻

d: n  地方主义， 乡土性

es.e: Wright grew frustrated with American provincialism.
es.c: 赖特对美国的地方偏狭观念愈发感到沮丧。

d: adj  占优势的， 主导的， 支配的； 显著的， 盛行的 more powerful, more common, or more easily noticed than others

es.e: the predominant group in society
es.c: 社会中的主导群体

es.e: In this painting, the predominant colour is black.
es.c: 这幅画的主色调是黑色。

d: vt  驯养， 驯化； 使精于家务， 使喜爱家居 to make an animal able to work for people or live with them as a pet

es.e: We domesticated the dog to help us with hunting.
es.c: 我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

d: n  食谱； 方法， 秘诀， 诀窍 a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food

es.e: a recipe book
es.c: 一本烹饪书

d: vi 栖息 if a bird roosts, it rests or sleeps somewhere；n  栖息处， 鸟巢 a place where birds rest and sleep

es.e: The peacocks roost in nearby shrubs.
es.c: 那只孔雀在附近的灌木丛里栖息。

d: vt  分配； 分派 to decide how something should be shared among various people

es.e: It’s not easy to apportion blame (=  say who deserves to be blamed  ) when a marriage breaks up.
es.c: 婚姻破裂很难说是谁的错。

d: adj  精神的； 智力的； 精神健康的 relating to the health or state of someone’s mind

es.e: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness .
es.c: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

es.e: Stress has an effect on both your physical and mental health .
es.c: 压力对身体健康和心理健康都有影响。

d: adj  体面的； 适当的， 得体的； 令人满意的； 正派的 following moral standards that are acceptable to society

es.e: a decent burial
es.c: 得体的葬礼

es.e: Paul visited the local bars more frequently than was decent for a senior lecturer.
es.c: 保罗过于频繁地光顾当地酒吧，不太合乎高级讲师的身份。

es.e: The chairman did the decent thing (= did what people thought he ought to ) and resigned.
es.c: 主席体面地辞去了职务。

d: adv  漂浮地 If someone or something is afloat, they remain partly above the surface of water and do not sink；adj 漂浮的；有偿债能力的，能维持下去的 floating on water

es.e: They talked modestly of their valiant efforts to keep the tanker afloat.
es.c: 他们谦虚地谈论了他们为让油轮保持不沉而付出的英勇努力。

d: v  转变， 改变； 交换， 掉换 to change from doing or using one thing to doing or using another；n 开关，电闸；转换，改变；枝条，鞭子 a piece of equipment that starts or stops the flow of electricity to a machine, light etc when you push it

es.e: The terrorists will switch tactics .
es.c: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

d: adj  辅助的， 补助的， 补充的； 备用的， 后备的 auxiliary workers provide additional help for another group of workers

es.e: an auxiliary nurse
es.c: 助理护士

es.e: auxiliary staff
es.c: 辅助员工

d: adj 凶残的；野蛮的，未开化的 very violent or cruel；n 野蛮人，未开化的人 a very offensive word for someone who has a simple, traditional way of life；vt  残害； 激烈抨击

es.e: a savage dog
es.c: 一条凶猛的狗

es.e: a savage murder
es.c: 凶残的谋杀

d: adj  可行的， 可实施的； 可生长发育的 a viable idea, plan, or method can work successfully

es.e: viable seeds
es.c: 可存活的种子

d: adj  面部的； 面部用的 on your face or relating to your face

es.e: Victor’s facial expression didn’t change.
es.c: 维克托脸上的表情没有变化。

es.e: facial hair
es.c: 脸部的汗毛

d: n  副产品； 副作用， 意外结果 something additional that is produced during a natural or industrial process

es.e: The raw material for the tyre is a byproduct of oil refining.
es.c: 这种轮胎的原料是汽油提炼的副产品。

d: vt  安慰， 抚慰 to make someone feel better when they are feeling sad or disappointed

es.e: No one could console her when Peter died.
es.c: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

d: adj  吉兆的， 吉利的； 幸运的 showing that something is likely to be successful

es.e: On the reverse the same inscription is repeated, besides a row of five Swastikas as auspicious symbols signifying security and good luck.
es.c: 倒转的同样碑刻是重复的，此外一排五个纳粹党所用的十字记号如幸运的符号表示安全和好运。

d: v  碰巧， 偶然发生； 冒…的险 to do something that you know involves a risk；n 机会；可能性，偶然性；偶然的事 the possibility that something will happen, especially something you want

es.e: I wasn’t sure if I’d got quite enough petrol to get me home, but I decided to chance it .
es.c: 我不知道开车回家汽油够不够，但我决定冒险一试。

es.e: We decided not to chance our luck in the storm.
es.c: 我们决定不去冒险顶着暴风雨出去。

es.e: She’d never played before, but she was ready to chance her arm (= take a risk by doing something which may fail ) .
es.c: 她以前从未玩过，但她准备冒险试一下。

d: n  药物治疗； 药物 medicine or drugs given to people who are ill

es.e: When somebody comes for treatment I always ask them if they are on any medication.
es.c: 有人来治疗时，我总是会问他们是否在服药。

d: adj  苛求的， 难满足的； 需要高的， 费力的 needing a lot of ability, effort, or skill

es.e: a demanding job
es.c: 高要求的工作

d: v 钻，打眼；训练 to make a hole in something using a drill；n  钻； 训练 a method of teaching students, sports players etc something by making them repeat the same lesson, exercise etc many times

es.e: Drill a hole in each corner.
es.c: 在每个角上钻一个孔。

d: n  必然的结果； 推断 something that is the direct result of something else

es.e: The number of prisoners increased as a corollary of the government's determination to combat violent crime.
es.c: 政府决心打击暴力犯罪，其后果是囚犯数量增加了。

d: v  变魔术， 变戏法； 召唤 to perform clever tricks in which you seem to make things appear, disappear, or change by magic

es.e: The magician conjured a rabbit out of his hat.
es.c: 魔术师从帽子里变出一只兔子来。

d: v  承认， 确认； 对…表示感谢 to admit or accept that something is true or that a situation exists

es.e: The family acknowledge the need for change.
es.c: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

es.e: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
es.c: 克莱尔承认有罪。

es.e: The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
es.c: 对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。

d: n  感受器； 受体 a nerve ending which receives information about changes in light, heat etc and causes the body to react in particular ways

es.e: ...the information receptors in our brain.
es.c: …我们大脑中的信息感受器。

d: adj  静止的； 休眠的； 隐匿的 not active or not growing at the present time but able to be active later

es.e: a huge dormant volcano
es.c: 一座巨大的休眠火山

d: v  游说 to try to persuade the government or someone with political power that a law or situation should be changed；n 休息室，大厅；游说团 a group of people who try to persuade a government that a particular law or situation should

es.e: The Wilderness Society lobbied Congress to authorize the Endangered Species Act.
es.c: 荒野协会游说国会批准《濒危物种法》。

d: n  脉搏， 脉率； 脉冲 the regular beat that can be felt, for example at your wrist, as your heart pumps blood around your body

es.e: His breathing was shallow and his pulse was weak .
es.c: 他呼吸很浅，脉搏微弱。

es.e: She felt his neck. There was no pulse.
es.c: 她摸了摸他的颈部，没有脉搏。

es.e: Her pulse raced (= beat very quickly ) with excitement.
es.c: 她激动得脉搏急速跳动。

d: adj  描述性的， 叙述的 giving a description of something

es.e: the descriptive passages in the novel
es.c: 小说中的描写性段落

d: n  复兴； 改造， 再建 the work that is done to repair the damage to a city, industry etc, especially after a war

es.e: a reconstruction of a Roman villa
es.c: 罗马别墅的重现

d: adj  遗传的； 可继承的， 世袭的 a quality or illness that is hereditary is passed from a parent to a child before the child is born

es.e: a hereditary peer
es.c: 世袭贵族

d: vi  绊脚； 蹒跚而行； 结巴 to walk in an unsteady way and often almost fall

es.e: In her hurry, she stumbled and spilled the milk all over the floor.
es.c: 匆忙中她绊了一下，把牛奶洒得满地都是。

d: n  宗系， 世系， 血统 the way in which members of a family are descended from other members

es.e: a family of ancient lineage
es.c: 古老世家

d: adj  无忧无虑的； 愉快的

es.e: "He whistles as he goes, lighthearted wretch, /Cold and yet cheerful" (William Cowper).
es.c: 他边走边吹口哨，无忧无虑的小家伙/寒冷但仍然很高兴“ （威廉姆·考珀）。

d: v 贮藏，囤积 to collect and save large amounts of food, money etc, especially when it is not necessary to do so；n  储藏， 贮存 a collection of things that someone hides somewhere, especially so they can use them later

es.e: families who hoarded food during the strike
es.c: 罢工期间囤积食品的家庭

d: v  改变， 变化 if something varies, it changes depending on the situation

es.e: Quentin’s mood seems to vary according to the weather.
es.c: 昆廷的情绪似乎随天气而变化。

es.e: ‘What do you wear when you go out?’ ‘Well, it varies.’
es.c: “你出门的时候通常穿什么衣服？”“噢，得看情况。"

d: adj  条理清楚的， 连贯的； 有表达能力的 if a piece of writing, set of ideas etc is coherent, it is easy to understand because it is clear and reasonable

es.e: The three years of the course are planned as a coherent whole.
es.c: 这三年的课程是作为连贯的整体来安排的。

es.e: a coherent account of the incident
es.c: 对该事件条理分明的陈述

d: n  突出部分； 暗礁

es.e: From the base of the rock on which I stood, a moss-covered ledge stuck into deep water.
es.c: 从我所站立的岩石的底部，一个满是苔藓的暗礁伸进深水里。

d: n  三角洲； 希腊字母表的第四个字母 an area of low land where a river spreads into many smaller rivers near the sea

es.e: the Nile delta
es.c: 尼罗河三角洲

d: n  一段时期； 片段， 插曲； 一集 an event or a short period of time during which something happens

es.e: She decided she would try to forget the episode by the lake.
es.c: 她决心尽量忘掉湖边的那次经历。

es.e: one of the most interesting episodes in his career
es.c: 他职业生涯中最有趣的时期之一

d: adj 红外线的；产生红外线的 Infrared radiation is similar to light but has a longer wavelength, so we cannot see it without special equipment；n  红外线

es.e: ...searching with infrared scanners for weapons and artillery.
es.c: …用红外线扫描仪搜查武器和大炮。

d: adj  回答的；n 回答者，响应者；调查对象；被告 someone who has to defend their own case in a law court, especially in a  divorce  case

es.e: Only 62 percent of respondents said they were satisfied.
es.c: 回复调查的人中只有62%表示满意。

d: v  思索， 沉思

es.e: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
es.c: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

d: adj  活的， 有生命的 living；vt  赋予生命， 使有活力 to give life or energy to something

es.e: animate beings
es.c: 生物

d: n  地点， 现场； 景色； 一场， 一个镜头； 场面； 活动领域， 圈子 a particular set of activities and the people who are involved in them

es.e: I’m not into the club scene (= going to night clubs ) .
es.c: 我不喜欢逛夜店。

es.e: LA’s music scene
es.c: 洛杉矶的音乐圈

es.e: the drug scene
es.c: 毒品圈子

d: adj  客观的 based on facts, or making a decision that is based on facts rather than on your feelings or beliefs；n 目标，目的 something that you are trying hard to achieve, especially in business or politics

es.e: Scientists need to be objective when doing research.
es.c: 科学家做研究时要客观。

d: vt  运用， 行使； 施加； 努力， 竭力 to use your power, influence etc in order to make something happen

es.e: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
es.c: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

es.e: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
es.c: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

d: n  丑事， 丑闻； 恶意诽谤， 流言蜚语； 可耻的行为 an event in which someone, especially someone important, behaves in a bad way that shocks people

es.e: It caused quite a scandal when he left his wife.
es.c: 他离开妻子成了一大丑闻。

es.e: The college has recently been involved in a drugs scandal .
es.c: 这所大学最近卷入了毒品丑闻。

es.e: He has been at the centre of a political scandal .
es.c: 他成了一桩政治丑闻的焦点。

d: n  休眠； 催眠状态； 隐匿
vt  阻碍， 妨碍 to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed

es.e: His career has been hindered by injury.
es.c: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

es.e: policies that will hinder rather than help families
es.c: 对家庭有害无益的政策

d: n 香味，香气；气味；踪迹，线索；香水 a pleasant smell that something has；vt  闻出； 察觉 written to suddenly think that something is going to happen or exists

es.e: a yellow rose with a lovely scent
es.c: 香气怡人的黄玫瑰

d: v 陈列，展览；显示，表现 to show something in a public place so that people can go to see it；n  展览， 陈列 an exhibition

es.e: Her paintings have been exhibited all over the world.
es.c: 她的绘画作品在世界各地展出。

d: n  附加物， 附件； 附加语， 修饰语 something that is added or joined to something that is bigger or more important
vi  迅速成长 to grow and develop very quickly；n 蘑菇 one of several kinds of  fungus  with stems and round tops, some of which can be eaten

es.e: New housing developments mushroomed on the edge of town.
es.c: 城郊新住宅区雨后春笋般地冒出来。

d: adj  准确的， 精确的；vt 精准定位；准确解释 to find or show the exact position of something；n 极小的范围；光点 a very small area or  dot  of something

es.e: New satellites will allow cars to pinpoint their position within an inch .
es.c: 新的卫星系统将让汽车精确他们的位置到每一英寸。

es.e: The feature could, for example, pinpoint areas being threatened by a quickly approaching tornado and alert residents of impending danger via their computers or cell phones.
es.c: 例如，精确地定位正遭受龙卷风攻击的区域并通过计算机和手机警告危险地区的人们。

d: adj  利他的， 无私心的， 为他人着想的 altruistic behaviour shows that you care about and will help other people, even though this brings no advantage for yourself

es.e: Were his motives entirely altruistic?
es.c: 他的动机是完全无私的吗？

d: n  末端； 极端， 极度 the degree to which something goes beyond what is usually thought to be acceptable

es.e: The committee was uncomfortable about the extremity of the proposal.
es.c: 委员会因该建议太极端而感到不安。

d: v  否认； 拒绝承认； 拒绝给予 to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something

es.e: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
es.c: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

d: n  炼金术士 An alchemist was a scientist in the Middle Ages who tried to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold

es.e: Would you rather be an alchemist or a chemist?
es.c: 那么，你想做一个炼金术士，还是一个化学家呢？

es.e: At first glance, it all seems an alchemist's illusion.
es.c: 乍看上去， 它完全象是一位炼金术士的幻术。

es.e: The original museum of 1683 was based on the collections of Elias Ashmole, alchemist and antiquarian , a leading figure of "The New Philosophy".
es.c: 1683年老馆里的展品基本是伊莱亚斯·阿什莫尔的藏品。 他是一位炼金术士和古文物收集者，也是“新哲学”的领军人物。

d: v  挖沟；n 沟渠，壕沟；战壕 a long narrow hole dug into the surface of the ground

es.e: Orders came that we should spade the trench in an hour.
es.c: 有命令要我们必须在一小时内挖好战壕。

es.e: From nine to eleven he planned to dig a hole, or trench, and possibly find something good to eat buried in the dirt.
es.c: 九点到十一点，他打算挖一个洞，或者一条小沟也行，没准儿还能从脏土里翻出什么好吃的呢。

es.e: The bridge lies like a trench in the fortress of the moat, which is shaped to blend in with the outlines of the landscape.
es.c: 这座桥就像是坐落在护城河中的一条沟渠，这种造型是为了使它与周围的风景融合在一起。

d: adj  痛苦的； 可怜的； 令人不快的 extremely unhappy, for example because you feel lonely, cold, or badly treated

es.e: I’ve been so miserable since Pat left me.
es.c: 自从帕特离我而去后，我十分痛苦。

es.e: I spent the weekend feeling miserable .
es.c: 我那个周末心情很糟糕。

es.e: Jan looks really miserable .
es.c: 简看上去很痛苦。

d: vt  减去 to take a number or an amount from a larger number or amount

es.e: Then the deal is that when you sell the house they subtract -you've got to pay this.
es.c: 那么当你售出房子后，他们会从中减去，这个余额，这就是你要付给他们的。

es.e: That is, if you find that a sensor consistently overestimates by a certain value, you can subtract that value before the final value is reported.
