es.c: 货运公司

es.e: We’ll send your personal belongings by air freight and your furniture by sea freight .
es.c: 你的个人物品我们将以空运方式运送，家具将以海运方式运送。

d: v 穿，戴；留；面露，面带；磨损，用旧 to have something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery on your body；n  穿戴， 衣着； 服装， 穿戴物； 磨损， 损坏 the clothes worn for a particular occasion or activity, or by a particular group of people

es.e: Susanna was wearing a black silk dress.
es.c: 苏珊娜穿着一条黑色真丝连衣裙。

es.e: He wore glasses for reading.
es.c: 他阅读时戴眼镜。

d: n  植物学； 植物 the scientific study of plants

es.e: He studied botany at university.
es.c: 他在大学学习植物学。

es.e: To what degree are you interested in botany?
es.c: 你对植物学的兴趣达到什么程度?

es.e: The first of these in the field of botany were the herbals.
es.c: 在植物学领域，这些最早的著作是本草书。

d: v  变动； 散布； 漫游 to move around in an area without aiming for a particular place；n 范围；山脉；一系列；射程，距离 a number of people or things that are all different, but are all of the same general type

es.e: They range in price from $3 to $15.
es.c: 它们的价格在$3到$15之间变化。

d: n  表层土 the upper level of soil in which most plants have their roots

es.e: The topsoil has been almost completely washed away.
es.c: 表层土壤已差不多完全给冲走了。

es.e: According to scientists, it takes nature 500 years to create an inch of topsoil.
es.c: 根据科学家们的看法，自然界要用500年的时间才能形成一英寸的表层土壤。

es.e: Straw mulching, cultivating and hoeing , regulating the root distribution in the topsoil are effective measures to reduce the soil evaporation.
es.c: 秸秆覆盖、中耕锄划、调控表层土壤根系分布等可作为减少土壤蒸发的有效措施。

d: n  极光 an atmospheric phenomenon consisting of bands, curtains, or streamers of light, usually green, red, or yellow, that move across the sky in polar regions

es.e: The light creates the aurora that we see.
es.c: 这些光亮造就了我们所看到的极光。

es.e: A vast dawn of ideas is the peculiarity of our century, and in that aurora England and Germany have a magnificent radiance.
es.c: 思想的广泛昌明是我们这一世纪的特征，在那曙光里，英国和德国都有它们辉煌的成就。

d: adj  富有魅力的， 迷人的 attractive, exciting, and related to wealth and success

es.e: She led an exciting and glamorous life.
es.c: 她生活奢华，充满刺激。

es.e: the most glamorous neighborhood in the city
es.c: 城里最繁华的街区

es.e: On television, she looks so glamorous.
es.c: 她在电视里看上去光彩照人。

d: vt  证明…不成立， 证明…是错误的 to show that something is wrong or not true

es.e: These figures disproved Smith’s argument.
es.c: 这些数据证明史密斯的论点是错误的。

d: v  取得； 起源 to get a chemical substance from another substance

es.e: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
es.c: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

d: adv 在海外，在国外 to or in a foreign country that is across the sea；adj  海外的， 国外的 coming from, existing in, or happening in a foreign country that is across the sea

es.e: Chris is going to work overseas.
es.c: 克里斯要去国外工作。

es.e: Most applications came from overseas.
es.c: 大部分申请来自海外。

d: v 漏，渗出，泄漏 if a container, pipe, roof etc leaks, or if it leaks gas, liquid etc, there is a small hole or crack in it that lets gas or liquid flow through；n  漏洞， 裂缝； 泄露； 走漏 a small hole that lets liquid or gas flow into o

es.e: The roof is leaking.
es.c: 屋顶在漏水。

es.e: A tanker is leaking oil off the coast of Scotland.
es.c: 苏格兰海岸附近有一艘油轮漏油。

d: n  自满， 满足

es.e: She made no further progress because of complacence.
es.c: 由于自满，她没有取得进一步进展。

d: v  断言， 声称 to state firmly that something is true

es.e: French cooking, she asserted, is the best in the world.
es.c: 她坚称法国菜是世界上最好的。

d: v 回忆起，回想起；召回，叫回；收回，撤销 to remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past；n  记忆力， 记性； 召回 the ability to remember something that you have learned or experienced

es.e: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
es.c: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

es.e: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
es.c: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

d: n 拍打；振翅；封盖， the noisy movement of something such as cloth in the air

es.e: the flap of the sails
es.c: 船帆的拍动

d: vi  跳跃； 急速行动； 骤变； 激增 to increase quickly and by a large amount；n 跳跃；骤变；激增 a big jump

es.e: He leapt 27 places to second spot.
es.c: 他上升了27位，跃居第二名。

d: adj  规则的， 有规律的； 整齐的， 匀称的； 频繁的， 经常的； 正常的； 经常的； 正规的， 正式的 happening every hour, every week, every month etc, usually with the same amount of time in between

es.e: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
es.c: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

es.e: His breathing was slow and regular.
es.c: 他的呼吸缓慢而均匀。

es.e: Trains will run at regular intervals from 11 am to 4 pm.
es.c: 火车从上午11点到下午4点每隔一定时间开行。

d: adj  冰川期的， 冰河时代的； 寒冷的， 冰冷的； 冷若冰霜的 relating to ice and glaciers, or formed by glaciers

es.e: a glacial valley
es.c: 冰川谷

es.e: glacial deposits
es.c: 冰川沉积

d: adj  如画的； 别致的； 生动的 a picturesque place is pretty and interesting in an old-fashioned way

es.e: a quiet fishing village with a picturesque harbour
es.c: 拥有一座美丽港口的宁静渔村

d: adj  有学识的； 见多识广的， 有见识的 having a lot of knowledge or information about a particular subject or situation

es.e: Informed sources said it was likely that the president would make a televised statement.
es.c: 据消息灵通人士说，总统可能会发表电视声明。

d: v  争论； 对…表示异议 to say that something such as a fact or idea is not correct or true；n 争论；纠纷 a serious argument or disagreement

es.e: The main facts of the book have never been disputed.
es.c: 书中的主要事实从未遭到质疑。

d: n  侵略； 敌对的情绪或行为 the act of attacking a country, especially when that country has not attacked first

es.e: an unprovoked act of aggression
es.c: 无端的侵犯

d: vt  再装修， 重新装饰 To refurbish a building or room means to clean it and decorate it and make it more attractive or better equipped

es.e: We have spent money on refurbishing the offices.
es.c: 我们已在这些办公室的翻新上花了钱。

d: adj  崎岖的， 凹凸不平的； 艰难的； 粗犷的； 结实的， 耐用的； 粗野的， 不文雅的 land that is rugged is rough and uneven

es.e: a rugged coastline
es.c: 崎岖不平的海岸线

es.e: the rugged beauty of the Highlands
es.c: 苏格兰高地崎岖起伏的美景

d: v 领导，引导；领先，占首位；通向，导致， If you lead a group of people, you walk or ride in front of them

es.e: The president and vice president led the mourners.
es.c: 总统和副总统带领着送葬人群。

es.e: He walks with a stick but still leads his soldiers into battle.
es.c: 尽管他拄着拐杖，但他仍带领士兵上战场。

d: n  小部分， 一点儿， 少许 a very small amount of something

es.e: She hesitated for a fraction of a second before responding.
es.c: 她犹豫了一下才回应。

d: adj  象征性的 someone who is included in a group to make everyone think that the group has all types of people in it, when this is not really true；n 表示，标志，象征；记号；信物；代币；礼券，代价券 a round piece of metal that you use instead of mon

es.e: A small token payment will keep the bank happy.
es.c: 象征性地付点钱，银行就会满意了。

d: v 过滤；筛选；走漏；渗入，透过 to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment；n  过滤器； 筛选 something that you pass water, air etc through in order to remove unwanted sub

es.e: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
es.c: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

es.e: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
es.c: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

d: v  预期， 期望， 指望 to demand that someone does something because it is a duty or seems reasonable

es.e: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
es.c: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

d: n  感情， 激情， 情绪 a strong human feeling such as love, hate, or anger

es.e: Her voice was full of emotion.
es.c: 她的声音充满了激情。

es.e: She was good at hiding her emotions.
es.c: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

es.e: Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
es.c: 金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

d: vt  缓和， 减轻； 抚慰， 安慰 to make someone feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry

es.e: Lucy soothed the baby by rocking it in her arms.
es.c: 露西把宝宝抱在怀里摇晃着，让他安静下来。

es.e: She made a cup of tea to soothe her nerves.
es.c: 她泡了杯茶让自己平静下来。

d: v&n  结束， 终止， 停止 to stop doing something or stop happening

es.e: The things people will do for charity never cease to amaze me (= I am always surprised by them ) .
es.c: 人们的慈善义举总是让我感到惊讶。

es.e: The rain ceased and the sky cleared.
es.c: 雨过天晴。

d: vt  估价； 评定 to make a judgment about a person or situation after thinking carefully about it

es.e: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
es.c: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

d: n  礼节， 礼仪 the formal rules for polite behaviour in society or in a particular group

es.e: strict rules of professional etiquette
es.c: 严格的行规

d: n  处方， 药方； 开处方， 开药方 a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist

es.e: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
es.c: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

es.e: a repeat prescription
es.c: 重复处方

d: n  观众； 旁观者 someone who is watching an event or game

es.e: The match attracted over 40,000 spectators.
es.c: 这场比赛吸引了四万多名观众。

d: n  屈服， 服从； 提交， 呈递； 提交物； 看法， 意见 the state of being completely controlled by a person or group, and accepting that you have to obey them

es.e: The deadline for the submission of proposals is May 1st.
es.c: 呈交提案的最后期限是 5 月 1 日。

d: adj  缺乏的； 稀有的， 罕见的 if something is scarce, there is not very much of it available

es.e: Food was often scarce in the winter.
es.c: 冬季常常粮食短缺。

es.e: There was fierce competition for the scarce resources .
es.c: 对这些紧缺资源的争夺非常激烈。

d: v  迷住； 牵挂

es.e: Sometimes the best thing you can do is not think, not wonder, not imagine, not obsess. Just breathe, and have faith that everything will work out for the best.
es.c: 有时候你能做的最好的事情就是不去想、不去怀疑，不去想象，不去牵挂。只呼吸，并相信一切都会得到最佳结果。

d: adj  完全的 complete – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong；vt 出声；说 to say something

es.e: That’s utter nonsense!
es.c: 真是一派胡言！

es.e: This company treats its employees with utter contempt.
es.c: 这家公司对其员工不屑一顾。

es.e: I watched in complete and utter horror as he pulled out a gun.
es.c: 我惊恐万分地看着他拔出枪来。

d: adj  适当的； 足够的； 适当的， 胜任的 If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted

es.e: One in four people worldwide are without adequate homes.
es.c: 世界上1/4的人没有足够的住房。

es.e: She is prepared to offer me an amount adequate to purchase another house.
es.c: 她准备好了给我一笔足以购买另一所房子的钱。

d: n  动物群 all the animals living in a particular area or period in history

es.e: ...the flora and fauna of the African jungle.
es.c: …非洲丛林的植物群和动物群。

d: n  同样， 一致； 一致性 the quality of being or looking the same as all other members of a group

es.e: There seems to be no uniformity among the various systems.
es.c: 各系统之间似乎没有统一性。

d: vi  奔忙， 匆匆忙忙 to move around quickly, looking very busy；n 忙乱嘈杂，喧嚣 Bustle is busy, noisy activity

es.e: My mother bustled around the kitchen.
es.c: 我母亲在厨房里忙得团团转。

es.e: ...the hustle and bustle of modern life.
es.c: …现代生活的忙碌喧嚣。

d: n  一打， 十二个 twelve

es.e: a dozen eggs
es.c: 一打鸡蛋

es.e: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
es.c: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

es.e: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
es.c: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

d: adj  惊人的； 巨大的 very big, fast, powerful etc

es.e: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
es.c: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

es.e: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
es.c: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

es.e: She praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her.
es.c: 她称赞丈夫给了她巨大支持。

d: v  压缩； 凝结 if a gas condenses, or is condensed, it becomes a liquid

es.e: the mist which condensed on every cold surface
es.c: 每个冰冷的表面上凝结的水汽

d: vt  证实， 证明 to prove the truth of something that someone has said, claimed etc

es.e: Katzen offered little evidence to substantiate his claims .
es.c: 卡曾拿不出什么证据来证明他的说法。

d: vt  转移…的注意力， 使分心； 使娱乐； 使转向， 使改道 to change the use of something such as time or money

es.e: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
es.c: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

d: n  卫生； 卫生学 the practice of keeping yourself and the things around you clean in order to prevent diseases

es.e: the importance of personal hygiene
es.c: 个人卫生的重要性

es.e: a food hygiene training course
es.c: 食品卫生培训课程

d: adj 贤明的；审慎的 very wise, especially as a result of a lot of experience；n  智者， 圣人 a man revered for his profound wisdom

es.e: sage advice
es.c: 明智的忠告

d: n  巨头， 大亨 someone who is successful in business or industry and has a lot of money and power

es.e: ...a self-made Irish-American property tycoon.
es.c: …一个靠自己奋斗成功的爱尔兰裔美国房地产大亨。

d: adj  显眼的， 明显的 very easy to notice

es.e: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
es.c: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

es.e: a bird with conspicuous white markings
es.c: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

es.e: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
es.c: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

d: n  法官； 司法； 正义， 公正 the quality of being right and deserving fair treatment

es.e: No one doubts the justice of our cause.
es.c: 没有人怀疑我们的事业是正义的。

d: n  诗歌； 韵文； 诗节 a set of lines that forms one part of a song, poem, or a book such as the Bible or the Koran

es.e: Let’s sing the last verse again.
es.c: 我们把最后一节再唱一遍吧。

es.e: Learn the first two verses of the poem by heart.
es.c: 把这首诗的头两节背下来。

es.e: Genesis chapter 3, verse 13
es.c: 《创世记》第3章第13节

d: adj  狂怒的， 狂暴的； 强烈的， 猛烈的 very angry

es.e: She was absolutely furious .
es.c: 她怒不可遏。

d: adj 单独的；独特的 considered separately from other people or things in the same group；n  个人， 个体 a person, considered separately from the rest of the group or society that they live in

es.e: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
es.c: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

es.e: the needs of the individual customer
es.c: 每位顾客的需求

d: n  鲑鱼， 大马哈鱼 a large fish with silver skin and pink flesh that lives in the sea but swims up rivers to lay its eggs

es.e: He gave them a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.
es.c: 他款待了他们一顿极好的熏三文鱼午餐。

d: n  花束； 香味， 芬芳 an arrangement of flowers, especially one that you give to someone

es.e: The woman carried a bouquet of dried violets.
es.c: 那个女子拿着一束干紫罗兰花。

d: adj  本能的 instinctive

es.e: The relationship between a parent and a child is instinctual and stems from basic human nature.
es.c: 父母与孩子之间的关系是本能的，源于人类的本性。

d: vt  束缚， 限制 to limit something

es.e: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
es.c: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

es.e: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
es.c: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

d: n  女皇， 皇后 a female ruler of an empire, or the wife of an emperor

es.e: Yuena is Rome empress, while the Romans worshiped her as the God of women and marriage.
es.c: 约娜是罗马众神的皇后，罗马人同时将她尊奉为妇女和婚姻之神。

d: n  提供消息或情报的人， 线人； 提供资料的人； 合作者 someone who secretly gives the police, the army etc information about someone else

es.e: One of the witnesses was a paid informant for the FBI.
es.c: 目击者之一是联邦调查局出钱雇用的线人。

d: n  腱 a thick strong string-like part of your body that connects a muscle to a bone

es.e: ...a torn tendon in his right shoulder.
es.c: …他右肩一根被拉伤的腱。

d: adj  暂时的， 过渡的 intended to be used or accepted for a short time only, until something or someone final can be made or found；n 间歇，过渡期间 in the period of time between two events

es.e: an interim report
es.c: 中期报告

es.e: He received an interim payment of £10,000.
es.c: 他收到暂时支付的一万英镑。

es.e: An interim government was established.
es.c: 一个临时政府成立了。

d: n  证词； 证据， 证明 a formal statement saying that something is true, especially one a  witness  makes in a court of law

es.e: Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
es.c: 巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。

es.e: In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
es.c: 他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

d: vt  实施， 生效， 执行； 强迫， 迫使 to make people obey a rule or law

es.e: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
es.c: 停车限制将会严格执行。

d: vi 闪烁，闪耀 to shine brightly with flashing points of light；n  灿烂的光辉； 诱惑力， 魅力 You can use glitter to refer to superficial attractiveness or to the excitement connected with something

es.e: The river glittered in the sunlight.
es.c: 阳光下河面波光粼粼。

es.e: She was blinded by the glitter and the glamour of her own life.
es.c: 她被自己生活的表面光耀所蒙蔽。

d: adj  注定的； 以…为目的地的 seeming certain to happen at some time in the future

es.e: The flight was destined for Cairo.
es.c: 本次航班飞往开罗。

d: adj  易碎的； 脆弱的； 纤巧的； 虚弱的 easily broken or damaged

es.e: Be careful with that vase – it’s very fragile.
es.c: 小心那只花瓶——很容易打碎的。

es.e: fragile bones
es.c: 脆弱的骨头

d: adj  煞费苦心的， 勤勉的 very careful and thorough

es.e: The work had been done with painstaking attention to detail.
es.c: 这项工作被一丝不苟地完成了。

es.e: Chris described in painstaking detail what had happened.
es.c: 克里斯非常详细地描述了所发生的事情。

d: n  社会学 the scientific study of societies and the behaviour of people in groups

es.e: Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
es.c: 社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。

es.e: The mistress hunters are mostly women and are all psychology, sociology or law graduates.
es.c: “情妇猎手”大多为女性，且都是心理学、社会学或法学的毕业生。

d: adj  结实的， 强壮的； 肥胖的； 顽强的 fairly fat and heavy, or having a thick body

es.e: a short, stout man
es.c: 一个矮胖的男人

d: adj  巨大的， 庞大的 extremely big

es.e: a gigantic skyscraper
es.c: 摩天大楼

d: adj  明显的， 清楚的； 确实的； 截然不同的 clearly different or belonging to a different type

es.e: two entirely distinct languages
es.c: 两种完全不同的语言

d: vi 觅食；搜寻 to go around searching for food or other supplies；n  草料， 饲料 food supplies for horses and cattle

es.e: In the summer, the goats forage freely (= in any place they want to go ) .
es.c: 夏天，羊群自由自在地觅食。

d: adj  游牧的； 流浪的 nomadic people are nomads

es.e: nomadic herdsmen
es.c: 游牧民

d: n  地质学； 地质概况 the study of the rocks, soil etc that make up the Earth, and of the way they have changed since the Earth was formed

es.e: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
es.c: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

d: v  用篱笆围； 避免直接回答 to avoid giving a direct answer to a question；n 树篱；防止损失的措施；防备 a row of small bushes or trees growing close together, usually dividing one field or garden from another

es.e: You’re hedging again - have you got the money or haven’t you?
es.c: 你又在闪烁其词了，你究竟有没有钱？

es.e: ‘That depends on my partner,’ she hedged.
es.c: “那取决于我的合伙人。”她避重就轻地答道。

d: n  蜻蜓 a brightly-coloured insect with a long thin body and transparent wings which lives near water

es.e: It looks like a blue dragonfly.
es.c: 它看上去像只蓝色蜻蜓。

es.e: Let ourselves piece together the dragonfly well.
es.c: 让我们自己来把蜻蜓拼好吧。

es.e: Could that dragonfly flying above that drain be the answer to my prayers?
es.c: 那只在排水沟上空飞着的蜻蜓能作为我祈求的答案吗？

d: adj  知道的； 意识到的 if you are aware that a situation exists, you realize or know that it exists

es.e: Mr Braley has been made aware of the need for absolute secrecy.
es.c: 布雷利先生被告知需要绝对保密。

es.e: As you are aware, a fee will be charged annually.
es.c: 正如你所知道的那样，每年都要收取一笔费用。

d: adj  符合条件的， 合格的； 适合的 someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age

es.e: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
es.c: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。

d: n 闹钟；警报 a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger；vt  使惊恐； 使担心 to make someone feel worried or frightened

es.e: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
es.c: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

es.e: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
es.c: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

es.e: a sophisticated alarm system
es.c: 精密的警报系统

d: n  杂草； 水草 a wild plant growing where it is not wanted that prevents crops or garden flowers from growing properly

es.e: the constant battle against weeds
es.c: 对付杂草的长期斗争

d: adj 巴比伦的；奢华的 of, relating to, or characteristic of ancient Babylon or Babylonia, its people, or their language；n  巴比伦人 an inhabitant of ancient Babylon or Babylonia

es.e: So too the stories of Moses and of Samson have Sumerian and Babylonian parallels.
es.c: 同样，关于摩西和参孙的传说在苏美尔和巴比伦也有相似的版本。

es.e: The early Babylonian's most popular resolution was to return borrowed farm equipment.
es.c: 早期巴比伦人最普遍的计划是归还借来的耕种工具。

es.e: In the years around 2000 BC, the Babylonian New Year began with the first New Moon (actually the first visible crescent) after the Vernal Equinox (first day of spring).
es.c: 大约在公元前2000年，巴比伦的新年随着春分（春天的第一天）之后的第一个新月（实际上第一个看得见的新月）开始了。

d: n  冰川， 冰河 a large mass of ice which moves slowly down a mountain valley

es.e: Do you think we can glide down this glacier?
es.c: 你觉得我们可以从冰河上滑行下去吗？

es.e: An ice penetrating radar is deployed from a string of four kayaks to survey a section of the Petermann glacier in Greenland.
es.c: 一部冰透雷达安装在连成一串的四艘橡皮船上，用来考察格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川的一个截面。

es.e: The hue is caused by the silt that is finely ground away from the valley walls by the glacier and deposited in the lake.
es.c: 之所以会出现这样的色调，是因为淤泥被冰川分成很多远离谷壁的细碎的小块，分散在湖中。

d: n  最后通牒 a threat saying that if someone does not do what you want by a particular time, you will do something to punish them

es.e: The club gave him an ultimatum – either he apologized, or he would be expelled from the team.
es.c: 俱乐部给他下了最后通牒——要么道歉，要么等着被开除出队。

es.e: The army issued an ultimatum for all weapons in the city to be surrendered on October 26th.
es.c: 军队发出最后通牒，必须于 10 月 26 日交出该市的全部武器。

d: n  一大群人； 游牧部落 a large crowd moving in a noisy uncontrolled way

es.e: This attracts hordes of tourists to Las Vegas.
es.c: 这吸引了一群群的旅客来到拉斯维加斯。

d: n  降雨； 降雨量 the amount of rain that falls on an area in a particular period of time

es.e: We’ve had a long period of low rainfall.
es.c: 我们已有很长一段时间雨量偏低。

es.e: The city has received only half its average rainfall of four inches.
es.c: 该市目前的降雨只有往常四英寸平均雨量的一半。

d: n  种族主义， 种族歧视 unfair treatment of people, or violence against them, because they belong to a different race from your own

es.e: The government has promised to continue the fight against racism.
es.c: 政府已承诺继续打击种族歧视。

es.e: the problem of racism in schools
es.c: 学校里的种族歧视问题

d: n  方向， 方位； 定位； 培训； 情况介绍 the angle or position of an object, or the direction in which it is facing

es.e: The party has a broadly socialist orientation.
es.c: 该政党大体上倾向于社会主义。

d: adj  奢侈的， 奢华的 very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable

es.e: a luxurious 30-room villa
es.c: 一栋有30个房间的豪华度假别墅

d: v  做动作， 示意 to give someone directions or instructions by moving your hand or head；n 运动，移动；动作；提议，动议 the process of moving or the way that someone or something moves

es.e: She motioned for the locked front doors to be opened.
es.c: 她打手势示意把锁着的前门打开。

d: adj 懒散的；没有工作的，闲散的；空闲的；漫无目的的；无用的，无效的 not working or producing anything；v  无所事事， 虚度 to spend time doing nothing

es.e: I cannot afford to leave the land lying idle.
es.c: 我不能让土地闲置。

es.e: The whole team stood idle, waiting for the mechanic.
es.c: 整队人干站着等技工来。

es.e: The workers have been idle for the last six months.
es.c: 最近六个月工人们都很闲。

d: n  困境， 苦境 a very bad situation that someone is in

es.e: the country’s economic plight
es.c: 该国的经济困境

d: v  匹配 if one thing matches another, or if two things match, they look attractive together because they are a similar colour, pattern etc；n 比赛；对手 an organized sports event between two teams or people

es.e: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
es.c: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

es.e: Do you think this outfit matches?
es.c: 你认为这套衣服配吗？

es.e: a beech dining table with four chairs to match (= chairs that match it )
es.c: 配有四把椅子的山毛榉餐桌

d: n  过错， 过失； 缺点， 弱点； 断层 if something bad that has happened is your fault, you should be blamed for it, because you made a mistake or failed to do something

es.e: I’m really sorry - it’s all my fault.
es.c: 我真的很抱歉——都是我的错。

es.e: I didn’t sleep well that night, but it was my own fault .
es.c: 那天晚上我没有睡好，但这是我自己的问题。

d: n&vi  相互作用， 相互影响 the way in which two people or things affect each other

es.e: ...the interplay of political, economic, social and cultural factors.
es.c: ...政治、经济，社会和文化因素的互相影响。

d: v  招呼； 高呼； 赞扬， 称颂； 下冰雹 to call to someone in order to greet them or try to attract their attention；n 冰雹；一阵 frozen raindrops which fall as hard balls of ice

es.e: She leaned out of the window and hailed a passerby.
es.c: 她探出窗户向一个路人大喊。

d: n  重音； 口音； 重音符号 the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from；vt  重读 to emphasize a part of a word in speech

es.e: He had a strong Irish accent
es.c: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

d: adj  被动的， 消极的； 被动语态的 someone who is passive tends to accept things that happen to them or things that people say to them, without taking any action

es.e: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
es.c: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

es.e: their passive acceptance of their fate
es.c: 他们对命运的消极接受

d: adj  恶心的； 令人作呕的， 令人厌恶的 feeling that you are going to vomit

es.e: I felt slightly nauseous.
es.c: 我觉得有点恶心。

es.e: The taste made me nauseous.
es.c: 那味道让我恶心。

d: v  分裂， 成碎片 to break something, or be broken into a lot of small separate parts – used to show disapproval；n  碎片， 断片 a small piece of something that has broken off or that comes from something larger

es.e: the dangers of fragmenting the Health Service
es.c: 医疗保健服务分崩离析的危险

d: n  花岗岩， 花岗石 a very hard grey rock, often used in building

es.e: A pile of sand is loose, but it mixed with cement, stone, water, the toughness than granite.
es.c: 一堆沙子是松散的，可是它和水泥、石子、水混合后，比花岗岩还坚韧。——王杰。

es.e: Engineerss had to dig and blast through 73 different kinds of rock, some as hard as granite and others as soft as sugar.
es.c: 施工人员挖出并炸掉的岩石足有73种之多，有的岩石硬的花岗岩，有的岩石软的像糖果。

es.e: In the rock types, each big rock types are different degree of distribution, which dominates, class of granite rock type.
es.c: 在岩石类型上，各大岩类均有不同程度的分布，其中以花岗岩类占主导，中基性岩类次之。

d: n  回答； 反应， 响应 something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened or been said

es.e: His immediate response was one of disbelief.
es.c: 他的第一反应是不相信。

es.e: Emmett’s new exhibition has met with a favourable response from critics.
es.c: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

d: adj  使人耳目一新的； 提神的， 使人精神振作的 pleasantly different from what is familiar and boring

es.e: It made a refreshing change to talk to someone new.
es.c: 和刚认识的人谈话感觉很新鲜。

d: adj  遗忘的； 未注意的， 不知不觉的 not knowing about or not noticing something that is happening around you

es.e: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
es.c: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

d: n  种类； 范畴 a group of people or things that are all of the same type

es.e: people in the over-45 age category
es.c: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

es.e: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
es.c: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

es.e: Williams’ style does not fit easily into the category of jazz.
es.c: 威廉斯的风格不能轻易归入爵士乐的范畴。

d: adj  竞争的， 对抗的；vt 与…相匹敌，比得上 to be as good or important as someone or something else；n 竞争对手 a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc

es.e: He is, in effect, my rival.
es.c: 实际上他是我的竞争对手。
